data.Korean: (첫 배치지는 생각보다 조용했다.)
data.English: (My first assignment was quieter than I expected.)
data.Thai: (จุดประจำการแรกเงียบกว่าที่คิดไว้)
data.Vietnamese: (Nơi được phân công đầu tiên của tôi yên tĩnh hơn tôi nghĩ.)
data.Indonesian: (Tempat penugasan pertamaku ternyata lebih tenang dari yang kupikir.)

data.Korean: 여기가 시에스 방어 요새야? 몬스터가 거의 안 나온다더니, 진짜로 조용하네.
data.English: Is this the Cies Defense Fortress? They said monsters barely show up here, and it really is quiet.
data.Thai: ที่นี่คือป้อมป้องกันซีเอสเหรอ? ได้ยินว่าแทบไม่มีมอนสเตอร์ออกมาเลย เงียบจริง ๆ ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Đây là pháo đài phòng thủ Cies à? Nghe nói quái vật hầu như không xuất hiện, đúng là yên tĩnh thật.
data.Indonesian: Ini Benteng Pertahanan Cies? Katanya monster hampir tidak pernah muncul, dan memang tenang sekali.

data.Korean: 지휘관님과 수호대 여러분이십니까?
data.English: Are you the Commander and the Guardians?
data.Thai: ท่านคือผู้บัญชาการกับทุกท่านจากหน่วยพิทักษ์ใช่ไหมครับ?
data.Vietnamese: Ngài là Chỉ huy và mọi người trong Đội Hộ vệ phải không ạ?
data.Indonesian: Apakah Anda Komandan dan para anggota Penjaga?

data.Korean: 시에스 방어 요새에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
data.English: Welcome to Cies Defense Fortress.
data.Thai: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ป้อมป้องกันซีเอสครับ
data.Vietnamese: Chào mừng đến với pháo đài phòng thủ Cies.
data.Indonesian: Selamat datang di Benteng Pertahanan Cies.

data.Korean: 환영해 줘서 고마워. 오자마자 일 이야기를 해서 미안한데, 안내를 부탁할게.
data.English: Thanks for the welcome. Sorry to bring up work right away, but could you guide us?
data.Thai: ขอบคุณที่มาต้อนรับนะ ขอโทษที่มาถึงก็พูดเรื่องงานเลย แต่ช่วยนำทางให้หน่อยได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Cảm ơn đã ra đón. Vừa tới đã nói chuyện công việc thì hơi ngại, nhưng nhờ anh hướng dẫn giúp.
data.Indonesian: Terima kasih atas sambutannya. Maaf baru tiba sudah membahas tugas, tapi tolong pandu kami.

data.Korean: 이쪽이 세라, 그리고 이쪽이 노아야.
data.English: This is Serah, and this is Noah.
data.Thai: คนนี้คือเซราห์ แล้วคนนี้คือโนอา
data.Vietnamese: Đây là Serah, còn đây là Noah.
data.Indonesian: Ini Serah, dan ini Noah.

data.Korean: 반가워! 전열을 맡고 있는 세라야.
data.English: Nice to meet you. I am Serah, the front-line guard. I will check the gate area first.
data.Thai: ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก ฉันชื่อเซราห์ รับหน้าที่แนวหน้า ฉันจะไปดูฝั่งประตูก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Rất vui được gặp. Tôi là Serah, phụ trách tuyến trước. Phần kiểm tra phía cổng cứ để tôi xem trước.
data.Indonesian: Senang bertemu. Aku Serah, bertugas di garis depan. Aku akan memeriksa area gerbang lebih dulu.

data.Korean: 노아야. 멀리서 움직임을 보는 건 내가 맡을게.
data.English: I am Noah. I will keep an eye on movement from a distance.
data.Thai: ฉันโนอา ถ้ามีการเคลื่อนไหวจากระยะไกล ฉันจะคอยดูให้ก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Noah. Tôi sẽ kiểm tra trước những chuyển động nhìn thấy từ xa.
data.Indonesian: Aku Noah. Aku akan mengawasi pergerakan yang terlihat dari jauh lebih dulu.

data.Korean: 그리고 이쪽이 엘리스, 스파인이야.
data.English: And this is Alice, and this is Spayne.
data.Thai: แล้วคนนี้คืออลิซ กับสไปน์
data.Vietnamese: Còn đây là Alice và Spayne.
data.Indonesian: Dan ini Alice serta Spayne.

data.Korean: 엘리스야. 신호석 확인과 마법 지원을 맡고 있어.
data.English: I am Alice. I handle signal stone checks and magical support. I am more thorough than I look, so do not worry.
data.Thai: ฉันชื่ออลิซ รับหน้าที่ตรวจศิลาสัญญาณกับสนับสนุนด้วยเวทมนตร์ เห็นแบบนี้แต่ฉันค่อนข้างละเอียดนะ ไม่ต้องห่วง
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Alice. Tôi phụ trách kiểm tra đá tín hiệu và hỗ trợ ma pháp. Tôi kỹ tính hơn vẻ ngoài đấy, nên đừng lo.
data.Indonesian: Aku Alice. Aku menangani pemeriksaan batu sinyal dan dukungan sihir. Aku lebih teliti dari kelihatannya, jadi jangan khawatir.

data.Korean: 스파인이야. 회복을 맡고 있어. 아프면 바로 말해줘.
data.English: I am Spayne. I handle healing. If you are hurt, tell me right away.
data.Thai: ฉันสไปน์ รับหน้าที่รักษา ถ้าเจ็บตรงไหนก็บอกทันทีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Spayne. Tôi phụ trách hồi phục. Nếu bị đau thì nói ngay nhé.
data.Indonesian: Aku Spayne. Aku bertugas memulihkan. Kalau sakit, segera bilang.

data.Korean: 저는 시에스 요새 수비대장인 데미안입니다.
data.English: I am Demian, captain of the Cies Fortress Guard.
data.Thai: ผมคือเดเมียน หัวหน้ากองป้องกันป้อมซีเอสครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Demian, đội trưởng đội phòng vệ pháo đài Cies.
data.Indonesian: Saya Demian, kapten pertahanan Benteng Cies.

data.Korean: 앞으로 잘 부탁해, 데미안. 도착 전에 확인할 업무는 전달받았어.
data.English: We will be counting on you, Demian. We received the tasks to check before we arrived.
data.Thai: ฝากตัวด้วยนะ เดเมียน ก่อนมาถึง พวกเราได้รับงานที่ต้องตรวจสอบแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Nhờ anh giúp đỡ, Demian. Chúng tôi đã nhận được các việc cần kiểm tra trước khi đến đây.
data.Indonesian: Kami mengandalkanmu, Demian. Sebelum tiba, kami sudah menerima tugas yang perlu diperiksa.

data.Korean: 세라는 관문 검문소를 확인해 줘. 노아는 망루에서 숲길을 봐줘.
data.English: Serah, check the gate checkpoint. Noah, watch the forest road from the watchtower.
data.Thai: เซราห์ ช่วยตรวจจุดตรวจประตูที โนอา ช่วยดูทางป่าจากหอเฝ้าระวัง
data.Vietnamese: Serah, kiểm tra trạm gác cổng giúp tôi. Noah, quan sát đường rừng từ tháp canh nhé.
data.Indonesian: Serah, tolong periksa pos pemeriksaan gerbang. Noah, awasi jalan hutan dari menara pengawas.

data.Korean: 엘리스는 신호석을 확인해 주고, 스파인은 물자 보관소를 봐줄래?
data.English: Alice, check the signal stones. Spayne, can you check the supply storage?
data.Thai: อลิซช่วยตรวจศิลาสัญญาณ ส่วนสไปน์ช่วยดูคลังเสบียงได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Alice, kiểm tra đá tín hiệu giúp tôi. Spayne, cậu xem kho vật tư được chứ?
data.Indonesian: Alice, tolong periksa batu sinyal. Spayne, bisa lihat gudang persediaan?

data.Korean: 데미안, 네 사람에게 안내할 인원을 붙여줄 수 있을까?
data.English: Demian, can you assign guides to the four of them?
data.Thai: เดเมียน ช่วยจัดคนไปนำทางทั้งสี่คนได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Demian, anh có thể bố trí người dẫn đường cho bốn người họ không?
data.Indonesian: Demian, bisa tempatkan orang untuk memandu mereka berempat?

data.Korean: 알겠습니다. 바로 안내 병력을 배치하겠습니다.
data.English: Understood. I will assign guides at once.
data.Thai: รับทราบครับ ผมจะจัดกำลังนำทางให้ทันทีครับ
data.Vietnamese: Rõ. Tôi sẽ bố trí binh lính dẫn đường ngay.
data.Indonesian: Dimengerti. Saya akan segera menempatkan pasukan pemandu.

data.Korean: 좋아! 관문 쪽은 내가 먼저 확인할게. 무슨 일 있으면 바로 알려줄게!
data.English: All right! I will check the gate checkpoint.
data.Thai: เอาล่ะ! จุดตรวจประตู ฉันจะไปดูเอง
data.Vietnamese: Được! Trạm gác cổng cứ để tôi xem.
data.Indonesian: Baik! Pos pemeriksaan gerbang biar aku yang lihat.

data.Korean: 먼저 가는 건 좋은데, 위험한 건 알고 있는 거지?
data.English: I will check the tower first.
data.Thai: ฉันจะไปตรวจฝั่งหอเฝ้าระวังก่อนแล้วกลับมา
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra phía tháp canh trước rồi quay lại.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa sisi menara pengawas dulu.

data.Korean: 나는 신호석을 먼저 볼게. 끝나면 관문 쪽도 확인하러 갈게.
data.English: I will check the signal stones, then help Serah.
data.Thai: ฉันจะตรวจศิลาสัญญาณก่อน แล้วค่อยไปช่วยฝั่งเซราห์
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra đá tín hiệu rồi qua hỗ trợ Serah.
data.Indonesian: Setelah memeriksa batu sinyal, aku akan membantu sisi Serah.

data.Korean: 관문 안쪽 물자 보관소라면... 여기서 제일 멀지 않아?
data.English: If it is the supply storage inside the gate... is that not the farthest place from here?
data.Thai: ถ้าเป็นคลังเสบียงด้านในประตู... มันไม่ได้ไกลที่สุดจากตรงนี้เหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Nếu là kho vật tư bên trong cổng... chẳng phải xa nhất từ đây sao?
data.Indonesian: Kalau gudang persediaan di dalam gerbang... bukankah itu yang paling jauh dari sini?

data.Korean: 세라, 혹시 나랑 역할 바꿀래...?
data.English: Even if it is far, checking it now should keep us from getting lost later.
data.Thai: ถึงจะไกล แต่ถ้าดูไว้ตอนนี้ ทีหลังก็ไม่น่าหลงทางนะ
data.Vietnamese: Dù xa, nếu kiểm tra từ bây giờ thì sau này sẽ đỡ lạc đường.
data.Indonesian: Walau jauh, kalau dicek sekarang nanti kita tidak akan tersesat.

data.Korean: 미안. 관문 쪽은 내가 볼게. 앞에서 막는 건 내 일이니까.
data.English: Serah, do you want to switch jobs with me...?
data.Thai: เซราห์... อยากสลับหน้าที่กับฉันไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Serah, hay là đổi nhiệm vụ với tôi không...?
data.Indonesian: Serah, mau tukar tugas denganku...?

data.Korean: 반박하고 싶은데... 맞는 말이라 더 가기 싫어...
data.English: Sorry. I think I should check the checkpoint. Holding the front is my job.
data.Thai: ขอโทษนะ ฉันว่าจุดตรวจให้ฉันดูจะดีกว่า เพราะการกันไว้ด้านหน้าคืองานของฉัน
data.Vietnamese: Xin lỗi. Tôi nghĩ mình nên xem trạm gác. Chặn ở phía trước là việc của tôi mà.
data.Indonesian: Maaf. Kurasa pos pemeriksaan sebaiknya aku yang lihat. Menahan dari depan itu tugasku.

data.Korean: (각자 위치를 확인하려던 찰나, 요새 안쪽에서 경보 종이 크게 울렸다.)
data.English: That is so true it just makes me sadder...
data.Thai: มันถูกเกินไปจนยิ่งเศร้าเลย...
data.Vietnamese: Đúng quá nên càng buồn hơn...
data.Indonesian: Terlalu benar, jadi makin sedih...

data.Korean: 보고드립니다! 몬스터 경보입니다! 숲 방향에서 다수의 몬스터를 확인했습니다! 관문 쪽으로 접근 중입니다!
data.English: (Just as we were about to check our positions, the alarm bell rang loudly inside the fortress.)
data.Thai: (ในจังหวะที่พวกเรากำลังจะแยกย้ายไปตรวจตำแหน่ง เสียงระฆังเตือนภัยก็ดังขึ้นจากในป้อม)
data.Vietnamese: (Ngay lúc chúng tôi chuẩn bị kiểm tra từng vị trí, chuông báo động vang lớn từ bên trong pháo đài.)
data.Indonesian: (Saat kami hendak memeriksa posisi masing-masing, lonceng peringatan berbunyi keras dari dalam benteng.)

data.Korean: 세라... 조용하다면서?
data.English: Reporting! Monster alarm! We have confirmed multiple monsters from the forest! They are approaching the gate!
data.Thai: รายงานครับ! สัญญาณเตือนมอนสเตอร์! พบมอนสเตอร์จำนวนมากจากทิศทางป่า! กำลังเข้าใกล้ฝั่งประตูครับ!
data.Vietnamese: Báo cáo! Báo động quái vật! Đã phát hiện nhiều quái vật từ hướng rừng! Chúng đang tiến về phía cổng!
data.Indonesian: Lapor! Alarm monster! Banyak monster terdeteksi dari arah hutan! Mereka sedang mendekati gerbang!

data.Korean: 그랬었지! 그럼 다시 조용하게 만들면 되잖아!
data.English: Serah... you said it was quiet.
data.Thai: เซราห์... ไหนบอกว่าเงียบไง?
data.Vietnamese: Serah... cậu bảo là yên tĩnh mà?
data.Indonesian: Serah... tadi kau bilang tenang, kan?

data.Korean: 맞는 말인데, 왜 이렇게 불안하게 들리지?
data.English: It was quiet!
data.Thai: เมื่อกี้มันเงียบจริง ๆ นะ!
data.Vietnamese: Lúc nãy đúng là yên tĩnh mà!
data.Indonesian: Memang tadinya tenang!

data.Korean: 노아는 망루에서 숲길을 계속 감시해 줘.
data.English: First, let us figure out how to make it quiet again.
data.Thai: ก่อนอื่น คิดวิธีทำให้มันกลับมาเงียบอีกครั้งกันเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Trước hết, hãy nghĩ cách làm nơi này yên tĩnh lại đã.
data.Indonesian: Pertama, kita pikirkan cara membuatnya tenang lagi.

data.Korean: 스파인은 물자 보관소에서 응급 처치 물품을 챙겨와 줘. 둘 다 준비되는 대로 관문으로 합류해.
data.English: Noah, keep watching the forest road from the tower.
data.Thai: โนอา เฝ้าดูทางป่าจากหอเฝ้าระวังต่อไปนะ
data.Vietnamese: Noah, tiếp tục theo dõi đường rừng từ tháp canh.
data.Indonesian: Noah, terus awasi jalan hutan dari menara pengawas.

data.Korean: 응, 확인하고 바로 갈게.
data.English: Spayne, bring first-aid supplies from the storage. Both of you, join us at the gate as soon as you are ready.
data.Thai: สไปน์ ไปหยิบอุปกรณ์ปฐมพยาบาลจากคลังเสบียงมา ทั้งสองคนพร้อมแล้วให้มารวมที่ประตู
data.Vietnamese: Spayne, mang vật tư sơ cứu từ kho đến. Hai người chuẩn bị xong thì tập hợp ở cổng.
data.Indonesian: Spayne, ambil perlengkapan P3K dari gudang persediaan. Kalian berdua, bergabung di gerbang begitu siap.

data.Korean: 윽... 힘들게 제일 먼 곳까지 왔는데 바로 돌아가야 하네.
data.English: Okay. I will check and come right away.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันจะตรวจแล้วรีบไปทันที
data.Vietnamese: Ừ, tôi sẽ kiểm tra rồi đến ngay.
data.Indonesian: Ya, aku cek lalu segera ke sana.

data.Korean: 세라와 엘리스 두 사람은 관문 검문소에서 몬스터를 먼저 막아줘.
data.English: Ugh... I came all the way to the farthest place, and now I have to go right back.
data.Thai: อึก... อุตส่าห์เดินมาถึงที่ไกลที่สุดแล้ว ต้องกลับทันทีเลยเหรอ
data.Vietnamese: Ư... vất vả lắm mới đến chỗ xa nhất, giờ lại phải quay về ngay.
data.Indonesian: Ugh... susah payah sampai tempat paling jauh, sekarang harus langsung kembali.

data.Korean: 좋아! 관문 앞은 내가 맡을게. 절대 지나가게 두지 않을 거야!
data.English: Serah and Alice, stop the monsters at the gate checkpoint first.
data.Thai: เซราห์กับอลิซ สองคนช่วยสกัดมอนสเตอร์ที่จุดตรวจประตูก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Serah và Alice, hai người hãy chặn quái vật ở trạm gác cổng trước.
data.Indonesian: Serah dan Alice, kalian berdua tahan monster dulu di pos pemeriksaan gerbang.

data.Korean: 든든하긴 한데, 신호 받고 움직여줘. 몰리는 쪽은 내가 정리할게.
data.English: All right! I will hold here. I will not let them get through to the gate!
data.Thai: เอาล่ะ! ตรงนี้ฉันจะยืนรับเอง จะไม่ปล่อยให้ผ่านไปถึงประตูเด็ดขาด!
data.Vietnamese: Được! Chỗ này cứ để tôi giữ. Tôi sẽ không để chúng vượt qua tới cổng đâu!
data.Indonesian: Oke! Di sini biar aku yang tahan. Aku tidak akan membiarkan mereka sampai ke gerbang!

data.Korean: 알겠어. 신호가 오면 바로 나갈게!
data.English: Serah, take the front. I will watch the side where enemies gather.
data.Thai: เซราห์ ฝากด้านหน้าให้เธอ ฉันจะดูฝั่งที่ศัตรูรวมตัวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Serah, nhờ cậu lo phía trước. Tôi sẽ xem phía địch tụ lại.
data.Indonesian: Serah, ambil bagian depan. Aku akan melihat sisi tempat musuh berkumpul.

data.Korean: 몬스터 무리가 관문 앞까지 접근했습니다! 지휘관님, 신호석 준비를 부탁드립니다!
data.English: Got it. I will move out as soon as the signal comes!
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ถ้าสัญญาณมา ฉันจะออกไปทันที!
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Có tín hiệu là tôi sẽ ra ngay!
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Begitu sinyal datang, aku langsung maju!

data.Korean: 세라와 엘리스한테 먼저 신호를 보낼게.
data.English: The monster horde is approaching the gate! Commander, please prepare the signal stones!
data.Thai: ฝูงมอนสเตอร์เข้าใกล้หน้าประตูแล้วครับ! ท่านผู้บัญชาการ กรุณาเตรียมศิลาสัญญาณด้วยครับ!
data.Vietnamese: Bầy quái vật đã áp sát trước cổng! Thưa Chỉ huy, xin hãy chuẩn bị đá tín hiệu!
data.Indonesian: Gerombolan monster sudah mendekati depan gerbang! Komandan, mohon siapkan batu sinyal!

data.Korean: 신호 연결 확인. 세라, 준비됐지?
data.English: I will send the signal to Serah and Alice first.
data.Thai: ฉันจะส่งสัญญาณให้เซราห์กับอลิซก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ gửi tín hiệu cho Serah và Alice trước.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan mengirim sinyal ke Serah dan Alice dulu.

data.Korean: 좋아, 간다!
data.English: Signal link confirmed. Serah, are you ready?
data.Thai: ยืนยันการเชื่อมต่อสัญญาณ เซราห์ พร้อมนะ?
data.Vietnamese: Xác nhận kết nối tín hiệu. Serah, sẵn sàng chứ?
data.Indonesian: Koneksi sinyal terkonfirmasi. Serah, siap?

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 신호석 타이밍 액션 및 3-Sort 콤보 공격 학습]
data.English: All right, here I go!
data.Thai: เอาล่ะ ไปเลย!
data.Vietnamese: Được, lên thôi!
data.Indonesian: Oke, maju!

data.Korean: 오기 시작했어! 앞은 내가 막을게!
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Learn signal stone timing actions and 3-Sort combo attacks]
data.Thai: [ป๊อปอัปสอนเล่น: เรียนรู้แอ็กชันจับจังหวะศิลาสัญญาณและการโจมตีคอมโบ 3-Sort]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Học thao tác căn thời điểm đá tín hiệu và tấn công combo 3-Sort]
data.Indonesian: [Pop-up Tutorial: Pelajari aksi timing batu sinyal dan serangan kombo 3-Sort]

data.Korean: 알겠어. 몰리는 쪽은 내가 정리할게.
data.English: Please drag the attack signal stone to Serah's slot.
data.Thai: กรุณาลากศิลาสัญญาณโจมตีไปยังช่องของเซราห์
data.Vietnamese: Vui lòng kéo đá tín hiệu tấn công vào ô của Serah.
data.Indonesian: Silakan seret batu sinyal serangan ke slot Serah.

data.Korean: 두 번째 무리가 보여. 이제 나도 합류할게. 멀리서 오는 적은 내가 먼저 확인할게.
data.English: Please line up three matching signal stones to complete a combo.
data.Thai: กรุณาจัดเรียงศิลาสัญญาณชนิดเดียวกัน 3 อันเพื่อทำคอมโบให้สำเร็จ
data.Vietnamese: Vui lòng xếp 3 đá tín hiệu cùng loại để hoàn thành combo.
data.Indonesian: Silakan susun 3 batu sinyal yang sama untuk menyelesaikan kombo.

data.Korean: 좋아! 뒤는 노아에게 맡기고, 앞은 내가 막을게!
data.English: They are starting to pour out! I will hold the front!
data.Thai: เริ่มทะลักออกมาแล้ว! ด้านหน้าฉันจะกันไว้เอง!
data.Vietnamese: Chúng bắt đầu tràn ra rồi! Phía trước để tôi chặn!
data.Indonesian: Mereka mulai menyerbu! Bagian depan akan kutahan!

data.Korean: 물자 쪽 잠금은 확인했어. 붕대도 챙겼고.
data.English: If enemies group together, I will handle them.
data.Thai: ถ้าศัตรูรวมกันเป็นกลุ่ม ฉันจะจัดการเอง
data.Vietnamese: Nếu kẻ địch tụ lại một chỗ, tôi sẽ xử lý.
data.Indonesian: Kalau musuh berkumpul di satu tempat, aku yang akan mengurusnya.

data.Korean: 이러면 다쳐도 바로 볼 수는 있겠지.
data.English: I see the second wave. I will join now. I will watch the enemies coming from afar.
data.Thai: เห็นกลุ่มที่สองแล้ว ตอนนี้ฉันจะเข้าร่วมด้วย ศัตรูที่เข้ามาจากไกล ๆ ฉันจะคอยดูให้
data.Vietnamese: Tôi thấy nhóm thứ hai rồi. Giờ tôi cũng sẽ tham gia. Kẻ địch tiến đến từ xa cứ để tôi theo dõi.
data.Indonesian: Aku melihat gelombang kedua. Aku bergabung sekarang. Musuh yang datang dari jauh akan kuawasi.

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 적 처치 경험치 획득 및 레벨업 보상 선택]
data.English: The supply storage is locked. I brought bandages too.
data.Thai: ตรวจล็อกฝั่งเสบียงแล้ว ผ้าพันแผลก็เอามาด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Tôi đã kiểm tra khóa bên kho vật tư. Băng vải cũng mang theo rồi.
data.Indonesian: Kunci di area persediaan sudah kuperiksa. Perban juga kubawa.

data.Korean: (대형 몬스터/보스 등장)
data.English: Still, I am glad you came right away.
data.Thai: ยังไงก็โล่งใจที่เธอมาได้ทันทีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Dù sao cậu đến ngay là tốt rồi.
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, bagus kau langsung datang.

data.Korean: 큰 녀석이 보여. 이번 무리는 저 녀석을 중심으로 움직이고 있어!
data.English: If I am late, I will just get busier...
data.Thai: ถ้ามาช้า งานก็จะยิ่งยุ่งขึ้น...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu đến muộn thì tôi lại càng bận hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau terlambat, aku malah makin sibuk...

data.Korean: 그럼 저 큰 녀석부터 막으면 되겠네. 내가 상대할게!
data.English: All right! Now everyone is here!
data.Thai: เอาล่ะ! ตอนนี้มากันครบแล้ว!
data.Vietnamese: Được! Giờ mọi người đã tụ họp đủ rồi!
data.Indonesian: Oke! Sekarang semua sudah berkumpul!

data.Korean: 세라, 잠깐만! 오래 끌면 무리가 더 늘어날 거야.
data.English: Now I can at least check on you right away if you get hurt.
data.Thai: แบบนี้ถ้าเจ็บ ฉันก็ยังดูให้ได้ทันทีล่ะนะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nếu có ai bị thương, ít nhất tôi cũng xem ngay được.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begini, setidaknya aku bisa langsung memeriksa kalau ada yang terluka.

data.Korean: 지휘관, 세라에게 스킬 신호를 보내줘!
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Gain EXP by defeating enemies and choose a level-up reward]
data.Thai: [ป๊อปอัปสอนเล่น: ได้รับค่าประสบการณ์จากการกำจัดศัตรูและเลือกการ์ดรางวัลเลเวลอัป]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Nhận EXP khi đánh bại kẻ địch và chọn phần thưởng lên cấp]
data.Indonesian: [Pop-up Tutorial: Dapatkan EXP dengan mengalahkan musuh dan pilih hadiah naik level]

data.Korean: 게이지를 전부 쓰는 필살기 신호야!
data.English: Please choose one level-up reward card.
data.Thai: กรุณาเลือกการ์ดรางวัลเลเวลอัป 1 ใบ
data.Vietnamese: Vui lòng chọn một thẻ thưởng lên cấp.
data.Indonesian: Silakan pilih salah satu kartu hadiah naik level.

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 게이지 소모를 통한 필살기(궁극기) 발동]
data.English: Large monster/boss appears
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์ขนาดใหญ่/บอสปรากฏตัว
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật lớn/Boss xuất hiện
data.Indonesian: Monster besar/Boss muncul

data.Korean: 신호 확인! 크게 한 방 먹일게!
data.English: I see a big one. This wave is moving around that one!
data.Thai: เห็นตัวใหญ่แล้ว กลุ่มนี้กำลังเคลื่อนไหวโดยมีเจ้าตัวนั้นเป็นศูนย์กลาง!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi thấy một con lớn. Nhóm này đang di chuyển quanh nó!
data.Indonesian: Aku melihat yang besar. Gelombang ini bergerak dengan dia sebagai pusatnya!

data.Korean: (관문 앞의 몬스터 무리를 전부 물리쳤다.)
data.English: Then we just have to stop that big one first. I will take the front!
data.Thai: งั้นก็หยุดเจ้าตัวใหญ่นั่นก่อนก็พอสินะ ฉันจะยืนด้านหน้าเอง!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chỉ cần chặn con lớn đó trước là được. Tôi sẽ đứng phía trước!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita hentikan yang besar itu dulu. Aku akan berdiri di depan!

data.Korean: 다친 데는 없어? 무리하지 말고 바로 말해줘.
data.English: Serah, wait! That huge one will take too long with normal attacks.
data.Thai: เซราห์ เดี๋ยวก่อน! เจ้าตัวใหญ่นั่น ถ้าใช้แค่การโจมตีปกติคงใช้เวลานาน
data.Vietnamese: Serah, khoan đã! Con to đó sẽ mất rất lâu nếu chỉ dùng đòn đánh thường.
data.Indonesian: Serah, tunggu! Yang besar itu akan memakan waktu lama kalau hanya diserang biasa.

data.Korean: 다친 데는 없어! 관문 앞은 조금 긁힌 것 같지만... 괜찮겠지?
data.English: Commander, send Serah the skill signal!
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ ส่งสัญญาณสกิลให้เซราห์ด้วย!
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, gửi tín hiệu kỹ năng cho Serah!
data.Indonesian: Komandan, kirim sinyal skill ke Serah!

data.Korean: 괜찮겠지로 끝내면 안 돼.
data.English: Not a normal signal. It is an ultimate signal that uses the entire gauge!
data.Thai: ไม่ใช่สัญญาณปกติ แต่เป็นสัญญาณท่าไม้ตายที่ใช้เกจทั้งหมด!
data.Vietnamese: Không phải tín hiệu thường. Đây là tín hiệu tuyệt kỹ dùng toàn bộ thanh tuyệt kỹ!
data.Indonesian: Bukan sinyal biasa. Ini sinyal jurus pamungkas yang menghabiskan seluruh Gauge Jurus Pamungkas!

data.Korean: 뭐, 그래도 관문 앞에서 막아낸 건 확실히 잘했어.
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Use the gauge to activate an ultimate skill]
data.Thai: [ป๊อปอัปสอนเล่น: ใช้เกจเพื่อเปิดใช้งานท่าไม้ตาย]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Kích hoạt tuyệt kỹ bằng cách tiêu hao thanh tuyệt kỹ]
data.Indonesian: [Pop-up Tutorial: Aktifkan jurus pamungkas dengan menggunakan Gauge Jurus Pamungkas]

data.Korean: 그래서 지금 확인하는 거야. 나중에 고치려면 더 귀찮아지니까.
data.English: Please use the Ultimate Gauge to activate Serah's ultimate skill.
data.Thai: กรุณาใช้เกจท่าไม้ตายเพื่อเปิดใช้งานท่าไม้ตายของเซราห์
data.Vietnamese: Vui lòng dùng thanh tuyệt kỹ để kích hoạt tuyệt kỹ của Serah.
data.Indonesian: Silakan gunakan Gauge Jurus Pamungkas untuk mengaktifkan jurus pamungkas Serah.

data.Korean: 그런데 좀 이상해. 아까 그 몬스터 무리, 전부 숲길에서 내려왔어.
data.English: Signal confirmed! I will hit it with one big blow!
data.Thai: ยืนยันสัญญาณ! จะซัดให้หนัก ๆ ทีเดียวเลย!
data.Vietnamese: Xác nhận tín hiệu! Tôi sẽ tung một đòn thật mạnh!
data.Indonesian: Sinyal diterima! Akan kuberi satu hantaman besar!

data.Korean: 망루에서도 봤는데, 숲길 안쪽 움직임이 아직 끝난 것 같진 않아.
data.English: (We defeated all the monsters in front of the gate.)
data.Thai: (พวกเรากำจัดมอนสเตอร์ทั้งหมดหน้าประตูได้แล้ว)
data.Vietnamese: (Chúng tôi đã đánh bại toàn bộ lũ quái vật trước cổng.)
data.Indonesian: (Kami mengalahkan semua monster di depan gerbang.)

data.Korean: 그럼 숲길 쪽을 다시 확인해야겠네.
data.English: Is anyone hurt? Do not push yourself. Tell me right away.
data.Thai: มีใครบาดเจ็บไหม? อย่าฝืน ถ้าเจ็บตรงไหนให้บอกทันที
data.Vietnamese: Có ai bị thương không? Đừng cố quá, đau ở đâu thì nói ngay nhé.
data.Indonesian: Ada yang terluka? Jangan memaksakan diri, segera bilang kalau sakit.

data.Korean: 시에스가 원래 이렇게 몬스터가 몰려드는 곳은 아니야.
data.English: No! I am not hurt! The stone pavement by the gate is... well, probably fine?
data.Thai: ไม่มี! ฉันไม่บาดเจ็บ! พื้นหินหน้าประตู... อืม คงไม่เป็นไรมั้ง?
data.Vietnamese: Không! Tôi không bị thương! Còn nền đá trước cổng thì... ừm, chắc là ổn nhỉ?
data.Indonesian: Tidak! Aku tidak terluka! Lantai batu di depan gerbang... hmm, mungkin baik-baik saja?

data.Korean: 조용한 근무지라더니, 그 소문이 완전히 틀렸네.
data.English: Probably fine is not how we should end that, but at least we stopped the monsters before they reached the gate.
data.Thai: คงไม่เป็นไรไม่ใช่คำตอบที่ควรจบเรื่องนะ แต่ยังไงก็หยุดมอนสเตอร์ได้ก่อนถึงประตู
data.Vietnamese: Không thể kết thúc bằng câu chắc là ổn được, nhưng dù sao cũng đã chặn được quái vật trước khi chúng chạm tới cổng.
data.Indonesian: “Mungkin baik-baik saja” bukan cara untuk mengakhiri ini, tapi setidaknya kita menghentikan monster sebelum mencapai gerbang.

data.Korean: 그 소문을 제일 먼저 말한 사람이 세라였지.
data.English: I will check the stone pavement. If repairs get worse later, it will be more annoying.
data.Thai: พื้นหินฉันจะตรวจไว้ให้ ถ้าซ่อมใหญ่ขึ้นทีหลังจะยิ่งน่ารำคาญ
data.Vietnamese: Nền đá để tôi kiểm tra cho. Nếu sau này việc sửa chữa lớn hơn thì càng phiền.
data.Indonesian: Lantai batunya akan kuperiksa. Kalau perbaikan jadi lebih besar nanti, itu akan lebih merepotkan.

data.Korean: 그럼 내가 직접 확인해서 정정하면 되겠네!
data.English: But something is strange. That monster horde all came down from the forest road.
data.Thai: แต่มันแปลกอยู่นะ ฝูงมอนสเตอร์เมื่อกี้ทั้งหมดลงมาจากทางป่า
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng có gì đó lạ. Đám quái vật vừa rồi đều đi xuống từ đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Tapi ada yang aneh. Gerombolan monster tadi semuanya turun dari jalan hutan.

data.Korean: 잠깐만, 관문 앞에 뭔가 보여.
data.English: When I looked from the watchtower, there was still movement deeper along the forest road.
data.Thai: ตอนมองจากหอเฝ้าระวัง ยังมีการเคลื่อนไหวอยู่ลึกเข้าไปในทางป่า
data.Vietnamese: Khi nhìn từ tháp canh, tôi vẫn thấy chuyển động sâu bên trong đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Saat kulihat dari menara pengawas, masih ada pergerakan lebih dalam di jalan hutan.

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 지나간 자리에 빛나는 게 남아 있어.
data.English: Then we need to check the forest road again.
data.Thai: งั้นต้องกลับไปตรวจฝั่งทางป่าสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy phải kiểm tra lại phía đường rừng rồi.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita harus memeriksa sisi jalan hutan lagi.

data.Korean: 진짜네. 그냥 돌은 아닌 것 같은데?
data.English: Cies is not normally a place where monsters swarm like this.
data.Thai: ปกติซีเอสไม่ใช่ที่ที่มอนสเตอร์จะทะลักเข้ามาแบบนี้
data.Vietnamese: Bình thường Cies không phải nơi quái vật kéo đến đông như vậy.
data.Indonesian: Biasanya Cies bukan tempat yang didatangi monster sebanyak ini.

data.Korean: 잘못 건드리면 더 복잡해질 수 있으니까, 먼저 확인하자...
data.English: They said it was a quiet post, but that rumor was completely wrong.
data.Thai: ได้ยินว่าเป็นจุดประจำการที่เงียบสงบ แต่ข่าวลือนั้นผิดเต็ม ๆ เลย
data.Vietnamese: Nghe nói đây là điểm trực yên tĩnh, nhưng tin đồn đó sai hoàn toàn rồi.
data.Indonesian: Katanya ini pos yang tenang, tapi rumor itu benar-benar salah.

data.Korean: 엘리스, 확인 부탁해도 돼?
data.English: The first person to say that rumor was Serah.
data.Thai: คนที่พูดข่าวลือนั้นคนแรกก็คือเซราห์นี่นา
data.Vietnamese: Người đầu tiên nói tin đồn đó là Serah đấy.
data.Indonesian: Orang pertama yang mengatakan rumor itu adalah Serah.

data.Korean: 응. 위험한 반응은 없어 보여.
data.English: Then I just have to check it myself and correct it!
data.Thai: งั้นฉันไปตรวจเองแล้วแก้ข่าวก็ได้!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy tôi chỉ cần tự mình kiểm tra rồi sửa lại là được!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, aku tinggal memeriksanya sendiri dan meluruskannya!

data.Korean: 신호석이랑 비슷한 반응인데, 조금 달라.
data.English: Wait, I see something in front of the gate.
data.Thai: เดี๋ยวก่อน หน้าประตูมีอะไรบางอย่างให้เห็น
data.Vietnamese: Khoan đã, tôi thấy có gì đó trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Tunggu, aku melihat sesuatu di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 이건 유물이야.
data.English: Something shining was left where the monsters passed.
data.Thai: ตรงที่มอนสเตอร์ผ่านไป มีอะไรบางอย่างส่องแสงเหลืออยู่
data.Vietnamese: Ở chỗ lũ quái vật đi qua có thứ gì đó phát sáng còn sót lại.
data.Indonesian: Ada sesuatu yang bersinar tertinggal di tempat monster lewat.

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 유물 보상 선택]
data.English: You are right. Something is shining!
data.Thai: จริงด้วย มีอะไรบางอย่างกำลังส่องแสงอยู่!
data.Vietnamese: Đúng thật. Có gì đó đang phát sáng!
data.Indonesian: Benar. Ada sesuatu yang bersinar!

data.Korean: 유물 효과는 다음 스테이지에도 유지됩니다. 3개 중 1개를 선택해주세요.
data.English: I do not want to touch it carelessly and make more work...
data.Thai: ไม่อยากแตะมั่ว ๆ แล้วทำให้งานเพิ่มเลย...
data.Vietnamese: Tôi không muốn lỡ chạm vào rồi làm việc tăng thêm đâu...
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak mau sembarangan menyentuhnya lalu menambah pekerjaan...

data.Korean: 그럼 신중하게 골라야겠네.
data.English: Alice, can you check it for me?
data.Thai: อลิซ ช่วยตรวจให้หน่อยได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Alice, cậu kiểm tra giúp được không?
data.Indonesian: Alice, bisa tolong periksa?

data.Korean: 그럼 세라가 앞에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있는 걸 고르자.
data.English: Yes. I checked it, and it does not seem dangerous.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันตรวจดูแล้ว ไม่น่ามีปัญหา
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi kiểm tra rồi, có vẻ không có vấn đề gì.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Sudah kuperiksa, sepertinya tidak ada masalah.

data.Korean: 숲길은 시야가 좁아. 세라가 앞에서 버텨주면 모두 움직이기 편할 거야.
data.English: The reaction is similar to a signal stone's, but a little different.
data.Thai: คล้ายปฏิกิริยาของศิลาสัญญาณ แต่ต่างกันนิดหน่อย
data.Vietnamese: Phản ứng hơi giống đá tín hiệu, nhưng có chút khác.
data.Indonesian: Reaksinya mirip batu sinyal, tapi sedikit berbeda.

data.Korean: 고대 갑옷을 획득했습니다. 이후 스테이지에도 효과가 유지됩니다.
data.English: This is a relic.
data.Thai: นี่คือวัตถุโบราณ
data.Vietnamese: Đây là di vật.
data.Indonesian: Ini relik.

data.Korean: 선택됐어. 이 효과는 다음 전투에도 남아.
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Choose a relic reward]
data.Thai: [ป๊อปอัปสอนเล่น: เลือกรางวัลวัตถุโบราณ]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Chọn phần thưởng Di vật]
data.Indonesian: [Pop-up Tutorial: Pilih hadiah Relik]

data.Korean: 숲길부터 확인해 보자. 노아, 흔적이 이어지는 방향을 봐줘.
data.English: Relic effects carry over to the next stage. Please choose one of the three.
data.Thai: ผลของวัตถุโบราณจะคงอยู่ถึงด่านถัดไป กรุณาเลือก 1 อย่างจาก 3 อย่าง
data.Vietnamese: Hiệu ứng Di vật sẽ được giữ sang màn tiếp theo. Vui lòng chọn 1 trong 3.
data.Indonesian: Efek Relik akan tetap berlaku ke stage berikutnya. Silakan pilih 1 dari 3.

data.Korean: 응. 흔적은 아직 남아 있어. 어디로 이어지는지 확인해 볼게.
data.English: Then we should choose carefully.
data.Thai: งั้นต้องเลือกให้รอบคอบสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy phải chọn cẩn thận rồi.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita harus memilih dengan hati-hati.

data.Korean: 나는 신호석 상태를 다시 볼게. 다음 무리가 오기 전에 맞춰둬야 하니까.
data.English: Then something related to Serah would be good, so she can hold the front longer.
data.Thai: งั้นเลือกของที่เกี่ยวกับเซราห์ เพื่อให้เธอยืนด้านหน้าได้นานขึ้นน่าจะดี
data.Vietnamese: Vậy thứ liên quan đến Serah, giúp cô ấy trụ phía trước lâu hơn, sẽ hợp đấy.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, yang berkaitan dengan Serah agar ia bisa bertahan lebih lama di depan akan bagus.

data.Korean: 좋아! 원인을 찾고, 시에스를 다시 조용하게 만들자!
data.English: The forest road has poor visibility. If Serah holds the front, everyone can move more easily.
data.Thai: ทางป่ามองเห็นได้แคบ ถ้าเซราห์ยืนรับด้านหน้า ทุกคนจะขยับได้ง่ายขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Đường rừng có tầm nhìn hẹp. Nếu Serah giữ phía trước, mọi người sẽ dễ di chuyển hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jalan hutan memiliki jarak pandang sempit. Jika Serah menahan bagian depan, semua orang bisa bergerak lebih mudah.

data.Korean: 그럼... 지금 가야겠네. 멀리까진 안 가도 되겠지...
data.English: Ancient Armor acquired. Its effect will remain in later stages.
data.Thai: ได้รับเกราะโบราณแล้ว ผลของมันจะคงอยู่ในด่านต่อ ๆ ไป
data.Vietnamese: Đã nhận Giáp Cổ Đại. Hiệu ứng sẽ được giữ ở các màn sau.
data.Indonesian: Armor Kuno diperoleh. Efeknya akan tetap berlaku di stage berikutnya.

data.Korean: 안 가도 된다고 해줘...
data.English: Selected. This effect will remain in the next battle too.
data.Thai: เลือกแล้ว ผลนี้จะยังคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งถัดไปด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Đã chọn. Hiệu ứng này cũng sẽ còn trong trận tiếp theo.
data.Indonesian: Terpilih. Efek ini juga akan tetap ada di pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: (관문 앞의 소란은 끝났지만, 숲 쪽의 움직임은 멈추지 않았다.)
data.English: Let us check the forest road first. Noah, follow the traces left by the monsters.
data.Thai: เริ่มจากตรวจทางป่ากันก่อน โนอา ช่วยตามร่องรอยที่มอนสเตอร์ทิ้งไว้
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kiểm tra đường rừng trước. Noah, lần theo dấu vết quái vật để lại.
data.Indonesian: Mari kita periksa jalan hutan dulu. Noah, ikuti jejak yang ditinggalkan monster.

data.Korean: 지휘관님, 수호대 여러분.
data.English: Okay. The traces are still there. I will follow them.
data.Thai: อืม ร่องรอยที่ผ่านไปยังเหลืออยู่ ฉันจะลองตามไปดู
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Dấu vết chúng đi qua vẫn còn. Tôi sẽ lần theo.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Jejak yang mereka tinggalkan masih ada. Aku akan mengikutinya.

data.Korean: 관문 앞 방어 기록은 정리해 두겠습니다.
data.English: I will check the signal stones again. We need to tune them before the next group comes.
data.Thai: ฉันจะตรวจสภาพศิลาสัญญาณอีกครั้ง ต้องปรับให้พร้อมก่อนกลุ่มถัดไปจะมา
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra lại trạng thái đá tín hiệu. Phải chỉnh lại trước khi nhóm tiếp theo đến.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa kondisi batu sinyal lagi. Kita harus menyesuaikannya sebelum gerombolan berikutnya datang.

data.Korean: 고마워, 데미안.
data.English: All right! Let us find the cause and get our quiet post back!
data.Thai: เอาล่ะ! ไปหาสาเหตุ แล้วเอาจุดประจำการที่เงียบสงบของเรากลับคืนมากัน!
data.Vietnamese: Được! Hãy tìm nguyên nhân và lấy lại nơi trực yên tĩnh của chúng ta!
data.Indonesian: Oke! Ayo cari penyebabnya dan dapatkan kembali tempat tugas kita yang tenang!

data.Korean: 우리는 숲길로 나가기 전에 상태를 먼저 확인하자.
data.English: Then let us move now. We will not have to go too far, right...
data.Thai: งั้นตอนนี้ขยับกันเถอะ คงไม่ต้องไปไกลมากหรอก... ใช่ไหม
data.Vietnamese: Vậy giờ di chuyển thôi. Chắc không phải đi xa lắm đâu nhỉ...
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, bergerak sekarang. Kita tidak perlu pergi terlalu jauh, kan...

data.Korean: 응. 다들 크게 다친 곳은 없어 보여.
data.English: Please tell me we do not have to go far...
data.Thai: ช่วยบอกทีว่าไม่ต้องไปไกล...
data.Vietnamese: Làm ơn nói là không phải đi xa đi...
data.Indonesian: Tolong bilang kita tidak perlu pergi jauh...

data.Korean: 크게 다친 사람이 없다는 건 좋은 일이야.
data.English: (The commotion at the gate had ended, but it seemed the movement in the forest had not stopped yet.)
data.Thai: (ความวุ่นวายหน้าประตูจบลงแล้ว แต่ดูเหมือนการเคลื่อนไหวในป่ายังไม่หยุด)
data.Vietnamese: (Sự hỗn loạn trước cổng đã kết thúc, nhưng có vẻ chuyển động trong rừng vẫn chưa dừng lại.)
data.Indonesian: (Keributan di depan gerbang telah berakhir, tetapi sepertinya pergerakan di hutan masih belum berhenti.)

data.Korean: 치료 시간이 길어지면 다 같이 힘드니까...
data.English: Let's start checking from here. We won't go too far from the gate.
data.Thai: เริ่มตรวจจากตรงนี้กันเถอะ เราจะไม่ออกห่างจากประตูมากเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Hãy bắt đầu kiểm tra từ đây. Chúng ta sẽ không đi quá xa khỏi cổng.
data.Indonesian: Kita mulai pemeriksaan dari sini. Kita tidak akan terlalu jauh dari gerbang.

data.Korean: 누군지는 몰라도, 한 명은 특히 힘들 것 같긴 하네.
data.English: Yeah. There are footprints here.
data.Thai: อืม มีรอยเท้าเหลืออยู่ตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Ở đây còn dấu chân.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Ada jejak kaki tertinggal di sini.

data.Korean: 그래도 다들 무사하니까 됐지!
data.English: If we look a little more, I think we can tell which way they go.
data.Thai: ถ้าดูต่ออีกหน่อย น่าจะรู้ได้ว่ามุ่งไปทางไหน
data.Vietnamese: Nếu nhìn kỹ thêm một chút, chắc sẽ biết chúng đi theo hướng nào.
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita lihat sedikit lagi, sepertinya kita bisa tahu arahnya.

data.Korean: 다음도 이 기세로 막으면 돼!
data.English: Got it. Then let's check carefully.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว งั้นค่อย ๆ ตรวจดูกันเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Vậy cứ kiểm tra từ từ nhé.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Kalau begitu, kita periksa pelan-pelan.

data.Korean: 기세만으로 가기 전에, 신호석부터 확인하자.
data.English: All right. Let's start with the traces.
data.Thai: ดี เริ่มจากร่องรอยก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Được. Bắt đầu từ dấu vết trước.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Mulai dari jejaknya dulu.

data.Korean: 첫 전투 기록을 봤어.
data.English: We can figure out where they came down toward the gate.
data.Thai: เราจะได้รู้ว่าพวกมันลงมาจากตรงไหนไปทางประตู
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta có thể biết chúng từ đâu đi xuống phía cổng.
data.Indonesian: Kita bisa memastikan dari mana mereka turun menuju gerbang.

data.Korean: 지휘관이 보낸 신호가 아직 안정적으로 남아 있어.
data.English: I'll mark the way back.
data.Thai: ฉันจะทำเครื่องหมายทางกลับไว้ให้
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ đánh dấu đường quay lại.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan menandai jalan kembali.

data.Korean: 그걸 다음 전투에도 이어갈 수 있어?
data.English: If we get lost here, our break time disappears too...
data.Thai: ถ้าหลงทางตรงนี้ เวลาพักก็จะหายไปด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu lạc đường ở đây thì cả thời gian nghỉ cũng biến mất...
data.Indonesian: Kalau tersesat di sini, waktu istirahat juga ikut hilang...

data.Korean: 가능해.
data.English: That would definitely be a big problem!
data.Thai: นั่นเป็นเรื่องใหญ่แน่นอน!
data.Vietnamese: Chuyện đó đúng là nghiêm trọng đấy!
data.Indonesian: Itu jelas masalah besar!

data.Korean: 지금 조율하면, 한 명의 전투 방식이 더 안정될 거야.
data.English: Getting lost on the way back is the bigger problem.
data.Thai: หลงทางกลับต่างหากที่เป็นเรื่องใหญ่กว่า
data.Vietnamese: Lạc mất đường quay lại mới là chuyện nghiêm trọng hơn.
data.Indonesian: Yang lebih gawat itu kehilangan jalan kembali.

data.Korean: 숲길로 나가기 전에 준비할 수 있다면 좋겠어.
data.English: Both are important...
data.Thai: ทั้งสองอย่างก็สำคัญนี่นา...
data.Vietnamese: Cả hai đều quan trọng mà...
data.Indonesian: Dua-duanya penting...

data.Korean: 그럼 다음 전투에 맞춰서 고르면 되겠네!
data.English: Maybe because this is a forest road, the air feels damp.
data.Thai: เพราะเป็นทางป่าหรือเปล่านะ อากาศเลยชื้นจัง
data.Vietnamese: Chắc vì là đường rừng nên không khí ẩm thật.
data.Indonesian: Mungkin karena ini jalan hutan, udaranya lembap.

data.Korean: 나중에 일이 덜 커지는 쪽이면 나도 찬성이야...
data.English: The dirt path is soft, and the sunlight is blocked...
data.Thai: ทางดินก็นุ่ม แดดก็ถูกบังไว้อย่างดี...
data.Vietnamese: Đường đất thì mềm, ánh nắng cũng bị che khá kỹ...
data.Indonesian: Jalan tanahnya empuk, dan sinar matahari juga terhalang...

data.Korean: 지휘관, 조율 방향을 골라줘.
data.English: If your next words are about being sleepy, please hold them in for a bit.
data.Thai: ถ้าจะต่อด้วยเรื่องง่วง ก็ช่วยอดทนอีกหน่อยนะ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu câu tiếp theo là buồn ngủ thì chịu khó nhịn một chút nhé.
data.Indonesian: Kalau setelah ini kau mau bilang mengantuk, tahan dulu sebentar.

data.Korean: [이벤트 강화: 세라 체력 증가 / 노아 공격력 증가 / 스파인 회복량 증가 중 1개 선택]
data.English: I hadn't said that yet...
data.Thai: ฉันยังไม่ได้พูดเลย...
data.Vietnamese: Tôi còn chưa nói mà...
data.Indonesian: Aku belum bilang begitu...

data.Korean: [선택한 강화가 이후 전투에도 유지됨을 표시한다]
data.English: Right. And you just said"yet."
data.Thai: อืม แล้วเมื่อกี้เธอก็พูดว่า “ยัง” แล้วไง
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Và cậu vừa nói “chưa” rồi đấy.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Dan barusan kau bilang “belum.”

data.Korean: 조율됐어.
data.English: Wait. The grass by the road is pressed down in one direction.
data.Thai: เดี๋ยวก่อน พงหญ้าริมทางถูกกดไปทางเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Chờ chút. Bụi cỏ ven đường bị ép về cùng một hướng.
data.Indonesian: Tunggu. Rumput di tepi jalan tertekan ke satu arah.

data.Korean: 이번 강화는 다음 전투부터도 유지될 거야.
data.English: Which way does it lead?
data.Thai: ร่องรอยต่อไปทางไหน?
data.Vietnamese: Nó kéo dài về phía nào?
data.Indonesian: Jejaknya berlanjut ke arah mana?

data.Korean: 좋아! 그럼 앞에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있겠네!
data.English: The monster traces lead from deeper in the forest toward the gate.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของมอนสเตอร์ต่อจากด้านในป่ามาทางประตู
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết quái vật nối từ sâu trong rừng về phía cổng.
data.Indonesian: Jejak monster berlanjut dari dalam hutan menuju gerbang.

data.Korean: 나도 주변을 더 꼼꼼히 살펴볼게.
data.English: There seem to have been quite a few of them. The footprints overlap all over.
data.Thai: น่าจะมีจำนวนไม่น้อยเลย รอยเท้าทับซ้อนกันเต็มไปหมด
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ số lượng khá nhiều. Dấu chân chồng lên nhau khắp nơi.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya jumlahnya cukup banyak. Jejak kaki saling bertumpuk di mana-mana.

data.Korean: 그럼 준비는 끝난 거네.
data.English: Ngh...!
data.Indonesian: Hah...!

data.Korean: 더 늦기 전에 가는 게 낫겠지...
data.English: Noah?
data.Thai: โนอา?
data.Vietnamese: Noah?
data.Indonesian: Noah?

data.Korean: 숲길 쪽 움직임은 아직 남아 있습니다.
data.English: Sorry. I was just a little startled.
data.Thai: ขอโทษ แค่ตกใจนิดหน่อย
data.Vietnamese: Xin lỗi. Tôi chỉ hơi giật mình thôi.
data.Indonesian: Maaf. Aku hanya sedikit terkejut.

data.Korean: 관문에서 멀리 나가실 경우, 조심해 주십시오.
data.English: That sound came from the direction the footprints lead.
data.Thai: เสียงเมื่อกี้ก็มาจากทางที่รอยเท้าพวกนั้นทอดไป
data.Vietnamese: Âm thanh vừa rồi cũng phát ra từ hướng dấu chân kéo dài tới.
data.Indonesian: Suara barusan juga datang dari arah yang sama dengan jejak kaki itu.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 관문에서 너무 멀어지진 않을게.
data.English: Got it. If something comes from there, I'll stop it.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ถ้ามีอะไรออกมาจากทางนั้น ฉันจะกันไว้เอง
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Nếu có gì xuất hiện từ hướng đó, tôi sẽ chặn lại.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Kalau ada sesuatu keluar dari arah itu, aku akan menahannya.

data.Korean: 다들 준비됐지?
data.English: Serah, don't go too far ahead.
data.Thai: เซราห์ อย่าออกไปข้างหน้ามากเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Serah, đừng tiến lên quá xa.
data.Indonesian: Serah, jangan terlalu maju.

data.Korean: 응! 언제든 나갈 수 있어.
data.English: Move where Noah can still keep track.
data.Thai: ขยับในระยะที่โนอายังยืนยันตำแหน่งได้
data.Vietnamese: Hãy di chuyển trong khoảng Noah còn có thể quan sát được.
data.Indonesian: Bergeraklah dalam jarak yang masih bisa Noah awasi.

data.Korean: 숲길 쪽 움직임은 아직 남아 있어. 조심해서 가자.
data.English: Got it. I won't go too far.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ฉันจะไม่ออกไปไกลเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Tôi sẽ không đi quá xa.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Aku tidak akan pergi terlalu jauh.

data.Korean: 좋아. 관문에서 가까운 곳부터 차근차근 보자.
data.English: Yeah... as I thought, these traces don't look like they were aiming for the gate.
data.Thai: อืม... อย่างที่คิด ร่องรอยนี้ไม่เหมือนว่าพวกมันตั้งใจโจมตีประตู
data.Vietnamese: Ừ... đúng như tôi nghĩ, đây không giống dấu vết nhắm thẳng vào cổng.
data.Indonesian: Ya... seperti dugaanku, jejak ini bukan tanda mereka bergerak untuk menyerang gerbang.

data.Korean: 돌아오는 데 오래 걸리는 길만 아니면 좋겠네...
data.English: There are a lot of skid marks. Almost no signs that they stopped.
data.Thai: มีรอยลื่นอยู่เยอะ แทบไม่มีร่องรอยว่าพวกมันหยุดเลย
data.Vietnamese: Có nhiều vết trượt. Gần như không có dấu vết chúng dừng lại.
data.Indonesian: Ada banyak bekas tergelincir. Hampir tidak ada tanda mereka berhenti.

data.Korean: 여기서부터 확인하자. 관문에서 너무 멀어지진 않을 거야.
data.English: It looks like the monsters came fleeing down from deeper in the forest.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนมอนสเตอร์จะหนีลงมาจากด้านในป่า
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ lũ quái vật đã chạy trốn từ sâu trong rừng xuống đây.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya para monster melarikan diri turun dari dalam hutan.

data.Korean: 응. 관문 앞에서 봤던 흔적이 여기까지 이어져 있어.
data.English: Then does that mean something deeper in the forest is chasing them?
data.Thai: งั้นมีอะไรไล่พวกมันมาจากในป่าเหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nghĩa là có thứ gì đó đang đuổi theo từ trong rừng sao?
data.Indonesian: Berarti ada sesuatu yang mengejar mereka dari dalam hutan?

data.Korean: 조금 더 보면 어디서 내려왔는지 알 수 있을 것 같아.
data.English: I don't know yet. But they didn't choose this direction on their own.
data.Thai: ยังไม่รู้ แต่ดูไม่เหมือนพวกมันเลือกทางเอง
data.Vietnamese: Tôi chưa biết. Nhưng đây không phải chuyển động do chúng tự chọn hướng.
data.Indonesian: Aku belum tahu. Tapi kelihatannya bukan arah yang mereka pilih sendiri.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 위험한 게 나오면 내가 앞에서 막을게.
data.English: So they weren't aiming for the gate.
data.Thai: งั้นก็ไม่ได้มุ่งมาที่ประตูสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy không phải chúng nhắm vào cổng.
data.Indonesian: Jadi mereka tidak mengincar gerbang.

data.Korean: 좋아. 우선 흔적부터 보자.
data.English: It looks more like they were running away from something.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนหนีลงมาเพื่อหลบอะไรบางอย่างมากกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ giống chúng đang chạy trốn thứ gì đó hơn.
data.Indonesian: Kelihatannya lebih seperti mereka turun untuk menghindari sesuatu.

data.Korean: 어디서 관문 쪽으로 내려왔는지부터 확인하자.
data.English: Commander, I hear monster footsteps getting closer from deeper in the forest.
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ เสียงฝีเท้าของมอนสเตอร์จากในป่าใกล้เข้ามาแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, tiếng bước chân quái vật từ sâu trong rừng đang đến gần.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, suara langkah monster dari dalam hutan semakin dekat.

data.Korean: 그럼 여기부터 표식을 남겨둘게.
data.English: It's the same direction as the traces we saw.
data.Thai: ทิศทางเดียวกับร่องรอยที่เราดูเมื่อกี้
data.Vietnamese: Cùng hướng với dấu vết chúng ta đã thấy.
data.Indonesian: Arahnya sama dengan jejak yang baru kita lihat.

data.Korean: 여기서 길 잃으면 쉬는 시간도 같이 사라지니까...
data.English: If we fall back now, they may come all the way to the gate.
data.Thai: ถ้าถอยตอนนี้ พวกมันอาจลงไปถึงหน้าประตู
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bây giờ rút lui, chúng có thể xuống tận trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita mundur sekarang, mereka mungkin turun sampai ke depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 그건 확실히 큰일이네!
data.English: Then we'll stop them here.
data.Thai: ถ้างั้น เราจะหยุดพวกมันตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chặn chúng ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita tahan mereka di sini.

data.Korean: 돌아가는 길을 잃는 게 더 큰일이야.
data.English: Confirmed! I'll take the front.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว! ข้างหน้าให้ฉันจัดการเอง
data.Vietnamese: Đã rõ! Phía trước cứ để tôi lo.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti! Bagian depan akan kujaga.

data.Korean: 둘 다 중요하잖아...
data.English: All right. I'll clear out the side where they gather.
data.Thai: ดี ทางที่พวกมันรวมตัวกัน ฉันจะจัดการเอง
data.Vietnamese: Được. Phía tụ lại cứ để tôi xử lý.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Yang bergerombol akan kutangani.

data.Korean: 숲길이라 그런가, 공기가 축축하네.
data.English: Ugh... fighting on a road like this isn't exactly ideal.
data.Thai: อืม... สู้บนทางแบบนี้ไม่ค่อยสะดวกเลย
data.Vietnamese: Ư... chiến đấu trên con đường thế này không thích lắm.
data.Indonesian: Ugh... bertarung di jalan seperti ini kurang nyaman.

data.Korean: 흙길은 푹신하고, 햇빛도 잘 가려졌고...
data.English: Still, it's better than letting them push all the way to the gate...
data.Thai: แต่ก็ยังดีกว่าถูกดันกลับไปถึงหน้าประตู...
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng vẫn tốt hơn là để chúng đẩy tới trước cổng...
data.Indonesian: Tapi masih lebih baik daripada terdorong sampai depan gerbang...

data.Korean: 다음 말이 졸리다는 이야기면, 조금만 참아줘.
data.English: Is everyone okay?
data.Thai: ทุกคนไม่เป็นไรใช่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Mọi người ổn chứ?
data.Indonesian: Semua baik-baik saja?

data.Korean: 아직 안 했는데...
data.English: If anything hurts, tell me right away.
data.Thai: ถ้าเจ็บตรงไหน รีบบอกทันทีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu đau ở đâu thì nói ngay nhé.
data.Indonesian: Kalau ada yang sakit, langsung bilang.

data.Korean: 응. 그리고 방금 "아직"이라고 했잖아.
data.English: If you stay quiet and endure it, it will hurt more...
data.Thai: ถ้าไม่พูดแล้วฝืนไว้ พวกเธอก็จะเจ็บกว่าเดิม...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu im lặng chịu đựng thì sẽ càng đau hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau diam saja dan menahannya, nanti makin sakit...

data.Korean: 잠깐만. 길가 풀숲이 한 방향으로 눌려 있어.
data.English: And that means more work for me...
data.Thai: แล้วงานของฉันก็จะเพิ่มด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Và việc của tôi cũng sẽ tăng lên...
data.Indonesian: Dan pekerjaanku juga bertambah...

data.Korean: 어느 쪽으로 이어져 있어?
data.English: I'm fine! I'm not hurt!
data.Thai: ฉันไม่เป็นไร! ไม่มีตรงไหนบาดเจ็บ!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi ổn! Không bị thương ở đâu cả!
data.Indonesian: Aku baik-baik saja! Aku tidak terluka!

data.Korean: 발자국이 숲 안쪽에서 관문 쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: Noah, if you see more movement, tell me right away.
data.Thai: โนอา ถ้าเห็นการเคลื่อนไหวอีก รีบบอกทันทีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Noah, nếu thấy chuyển động nữa thì báo ngay nhé.
data.Indonesian: Noah, kalau kau melihat pergerakan lagi, segera beri tahu.

data.Korean: 수가 꽤 많았던 것 같아. 발자국이 여기저기 겹쳐 있어.
data.English: I'll stop them at the front again.
data.Thai: ครั้งนี้ฉันก็จะหยุดพวกมันไว้ข้างหน้าเอง
data.Vietnamese: Lần này tôi cũng sẽ chặn ở phía trước.
data.Indonesian: Kali ini juga aku akan menahan mereka dari depan.

data.English: Okay. I won't miss it either.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันจะไม่พลาดเหมือนกัน
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi cũng sẽ không bỏ sót đâu.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Aku juga tidak akan melewatkannya.

data.Korean: 노아?
data.English: I'm fine too. Spayne?
data.Thai: ฉันก็ไม่เป็นไร สไปน์ล่ะ?
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cũng ổn. Spayne thì sao?
data.Indonesian: Aku juga baik-baik saja. Spayne?

data.Korean: 미안. 그냥 조금 놀랐어.
data.English: Yeah, me too. The forest road was just a little uncomfortable...
data.Thai: อืม ฉันก็เหมือนกัน แค่ทางป่ามันเดินลำบากนิดหน่อย...
data.Vietnamese: Ừ, tôi cũng vậy. Chỉ là đường rừng hơi khó chịu một chút...
data.Indonesian: Ya, aku juga. Jalan hutannya cuma agak tidak nyaman...

data.Korean: 방금 소리도 같은 쪽에서 났어.
data.English: That's a relief. Let's talk after we get back.
data.Thai: ดีแล้ว รายละเอียดค่อยคุยกันหลังกลับไป
data.Vietnamese: May quá. Chuyện chi tiết để về rồi nói.
data.Indonesian: Syukurlah. Kita bicarakan detailnya setelah kembali.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 그쪽에서 움직이면 내가 막을게.
data.English: Getting out safely comes first right now.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้ต้องออกไปอย่างปลอดภัยก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Bây giờ ra khỏi đây an toàn là ưu tiên trước.
data.Indonesian: Sekarang yang utama adalah keluar dengan aman.

data.Korean: 세라, 너무 앞서가진 마.
data.English: I'm glad everyone is okay.
data.Thai: ดีแล้วที่ทุกคนไม่เป็นไร
data.Vietnamese: Thật may là mọi người đều ổn.
data.Indonesian: Syukurlah semua baik-baik saja.

data.Korean: 노아가 확인할 수 있는 거리 안에 있어.
data.English: Let's not go any deeper for now.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้อย่าเพิ่งเข้าไปลึกกว่านี้
data.Vietnamese: Bây giờ đừng đi sâu hơn nữa.
data.Indonesian: Untuk sekarang, jangan masuk lebih dalam.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 너무 멀리 가진 않을게.
data.English: First, let's head back toward the gate and sort things out.
data.Thai: ก่อนอื่นกลับไปทางประตู แล้วค่อยจัดข้อมูลให้เรียบร้อย
data.Vietnamese: Trước hết hãy quay về phía cổng rồi sắp xếp lại thông tin.
data.Indonesian: Kita kembali ke gerbang dulu, lalu rapikan informasi.

data.Korean: 응... 역시, 관문을 노리고 움직인 흔적은 아닌 것 같아.
data.English: Yeah. That sounds good.
data.Thai: อืม แบบนั้นดีกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Như vậy tốt hơn.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Itu lebih baik.

data.Korean: 미끄러진 자국이 많아. 멈춰 선 자국은 거의 없어.
data.English: Got it. Spayne, can you still see the marks for the way back?
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว สไปน์ เครื่องหมายทางกลับยังเห็นอยู่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Spayne, cậu còn thấy dấu đường quay lại không?
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Spayne, tanda jalan kembali masih terlihat?

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 숲 안쪽에서 도망쳐 내려온 것 같아.
data.English: Yeah. I can see the cloth I marked, and our footprints are still there too.
data.Thai: อืม ผ้าที่ทำเครื่องหมายไว้ยังเห็นอยู่ แล้วรอยเท้าของเราก็ยังเหลืออยู่
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi thấy mảnh vải đã đánh dấu, và dấu chân chúng ta đi qua vẫn còn.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Kain yang kutandai terlihat, dan jejak kaki kita juga masih ada.

data.Korean: 그럼 숲 안쪽에서 뭔가 쫓아오고 있다는 뜻이야?
data.English: Wait. Monster footprints that turn off from the forest path in front of the gate are mixed in here.
data.Thai: เดี๋ยวก่อน มีรอยเท้ามอนสเตอร์ที่แยกออกจากทางป่าหน้าประตูปนอยู่
data.Vietnamese: Chờ chút. Có dấu chân quái vật rẽ ra từ con đường rừng trước cổng lẫn vào đây.
data.Indonesian: Tunggu. Ada jejak kaki monster yang berbelok dari jalan hutan di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 아직은 몰라. 하지만 원해서 이쪽으로 온 것 같진 않아.
data.English: Ugh... I was only trying to check the way back.
data.Thai: อืม... ฉันแค่จะดูทางกลับเท่านั้นเอง
data.Vietnamese: Ư... tôi chỉ định xem đường quay lại thôi mà.
data.Indonesian: Ugh... aku hanya mau melihat jalan kembali.

data.Korean: 관문을 노린 움직임은 아니네.
data.English: Still, thanks to that, we found traces that leave the forest path in front of the gate.
data.Thai: แต่เพราะแบบนั้น เราเลยเจอร่องรอยที่แยกออกจากทางป่าหน้าประตู
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng nhờ vậy, chúng ta tìm được dấu vết rời khỏi con đường rừng trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Tapi berkat itu, kita menemukan jejak yang keluar dari jalan hutan di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 뭔가를 피해 내려온 걸로 보는 게 맞겠어.
data.English: Where do they lead?
data.Thai: มุ่งไปทางไหน?
data.Vietnamese: Nó dẫn tới đâu?
data.Indonesian: Ke mana arahnya?

data.Korean: 지휘관, 숲 안쪽에서 몬스터 발소리가 가까워지고 있어.
data.English: Toward the entrance road leading south of the gate.
data.Thai: ไปทางทางเข้าที่แยกไปทางใต้ของประตู
data.Vietnamese: Về phía lối vào rẽ xuống phía nam cổng.
data.Indonesian: Ke arah jalan masuk yang menuju selatan gerbang.

data.Korean: 발자국이 이어진 쪽에서 그대로 내려오고 있어.
data.English: They look similar to the traces we saw on the forest road.
data.Thai: คล้ายกับร่องรอยที่เราเห็นบนทางป่าเมื่อกี้
data.Vietnamese: Nó giống dấu vết chúng ta vừa thấy trên đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Mirip dengan jejak yang kita lihat di jalan hutan tadi.

data.Korean: 지금 물러나면 관문 앞까지 내려올지도 몰라.
data.English: So monsters passed through that way too.
data.Thai: แปลว่ามอนสเตอร์ผ่านไปทางนั้นด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Vậy là quái vật cũng đã đi qua hướng đó.
data.Indonesian: Berarti monster juga lewat ke arah itu.

data.Korean: 좋아. 관문 앞까지 내려오기 전에 여기서 막자.
data.English: The southern entrance road...
data.Thai: ทางเข้าด้านใต้เหรอ...
data.Vietnamese: Lối vào phía nam à...
data.Indonesian: Jalan masuk selatan...

data.Korean: 확인했어! 내가 먼저 막을게.
data.English: All right. Let's return to the gate first.
data.Thai: ดี ก่อนอื่นกลับไปที่ประตูกันเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Được. Trước hết hãy quay lại cổng.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Pertama, kita kembali ke gerbang.

data.Korean: 좋아. 몰리는 쪽은 내가 정리할게.
data.English: Once we're done reorganizing, we'll check that way.
data.Thai: พอเตรียมตัวกันใหม่เสร็จแล้ว ค่อยตรวจทางนั้น
data.Vietnamese: Khi chuẩn bị lại xong, chúng ta sẽ kiểm tra hướng đó.
data.Indonesian: Setelah selesai bersiap ulang, kita periksa arah itu.

data.Korean: 으... 이런 길에서 싸우는 건 별로인데.
data.English: Is this the southern entrance road?
data.Thai: นี่คือทางเข้าด้านใต้ใช่ไหม
data.Vietnamese: Đây là lối vào phía nam à?
data.Indonesian: Ini jalan masuk selatan?

data.Korean: 관문 앞까지 밀리는 것보단 낫겠지...
data.English: The location is right.
data.Thai: ตำแหน่งถูกต้องแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Đúng vị trí rồi.
data.Indonesian: Lokasinya benar.

data.Korean: 다들 괜찮아?
data.English: The road is narrow. It does not look like a route for a large force.
data.Thai: ทางแคบนะ ไม่น่าใช่ทางที่กองกำลังใหญ่ใช้ผ่าน
data.Vietnamese: Đường hẹp thật. Không giống lối để đội quân lớn đi qua.
data.Indonesian: Jalannya sempit. Sepertinya bukan jalan untuk pasukan besar.

data.Korean: 아픈 곳 있으면 바로 말해줘.
data.English: But the footprints continue this far.
data.Thai: แต่รอยเท้ายังต่อมาถึงตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng dấu chân kéo dài tới tận đây.
data.Indonesian: Tapi jejak kakinya berlanjut sampai sini.

data.Korean: 말 안 하고 버티면 더 아파지고...
data.English: These are the monster footprints that branched off from the forest path in front of the gate.
data.Thai: นี่คือรอยเท้ามอนสเตอร์ที่แยกมาจากทางป่าหน้าประตู
data.Vietnamese: Đúng là dấu chân quái vật rẽ ra từ con đường rừng trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Ini jejak kaki monster yang berbelok dari jalan hutan di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 나도 일이 늘어나니까...
data.English: The depth and direction of the footprints are similar to what we saw on the forest path.
data.Thai: ความลึกกับทิศทางของรอยเท้าก็คล้ายกับที่เห็นบนทางป่า
data.Vietnamese: Độ lún và hướng dấu chân cũng giống những gì ta thấy trên đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Kedalaman dan arah jejaknya juga mirip dengan yang kita lihat di jalan hutan.

data.Korean: 난 괜찮아! 다친 데는 없어!
data.English: If the road is narrow, it should be easier for me to stop them up front.
data.Thai: ถ้าทางแคบ ฉันก็น่าจะกันไว้ด้านหน้าได้ง่ายขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Nếu đường hẹp, tôi sẽ dễ chặn chúng ở phía trước hơn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau jalannya sempit, aku lebih mudah menahan mereka di depan.

data.Korean: 노아가 알려준 쪽으로 막으니까 확실히 편했어.
data.English: That is not the only thing to consider.
data.Thai: มันไม่ได้มีแต่ข้อดีหรอก
data.Vietnamese: Không phải chỉ có điểm tốt đâu.
data.Indonesian: Itu bukan berarti semuanya menguntungkan.

data.Korean: 다음에도 부탁할게.
data.English: If our view opens up late, our reaction will be late too.
data.Thai: ถ้ามองเห็นช้า การตอบสนองก็จะช้าตามไปด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu tầm nhìn mở ra chậm, phản ứng cũng sẽ chậm theo.
data.Indonesian: Kalau pandangan terbuka terlambat, reaksi kita juga terlambat.

data.Korean: 응. 나도 놓치지 않을게.
data.English: Just looking at the ground makes it look hard to walk on...
data.Thai: แค่เห็นพื้นก็รู้สึกเดินลำบากแล้ว...
data.Vietnamese: Nhìn mặt đất thôi cũng thấy khó đi rồi...
data.Indonesian: Dari melihat tanahnya saja, kelihatannya sulit dilewati...

data.Korean: 나도 괜찮아. 스파인은?
data.English: It will not be easy to move injured people here.
data.Thai: ถ้าต้องย้ายคนเจ็บ ก็คงไม่ง่าย
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển người bị thương ở đây chắc cũng không dễ.
data.Indonesian: Membawa orang terluka di sini juga tidak akan mudah.

data.Korean: 응, 나도. 숲길이 좀 불편했을 뿐이야...
data.English: Then I just have to stop them before anyone gets hurt!
data.Thai: งั้นยิ่งต้องกันไว้ก่อนที่จะมีใครบาดเจ็บ!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy càng phải chặn chúng trước khi có ai bị thương!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita harus menghentikan mereka sebelum ada yang terluka!

data.Korean: 다행이야. 이야기는 돌아가서 하자.
data.English: That is true, but do not move too far ahead.
data.Thai: พูดถูกก็จริง แต่อย่าออกไปข้างหน้ามากเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Nói thì đúng, nhưng đừng tiến quá xa.
data.Indonesian: Itu benar, tapi jangan maju terlalu jauh.

data.Korean: 지금은 안전하게 빠져나가는 게 먼저야.
data.English: Got it. I will take only the area I can see.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ฉันจะรับผิดชอบแค่ตรงที่มองเห็น
data.Vietnamese: Tôi hiểu. Tôi sẽ giữ phần mình nhìn thấy.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Aku akan menjaga area yang bisa kulihat saja.

data.Korean: 다들 괜찮아서 다행이야.
data.English: This road should lead toward the gate wall too, right?
data.Thai: ทางนี้ก็น่าจะต่อไปทางกำแพงประตูใช่ไหม
data.Vietnamese: Con đường này cũng dẫn về phía tường cổng đúng không?
data.Indonesian: Jalan ini juga mengarah ke dinding gerbang, kan?

data.Korean: 더 안쪽은 나중에 확인하고, 일단 관문 쪽으로 돌아가자.
data.English: Yes. If it follows this direction, it should lead toward the front of the gate.
data.Thai: อืม ถ้าไปตามทิศนี้ก็น่าจะต่อไปด้านหน้าประตู
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Theo hướng này thì nó sẽ dẫn tới phía trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Dengan arah ini, seharusnya menuju bagian depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 응. 그게 좋겠어.
data.English: Let us not go too deep into this road.
data.Thai: อย่าเข้าไปลึกในทางนี้มากนัก
data.Vietnamese: Đừng đi quá sâu vào con đường này.
data.Indonesian: Jangan masuk terlalu dalam ke jalan ini.

data.Korean: 스파인, 아까 남겨둔 표식은 아직 보여?
data.English: We will check the entrance. If it is dangerous, we will stop them here.
data.Thai: ตรวจแค่ปากทางก่อน ถ้าอันตรายก็กันไว้ตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Kiểm tra lối vào trước. Nếu nguy hiểm, ta chặn chúng ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Kita periksa pintu masuknya. Kalau berbahaya, kita hentikan mereka di sini.

data.Korean: 응. 표시해 둔 천도 보이고, 우리가 지나온 발자국도 남아 있어.
data.English: The monster footprints are clearer now.
data.Thai: รอยเท้ามอนสเตอร์ชัดขึ้นแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân quái vật rõ hơn rồi.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki monsternya makin jelas.

data.Korean: 지휘관님, 추가 보고가 있습니다.
data.English: They are pressed deeper than the ones we saw on the forest path in front of the gate.
data.Thai: กดลึกกว่าที่เห็นบนทางป่าหน้าประตู
data.Vietnamese: Chúng lún sâu hơn dấu chân ở con đường rừng trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Jejaknya lebih dalam daripada yang kita lihat di jalan hutan depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 남쪽 진입로를 확인하러 나갔던 정찰병이 돌아왔습니다.
data.English: It looks like they could not slow down here.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนตรงนี้พวกมันจะลดความเร็วไม่ได้
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ ở đây chúng không kịp giảm tốc.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya mereka tidak sempat melambat di sini.

data.Korean: 그쪽에서도 비슷한 발자국이 발견됐다고 합니다.
data.English: If they came rushing down like that, we have no choice but to stop them from the front.
data.Thai: ถ้าถูกไล่ลงมาแบบนั้น ก็คงต้องหยุดไว้จากด้านหน้า
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chúng bị dồn xuống như vậy, ta chỉ còn cách chặn từ phía trước.
data.Indonesian: Kalau mereka terdorong turun seperti itu, kita harus menghentikan mereka dari depan.

data.Korean: 발자국뿐이라 단정하긴 어렵지만, 확인이 필요해 보입니다.
data.English: Yes. There are a lot of overlapping footprints.
data.Thai: อืม มีรอยเท้าซ้อนกันเยอะ
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Có rất nhiều dấu chân chồng lên nhau.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Banyak jejak kaki yang saling tumpang tindih.

data.Korean: 그러면 숲길만의 문제는 아니란 거네.
data.English: They are not lined up in one direction. Some are twisted off to the side.
data.Thai: ไม่ได้เรียงไปทางเดียวกัน มีรอยที่บิดออกด้านข้างด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Không phải chúng xếp theo một hướng. Có cả dấu vết lệch sang bên.
data.Indonesian: Mereka tidak tersusun ke satu arah. Ada juga jejak yang menyimpang ke samping.

data.Korean: 응. 우리가 본 발자국이랑 이어진 흔적일 수도 있어.
data.English: These do not look like traces of monsters marching down to attack.
data.Thai: ไม่เหมือนร่องรอยของพวกที่จัดแถวลงมาโจมตี
data.Vietnamese: Không giống dấu vết của đội hình tiến xuống để tấn công.
data.Indonesian: Ini bukan jejak monster yang berbaris turun untuk menyerang.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 그 내용까지 정리해 두자.
data.English: So this is not just happening on the forest path in front of the gate. It reaches this road too.
data.Thai: งั้นก็ไม่ใช่แค่ทางป่าหน้าประตูแล้ว มันลามมาถึงทางนี้ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Vậy không chỉ con đường rừng trước cổng. Chuyện này còn kéo tới cả lối này.
data.Indonesian: Jadi masalahnya bukan hanya di jalan hutan depan gerbang. Jejaknya sampai ke jalan ini juga.

data.Korean: 준비가 끝나면 남쪽 진입로를 확인하러 가자.
data.English: If we get pushed back on a road like this, falling down and stopping them both sound like trouble...
data.Thai: ถ้าถูกดันถอยในทางแบบนี้ ทั้งฝ่ายที่ล้มกับฝ่ายที่กันไว้ก็คงวุ่นวายหมด...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị đẩy lùi trên con đường kiểu này, cả người ngã lẫn người chặn đều sẽ phiền phức...
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita terdorong mundur di jalan seperti ini, yang jatuh maupun yang menahan akan sama-sama repot...

data.Korean: 여기가 정찰병이 말한 남쪽 진입로야?
data.English: Then we just stop them before they fall, right?
data.Thai: งั้นก็หยุดพวกมันก่อนจะล้มก็ได้นี่?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy thì chặn chúng trước khi ngã là được mà?
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, hentikan mereka sebelum jatuh, kan?

data.Korean: 위치는 맞아. 관문 남쪽 아래로 붙은 길이네.
data.English: It is scarier when you say it like it is that easy...
data.Thai: พูดเหมือนง่ายแบบนั้นแล้วน่ากลัวกว่าเดิมอีก...
data.Vietnamese: Cậu nói như thể dễ lắm, nên nghe còn đáng sợ hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kamu mengatakannya seolah itu mudah, jadi malah lebih menakutkan...

data.Korean: 정찰병이 말한 발자국도 보여.
data.English: Wait. There is movement inside the bushes.
data.Thai: เดี๋ยวก่อน มีความเคลื่อนไหวในพุ่มไม้ข้างใน
data.Vietnamese: Chờ đã. Có chuyển động bên trong bụi cây.
data.Indonesian: Tunggu. Ada gerakan di dalam semak.

data.Korean: 깊이랑 간격이 숲길에서 봤던 흔적이랑 비슷해.
data.English: There is movement where the footprints continue.
data.Thai: มีความเคลื่อนไหวตรงทางที่รอยเท้าต่อไป
data.Vietnamese: Có chuyển động ở phía dấu chân kéo dài tới.
data.Indonesian: Ada gerakan di arah jejak kaki itu berlanjut.

data.Korean: 숲길에서 내려온 흐름이 남쪽 진입로 쪽으로도 갈라진 거네.
data.English: Which direction are they coming from?
data.Thai: มาจากทางไหน
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đến từ hướng nào?
data.Indonesian: Mereka datang dari arah mana?

data.Korean: 이 길은 다친 사람 옮기기엔 별로 좋아 보이지 않는데...
data.English: From deeper inside the southern entrance road.
data.Thai: ข้างในทางเข้าด้านใต้
data.Vietnamese: Từ sâu trong lối vào phía nam.
data.Indonesian: Dari dalam jalan masuk selatan.

data.Korean: 더 들어가면 대응하기도 어려워질 거야.
data.English: It is the same direction as the footprints we saw.
data.Thai: เป็นทิศเดียวกับรอยเท้าที่เราเห็น
data.Vietnamese: Cùng hướng với dấu chân chúng ta đã thấy.
data.Indonesian: Arahnya sama dengan jejak kaki yang kita lihat.

data.Korean: 깊이 들어가진 말자.
data.English: Looks like this is going to get bigger...
data.Thai: เหมือนเรื่องจะใหญ่ขึ้นแล้ว...
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ chuyện sẽ lớn hơn rồi...
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya masalahnya akan makin besar...

data.Korean: 입구를 확인하고, 위험하면 이 자리에서 막자.
data.English: If we get pushed back, it leads straight to the gate.
data.Thai: ถ้าถูกดันถอย ก็จะต่อถึงประตูทันที
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị đẩy lùi, đường này sẽ nối thẳng tới cổng.
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita terdorong mundur, jalan ini langsung menuju gerbang.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 앞쪽은 내가 볼게.
data.English: Then we will stop them here.
data.Thai: งั้นก็หยุดไว้ตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chặn chúng ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita hentikan mereka di sini.

data.Korean: 발자국이 여기서 더 깊어졌어.
data.English: Commander, I think they are about to come out.
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ ดูเหมือนพวกมันจะออกมาแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, có vẻ chúng sắp ra rồi.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, sepertinya mereka akan keluar.

data.Korean: 숲길에서 봤던 것보다 훨씬 눌려 있어.
data.English: The road is narrow, so I do not think many can come down at once.
data.Thai: ทางแคบ เลยไม่น่าจะลงมาพร้อมกันได้มาก
data.Vietnamese: Đường hẹp nên chắc chúng không thể xuống quá nhiều cùng lúc.
data.Indonesian: Jalannya sempit, jadi sepertinya tidak banyak yang bisa turun sekaligus.

data.Korean: 주변을 살필 여유도 없이 급하게 내려온 것 같아.
data.English: If Serah stops them up front, I can land my magic too.
data.Thai: ถ้าเซราห์กันไว้ด้านหน้า เวทของฉันก็จะเล็งได้
data.Vietnamese: Nếu Serah chặn phía trước, tôi cũng có thể nhắm phép chính xác.
data.Indonesian: Kalau Serah menahan mereka di depan, aku juga bisa mengenai mereka dengan sihirku.

data.Korean: 그럼 관문까지 가기 전에 막아야겠네.
data.English: Good. We will stop them here.
data.Thai: ดี กันไว้ตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Ta chặn chúng ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Kita hentikan mereka di sini.

data.Korean: 응. 발자국이 겹친 자리가 많아.
data.English: Understood. I will stop them from the front.
data.Thai: รับทราบ ฉันจะหยุดไว้จากด้านหน้า
data.Vietnamese: Rõ. Tôi sẽ chặn chúng từ phía trước.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Aku akan menghentikan mereka dari depan.

data.Korean: 한 방향으로 정리된 게 아니라, 옆으로 비틀린 흔적도 있어.
data.English: I will trust you with the rest.
data.Thai: ด้านหลังฝากไว้ด้วยนะ
data.Vietnamese: Phía sau tôi tin mọi người lo được.
data.Indonesian: Aku percaya kalian menjaga belakangku.

data.Korean: 그러면 이쪽도 그냥 스쳐 지나간 정도는 아니겠네.
data.English: Okay. Just hold where I can see you.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว แค่อยู่ในจุดที่ฉันมองเห็นก็พอ
data.Vietnamese: Được. Nhưng hãy trụ ở nơi tôi nhìn thấy được.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Tapi bertahanlah di tempat yang bisa kulihat.

data.Korean: 이런 길에서 밀리면 다친 사람 옮기기도 힘들겠는데...
data.English: Of course. I will not go too deep.
data.Thai: แน่นอน ฉันจะไม่เข้าไปลึกเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Tất nhiên. Tôi sẽ không vào quá sâu.
data.Indonesian: Tentu. Aku tidak akan masuk terlalu dalam.

data.Korean: 그럼 밀리기 전에 막으면 되잖아?
data.English: Please choose the way where everyone gets hurt less...
data.Thai: ขอทางที่บาดเจ็บกันน้อยที่สุดนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Làm ơn chọn cách ít bị thương hơn nhé...
data.Indonesian: Tolong pilih cara yang membuat kita tidak terlalu terluka...

data.Korean: 말은 쉬운데...
data.English: If someone falls here, getting them up looks hard too.
data.Thai: ถ้าล้มตรงนี้ จะพยุงขึ้นมาก็ดูลำบาก
data.Vietnamese: Nếu ngã ở đây thì dựng dậy cũng có vẻ vất vả.
data.Indonesian: Kalau ada yang jatuh di sini, membangunkannya juga terlihat sulit.

data.Korean: 잠깐만. 풀숲 안쪽에서 움직임이 있어.
data.English: I will keep watching their movement from here.
data.Thai: ฉันจะคอยดูความเคลื่อนไหวจากตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ tiếp tục quan sát chuyển động từ đây.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan terus mengawasi gerakan mereka dari sini.

data.Korean: 어느 쪽에서 오고 있어?
data.English: Serah, if you go too deep, I will tell you right away.
data.Thai: เซราห์ ถ้าเข้าไปลึกเกินไป ฉันจะบอกทันที
data.Vietnamese: Serah, nếu cậu vào quá sâu, tôi sẽ nói ngay.
data.Indonesian: Serah, kalau kamu masuk terlalu dalam, aku akan langsung bilang.

data.Korean: 남쪽 진입로 안쪽이야.
data.English: Got it. If Noah says it, I will adjust right away.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ถ้าโนอาบอก ฉันจะปรับตามทันที
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Noah nói thì tôi sẽ điều chỉnh ngay.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Kalau Noah bilang, aku akan langsung menyesuaikan.

data.Korean: 숲길에서 봤던 것처럼, 안쪽에서 밀려 내려오고 있어.
data.English: Is everyone okay?
data.Thai: ทุกคนไม่เป็นไรนะ
data.Vietnamese: Mọi người ổn chứ?
data.Indonesian: Semuanya baik-baik saja?

data.Korean: 일이 더 커질 것 같은데...
data.English: Is anyone hurt?
data.Thai: มีใครบาดเจ็บไหม
data.Vietnamese: Có ai bị thương không?
data.Indonesian: Ada yang terluka?

data.Korean: 여기서 밀리면 바로 관문 쪽으로 이어져.
data.English: I am okay! I am not hurt!
data.Thai: ฉันไม่เป็นไร! ไม่มีตรงไหนบาดเจ็บ!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi ổn! Không bị thương chỗ nào!
data.Indonesian: Aku baik-baik saja! Tidak ada yang terluka!

data.Korean: 그럼 앞쪽은 내가 맡을게.
data.English: The narrow road was not as bad as I thought.
data.Thai: ทางแคบก็ไม่ได้แย่อย่างที่คิด
data.Vietnamese: Đường hẹp cũng không tệ như tôi nghĩ.
data.Indonesian: Jalan sempit ini tidak seburuk yang kupikir.

data.Korean: 지휘관, 곧 보일 것 같아.
data.English: I am okay too.
data.Thai: ฉันก็ไม่เป็นไร
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cũng ổn.
data.Indonesian: Aku juga baik-baik saja.

data.Korean: 길을 따라 그대로 내려오고 있어. 앞쪽을 막으면 돼.
data.English: You know that was pretty close, right?
data.Thai: เมื่อกี้ค่อนข้างเฉียดฉิว รู้ตัวใช่ไหม
data.Vietnamese: Cậu biết vừa rồi khá sát nút đấy chứ?
data.Indonesian: Kamu tahu tadi cukup nyaris, kan?

data.Korean: 좋아. 이 자리에서 막자.
data.English: It was close, but I still stopped them, did I not?
data.Thai: ถึงจะเฉียดฉิว แต่ก็กันไว้ได้ใช่ไหม
data.Vietnamese: Dù sát nút nhưng tôi vẫn chặn được mà?
data.Indonesian: Memang nyaris, tapi aku tetap menghentikan mereka, kan?

data.Korean: 세라가 앞을 잡아주면, 내가 몰리는 쪽을 정리할게.
data.English: True... but next time, be a little more careful.
data.Thai: ก็ใช่... แต่ครั้งหน้าระวังกว่านี้หน่อย
data.Vietnamese: Đúng là vậy... nhưng lần sau cẩn thận hơn nhé.
data.Indonesian: Memang benar... tapi lain kali lebih hati-hati.

data.Korean: 뒤는 믿고 맡길게.
data.English: Yeah, me too... The road was just uncomfortable.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันก็เหมือนกัน... แค่ทางมันเดินลำบาก
data.Vietnamese: Ừ, tôi cũng vậy... Chỉ là đường khó chịu thôi.
data.Indonesian: Ya, aku juga... Jalannya saja yang tidak nyaman.

data.Korean: 덜 다치는 방향으로 부탁할게...
data.English: I do not want to stay in a place like this for long.
data.Thai: ไม่อยากอยู่นานในที่แบบนี้เลย
data.Vietnamese: Tôi không muốn ở lâu trong chỗ như thế này.
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak ingin lama-lama di tempat seperti ini.

data.Korean: 내가 계속 볼게. 너무 앞서면 바로 알려줄게.
data.English: I will check the monster footprints again.
data.Thai: ฉันจะดูรอยเท้ามอนสเตอร์อีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ xem lại dấu chân quái vật.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa jejak kaki monster lagi.

data.Korean: 다들 괜찮아?
data.English: Yes. Check whether they connect toward the gate wall.
data.Thai: อืม ตรวจดูว่ามันต่อไปทางกำแพงประตูไหม
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Kiểm tra xem chúng có nối tới phía tường cổng không.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Periksa apakah jejaknya terhubung ke arah dinding gerbang.

data.Korean: 다친 데는 없어?
data.English: They do.
data.Thai: ต่ออยู่
data.Vietnamese: Có nối.
data.Indonesian: Terhubung.

data.Korean: 난 괜찮아! 다친 데는 없어!
data.English: The traces from the forest path in front of the gate and the southern entrance road turn in the same direction.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยจากทางป่าหน้าประตู กับร่องรอยจากทางเข้าด้านใต้หักไปทางเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết từ con đường rừng trước cổng và lối vào phía nam đều rẽ theo cùng một hướng.
data.Indonesian: Jejak dari jalan hutan depan gerbang dan jalan masuk selatan berbelok ke arah yang sama.

data.Korean: 좁은 길에서 막는 것도 생각보다 나쁘진 않았어.
data.English: Then both roads meet in front of the gate.
data.Thai: งั้นทั้งสองทางก็มาบรรจบกันที่หน้าประตู
data.Vietnamese: Vậy cả hai con đường đều hợp lại trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Berarti kedua jalan itu bertemu di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 나도 괜찮아.
data.English: And there is still movement deeper inside.
data.Thai: แล้วข้างในยังมีความเคลื่อนไหวเหลืออยู่
data.Vietnamese: Và bên trong vẫn còn chuyển động.
data.Indonesian: Dan masih ada gerakan di bagian dalam.

data.Korean: 방금 꽤 아슬아슬했던 건 알고 있지?
data.English: It may continue toward the gate.
data.Thai: อาจจะต่อไปทางประตูอีก
data.Vietnamese: Có thể chúng còn kéo tới phía cổng.
data.Indonesian: Mungkin masih berlanjut ke arah gerbang.

data.Korean: 그래도 관문 쪽으로는 안 보냈잖아?
data.English: Then next time, I will check the direction Noah is watching first.
data.Thai: งั้นครั้งหน้า ฉันจะดูทิศที่โนอามองก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Vậy lần sau tôi sẽ kiểm tra hướng Noah đang nhìn trước.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, lain kali aku akan memeriksa arah yang dilihat Noah dulu.

data.Korean: 그건 맞는데... 다음엔 조금만 더 조심해줘.
data.English: Yeah. I will make sure I do not miss it.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันจะดูไม่ให้พลาด
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi sẽ chú ý để không bỏ sót.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Aku akan memastikan tidak melewatkannya.

data.Korean: 응, 나도... 다친 사람 안 나온 게 제일 다행이네.
data.English: It is good that we are getting more in sync...
data.Thai: ดีที่เริ่มประสานงานกันได้ดีขึ้น...
data.Vietnamese: Chuyện phối hợp ăn ý hơn là tốt...
data.Indonesian: Bagus kalau kerja sama kita makin selaras...

data.Korean: 이런 곳에 오래 있고 싶진 않아.
data.English: So why does it feel like we have more work every time...
data.Thai: แต่ทำไมยิ่งทำ ยิ่งรู้สึกว่างานเพิ่มขึ้นนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng sao càng lúc tôi càng có cảm giác việc nhiều thêm vậy...
data.Indonesian: Tapi kenapa rasanya pekerjaan kita malah makin bertambah...

data.Korean: 잠깐만. 발자국이 아직 끊기지 않았어.
data.English: We have checked the monster traces on the southern entrance road enough.
data.Thai: เราตรวจร่องรอยมอนสเตอร์ที่ทางเข้าด้านใต้พอแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Ta đã kiểm tra đủ dấu vết quái vật ở lối vào phía nam rồi.
data.Indonesian: Kita sudah cukup memeriksa jejak monster di jalan masuk selatan.

data.Korean: 남쪽 진입로의 발자국도 관문 방어벽 쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: Next, let us check the area in front of the gate wall.
data.Thai: ต่อไปตรวจสภาพหน้ากำแพงประตูกัน
data.Vietnamese: Tiếp theo, hãy kiểm tra khu vực trước tường cổng.
data.Indonesian: Selanjutnya, periksa area di depan dinding gerbang.

data.Korean: 그럼 두 길에서 내려온 흔적이 관문 방어벽 앞에서 합쳐지는 거네.
data.English: Commander, Guardians.
data.Thai: ท่านผู้บัญชาการ และทุกท่านจากหน่วยพิทักษ์ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Thưa ngài Chỉ huy, các thành viên Đội Hộ vệ.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, para Guardian.

data.Korean: 응. 그 앞도 확인해 봐야 해.
data.English: I will organize the defense records from the gate front.
data.Thai: ผมจะจัดการบันทึกการป้องกันหน้าประตูไว้ให้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ tổng hợp lại ghi chép phòng thủ trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Saya akan merapikan catatan pertahanan di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 좋아. 다음엔 노아가 확인한 쪽부터 움직이자.
data.English: Thanks, Demian.
data.Thai: ขอบคุณนะ เดเมียน
data.Vietnamese: Cảm ơn, Demian.
data.Indonesian: Terima kasih, Demian.

data.Korean: 응. 발자국이 이어지는 곳은 계속 볼게.
data.English: Before we head to the forest path, let us check our condition first.
data.Thai: ก่อนออกไปทางป่า เรามาตรวจสภาพกันก่อนเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Trước khi ra đường rừng, chúng ta kiểm tra tình trạng trước đã.
data.Indonesian: Sebelum menuju jalan hutan, kita periksa kondisi dulu.

data.Korean: 손발이 맞아가는 건 좋은데...
data.English: Yeah. It does not look like anyone is badly hurt.
data.Thai: อืม ดูเหมือนไม่มีใครบาดเจ็บหนักนะ
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Có vẻ không ai bị thương nặng.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Sepertinya tidak ada yang terluka parah.

data.Korean: 왜 그럴수록 쉬는 시간은 멀어지는 걸까...
data.English: No one being badly hurt is a good thing.
data.Thai: ไม่มีใครบาดเจ็บหนักก็ถือว่าเป็นเรื่องดี
data.Vietnamese: Không có ai bị thương nặng là chuyện tốt.
data.Indonesian: Tidak ada yang terluka parah itu hal yang baik.

data.Korean: 남쪽 진입로는 여기까지 확인하자.
data.English: It also means I have less work to do...
data.Thai: แปลว่างานของฉันลดลงด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Cũng có nghĩa là việc của tôi bớt đi...
data.Indonesian: Itu juga berarti pekerjaanku berkurang...

data.Korean: 관문 방어벽 앞으로 돌아가서 상태를 보자.
data.English: That started like a nice comment and ended up being about you.
data.Thai: เริ่มเหมือนคำพูดดี ๆ แต่สุดท้ายก็จบที่เรื่องของตัวเองสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Mở đầu nghe như lời tốt đẹp, cuối cùng lại thành chuyện của cậu nhỉ.
data.Indonesian: Awalnya terdengar seperti ucapan baik, tapi akhirnya tentang dirimu sendiri.

data.Korean: 수호대 여러분, 무사하십니까?
data.English: Still, everyone is safe, so that is what matters!
data.Thai: แต่ทุกคนปลอดภัยก็พอแล้วนี่!
data.Vietnamese: Dù sao mọi người đều an toàn là được rồi!
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, semua selamat, jadi tidak apa-apa!

data.Korean: 응. 남쪽 진입로도 확인했어.
data.English: We can stop the next one with this momentum too!
data.Thai: ครั้งต่อไปก็กันไว้ด้วยจังหวะแบบนี้ก็ได้!
data.Vietnamese: Lần tới cứ chặn với khí thế này là được!
data.Indonesian: Berikutnya juga tinggal kita tahan dengan semangat ini!

data.Korean: 남쪽 진입로 쪽 흔적이 여기서 숲길 쪽 흔적이랑 만났어.
data.English: Before we rely on momentum, let us check the signal stones.
data.Thai: ก่อนจะพึ่งแค่กำลังใจ ไปตรวจศิลาสัญญาณกันก่อนเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Trước khi chỉ dựa vào khí thế, kiểm tra đá tín hiệu đã.
data.Indonesian: Sebelum hanya mengandalkan semangat, periksa batu sinyal dulu.

data.Korean: 예. 방어벽 앞에 흔적이 몰려 있습니다.
data.English: I looked at the first battle records.
data.Thai: ฉันดูบันทึกการต่อสู้ครั้งแรกแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Tôi đã xem ghi chép trận đầu.
data.Indonesian: Aku sudah melihat catatan pertempuran pertama.

data.Korean: 여기서도 같은 흔적이 보여?
data.English: The signal the Commander sent is still holding steady.
data.Thai: สัญญาณที่ผู้บัญชาการส่งไปยังคงเสถียรอยู่
data.Vietnamese: Tín hiệu Chỉ huy gửi vẫn còn ổn định.
data.Indonesian: Sinyal yang dikirim Komandan masih tersisa dengan stabil.

data.Korean: 응. 멈춰 선 흔적보다 미끄러진 흔적이 더 많아.
data.English: Can we carry that into the next battle?
data.Thai: เราต่อสัญญาณนั้นไปใช้ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไปได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Có thể nối nó sang trận tiếp theo không?
data.Indonesian: Bisa kita lanjutkan ke pertempuran berikutnya?

data.Korean: 방어벽 앞까지 밀려 내려온 흔적이 쌓인 거네.
data.English: We can.
data.Thai: ได้
data.Vietnamese: Có thể.
data.Indonesian: Bisa.

data.Korean: 그럼 여기서 밀리면 바로 관문이네...
data.English: If we tune it now, one person's combat style will become more stable.
data.Thai: ถ้าปรับตอนนี้ รูปแบบการต่อสู้ของคนหนึ่งจะเสถียรขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Nếu điều chỉnh bây giờ, cách chiến đấu của một người sẽ ổn định hơn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau diselaraskan sekarang, gaya bertarung satu orang akan lebih stabil.

data.Korean: 그럼 앞은 내가 맡을게.
data.English: If we can prepare before heading to the forest path, that would help.
data.Thai: ถ้าเตรียมตัวก่อนออกไปทางป่าได้ก็ดีเลย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chuẩn bị được trước khi ra đường rừng thì tốt.
data.Indonesian: Akan bagus kalau kita bisa bersiap sebelum menuju jalan hutan.

data.Korean: 이번엔 관문이 바로 뒤야. 너무 앞으로 나가진 마.
data.English: Then strengthening whoever can hold the front longer sounds good!
data.Thai: งั้นเสริมคนที่ยืนแนวหน้าได้นานขึ้นก็ดีเหมือนกัน!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy tăng cường cho người có thể trụ lâu hơn phía trước cũng được đấy!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, memperkuat yang bisa bertahan lebih lama di depan juga bagus!

data.Korean: 알겠어. 보이는 거리 안에서 막을게.
data.English: If it means fewer people get hurt, I am in favor too...
data.Thai: ถ้าช่วยให้คนบาดเจ็บน้อยลง ฉันก็เห็นด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu giúp giảm người bị thương thì tôi cũng tán thành...
data.Indonesian: Kalau itu berarti lebih sedikit yang terluka, aku juga setuju...

data.Korean: 숲 쪽에서 움직임이 가까워지고 있어.
data.English: Commander, choose the tuning direction.
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ เลือกทิศทางการปรับสัญญาณที
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, chọn hướng điều chỉnh đi.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, pilih arah penyelarasannya.

data.Korean: 관문 앞 숲길 쪽이랑 남쪽 진입로 쪽에서 동시에 내려와.
data.English: [Event Enhancement: Choose one from Serah HP increase / Noah attack increase / Spayne healing increase]
data.Thai: [เสริมพลังอีเวนต์: เลือก 1 อย่างจาก เพิ่มพลังชีวิตเซราห์ / เพิ่มพลังโจมตีโนอา / เพิ่มปริมาณฟื้นฟูของสเปย์น]
data.Vietnamese: [Cường hóa sự kiện: Chọn 1 trong tăng HP Serah / tăng tấn công Noah / tăng lượng hồi phục Spayne]
data.Indonesian: [Peningkatan event: Pilih 1 dari peningkatan HP Serah / peningkatan serangan Noah / peningkatan jumlah pemulihan Spayne]

data.Korean: 병사들은 방어벽 뒤로 물리겠습니다.
data.English: [Display that the selected enhancement will remain active in later battles]
data.Thai: [แสดงว่าการเสริมพลังที่เลือกจะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ถัดไปด้วย]
data.Vietnamese: [Hiển thị rằng cường hóa đã chọn sẽ được duy trì trong các trận sau]
data.Indonesian: [Tampilkan bahwa peningkatan yang dipilih akan tetap aktif di pertempuran berikutnya]

data.Korean: 여러분께서 막아 주시는 동안, 저희는 방어벽 상태를 확인하겠습니다.
data.English: Tuned.
data.Thai: ปรับเสร็จแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Đã điều chỉnh xong.
data.Indonesian: Sudah diselaraskan.

data.Korean: 좋아. 여기서 관문을 지키자.
data.English: This enhancement will remain active from the next battle onward.
data.Thai: การเสริมพลังครั้งนี้จะคงอยู่ตั้งแต่การต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไปด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Cường hóa lần này sẽ được duy trì từ trận tiếp theo trở đi.
data.Indonesian: Peningkatan kali ini akan tetap aktif mulai pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 관문 앞은 못 지나가게 할게.
data.English: Good! Then I can stand in front with more confidence.
