data.Thai: ดีเลย! งั้นฉันก็ยืนแนวหน้าได้อย่างมั่นใจขึ้นแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Tốt! Vậy mình có thể tin tưởng hơn khi đứng phía trước rồi.
data.Indonesian: Bagus! Kalau begitu aku bisa lebih percaya diri berdiri di depan.

data.Korean: 다치면 바로 말해줘. 숨기면 더 힘들어져...
data.English: I will keep a closer watch on the forest path movement too.
data.Thai: ฉันก็จะจับตาดูความเคลื่อนไหวทางป่าให้ชัดขึ้นเหมือนกัน
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cũng sẽ quan sát rõ hơn chuyển động phía đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Aku juga akan mengawasi pergerakan di jalan hutan dengan lebih jelas.

data.Korean: 다친 사람은 없어?
data.English: Then let us check it quickly and come back.
data.Thai: งั้นรีบไปดูแล้วกลับมากันเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chúng ta xem nhanh rồi quay lại thôi.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, cepat kita lihat lalu kembali.

data.Korean: 난 괜찮아! 관문 앞도 막아냈고.
data.English: If we take too long, our rest time disappears too...
data.Thai: ถ้าช้าเกินไป เวลาพักก็จะหายไปด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chậm quá, thời gian nghỉ cũng biến mất luôn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau terlalu lama, waktu istirahat juga ikut hilang...

data.Korean: 그래도 방어벽 상태는 확인해야 해.
data.English: There is still movement near the forest path.
data.Thai: ยังมีความเคลื่อนไหวทางป่าอยู่ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Vẫn còn chuyển động phía đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Masih ada pergerakan di arah jalan hutan.

data.Korean: 겉으로 멀쩡해 보여도 안쪽은 다를 수 있으니까...
data.English: Please be careful if you go far from the gate.
data.Thai: หากออกไปไกลจากประตูด่าน โปรดระวังด้วยครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu các vị đi xa khỏi cổng, xin hãy cẩn thận.
data.Indonesian: Jika kalian pergi jauh dari gerbang, harap berhati-hati.

data.Korean: 데미안, 방어벽 상태는 어때?
data.English: Got it. We will not go too far from the gate.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว เราจะไม่ออกห่างจากประตูด่านมากเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Biết rồi. Chúng ta sẽ không đi quá xa khỏi cổng.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Kami tidak akan terlalu jauh dari gerbang.

data.Korean: 버티고는 있지만, 충격이 꽤 쌓였습니다.
data.English: Everyone ready?
data.Thai: ทุกคนพร้อมแล้วใช่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Mọi người sẵn sàng rồi chứ?
data.Indonesian: Semuanya sudah siap?

data.Korean: 이 상태로 바로 다음 무리까지 막긴 어렵습니다.
data.English: Yeah! If the road gets narrow, I will take the front.
data.Thai: อืม! ถ้าทางแคบลง ฉันจะไปยืนข้างหน้าเอง
data.Vietnamese: Ừ! Nếu đường hẹp lại, tôi sẽ đứng phía trước.
data.Indonesian: Ya! Kalau jalannya menyempit, aku akan berdiri di depan.

data.Korean: 보강이 필요하겠네.
data.English: I will look for traces.
data.Thai: ฉันจะดูร่องรอยให้
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ xem xét dấu vết.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa jejaknya.

data.Korean: 예. 짧게라도 손보는 편이 안전합니다.
data.English: We need to confirm whether the monsters targeted the gate or fled down here.
data.Thai: ต้องดูให้แน่ใจว่าสัตว์ประหลาดเล็งประตูด่าน หรือหนีลงมาทางนี้กันแน่
data.Vietnamese: Cần xác nhận xem quái vật nhắm vào cổng, hay chạy trốn xuống đây.
data.Indonesian: Kita harus memastikan apakah monster menargetkan gerbang, atau melarikan diri ke sini.

data.Korean: 숲 쪽 움직임은 아직 남아 있어.
data.English: I will mark the way back too.
data.Thai: ฉันจะทำเครื่องหมายทางกลับไว้ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cũng sẽ đánh dấu đường quay về.
data.Indonesian: Aku juga akan menandai jalan pulang.

data.Korean: 아까보다 무거운 발소리도 섞여 있어.
data.English: If we get lost, we will have to camp out... and I do not want that.
data.Thai: ถ้าหลงทางก็ต้องตั้งค่ายค้างคืน... แบบนั้นไม่เอา
data.Vietnamese: Nếu lạc đường thì phải cắm trại qua đêm... Tôi không thích chuyện đó.
data.Indonesian: Kalau tersesat, kita harus berkemah... aku tidak mau itu.

data.Korean: 그러면 방어벽을 먼저 손보고, 그쪽 움직임을 다시 확인하자.
data.English: Guardians, are you unharmed?
data.Thai: ทุกท่านจากหน่วยพิทักษ์ ปลอดภัยดีหรือไม่ครับ?
data.Vietnamese: Các thành viên Đội Hộ vệ, mọi người vẫn an toàn chứ?
data.Indonesian: Para Guardian, apakah kalian baik-baik saja?

data.Korean: 정비 시간이 있으면 잠깐 눈을...
data.English: Yeah. We checked the southern entrance too.
data.Thai: อืม เราตรวจทางเข้าด้านใต้แล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Chúng tôi cũng đã kiểm tra lối vào phía nam.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Kami juga sudah memeriksa jalur masuk selatan.

data.Korean: 정비 시간에 잠자는 건 포함 안 돼.
data.English: The forest path in front of the gate, and the southern entrance too.
data.Thai: ทั้งทางป่าหน้าประตูด่าน และทางเข้าด้านใต้
data.Vietnamese: Cả đường rừng trước cổng, lẫn lối vào phía nam.
data.Indonesian: Jalan hutan di depan gerbang, dan jalur masuk selatan juga.

data.Korean: 아직 말 끝까지 안 했는데...
data.English: The footprints all end up leading this way.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าสุดท้ายก็เชื่อมมาทางนี้
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân cuối cùng đều nối về phía này.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kakinya akhirnya tersambung ke arah sini.

data.Korean: ...아니, 거의 맞긴 했지만.
data.English: So they ended up converging here.
data.Thai: แปลว่าสุดท้ายพวกมันมารวมกันที่นี่สินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy cuối cùng chúng tụ lại ở đây nhỉ.
data.Indonesian: Jadi akhirnya mereka berkumpul di sini.

data.Korean: 좋아. 관문 방어벽부터 손보자.
data.English: Yes. We can see the same traces in front of the wall.
data.Thai: ครับ ด้านหน้ากำแพงป้องกันก็มีร่องรอยแบบเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Vâng. Trước tường phòng thủ cũng thấy dấu vết tương tự.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Di depan dinding pertahanan juga terlihat jejak yang sama.

data.Korean: 노아와 엘리스는 숲 쪽 움직임을 계속 확인해줘.
data.English: The footprints from both roads overlap around here.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าจากทั้งสองทางซ้อนกันแถวนี้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân từ cả hai đường chồng lên nhau quanh khu vực này.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki dari kedua jalan bertumpuk di sekitar sini.

data.Korean: 세라와 스파인은 병사들과 함께 정비할 곳을 확인해줘.
data.English: Did the first group we stopped at the gate come from the same direction?
data.Thai: กลุ่มแรกที่เราหยุดไว้หน้าประตูด่านก็มาจากทิศเดียวกันเหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Nhóm đầu tiên chúng ta chặn trước cổng cũng đến từ cùng hướng sao?
data.Indonesian: Gerombolan pertama yang kita tahan di depan gerbang juga datang dari arah yang sama?

data.Korean: 응. 숲 쪽은 계속 보고 있을게.
data.English: Yeah. I think that is the right way to read it.
data.Thai: อืม น่าจะมองแบบนั้นได้
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi nghĩ hiểu như vậy là đúng.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Sepertinya begitu cara membacanya.

data.Korean: 좋아. 다음 전투 전까지 준비해 둘게!
data.English: There are more sliding marks than signs that they tried to stop.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยลื่นไถลมีมากกว่าร่องรอยที่พยายามหยุด
data.Vietnamese: Dấu trượt nhiều hơn dấu vết cho thấy chúng cố dừng lại.
data.Indonesian: Jejak tergelincir lebih banyak daripada jejak mencoba berhenti.

data.Korean: 좋아. 이번엔 사람도 방어벽도 덜 다치는 쪽으로 가자...
data.English: So they were not aiming for the gate. They kept getting driven down here.
data.Thai: แปลว่าไม่ได้เล็งประตูด่าน แต่ถูกไล่ต้อนลงมาตลอดสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chúng không nhắm vào cổng, mà liên tục bị đẩy xuống đây.
data.Indonesian: Jadi mereka bukan mengincar gerbang, tapi terus terdorong turun ke sini.

data.Korean: 데미안, 여기 금이 많이 간 것 같아.
data.English: Then if we get pushed back here, the gate is right behind us...
data.Thai: งั้นถ้าเราถูกดันถอยจากตรงนี้ ข้างหลังก็เป็นประตูด่านเลยนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nếu bị đẩy lùi ở đây, ngay sau lưng là cổng...
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita terdorong mundur di sini, gerbang tepat di belakang kita...

data.Korean: 예. 바로 보강하겠습니다.
data.English: We will be lucky if repairs are all we need.
data.Thai: ถ้าจบแค่ซ่อมแซมได้ก็คงโชคดีแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chỉ dừng ở việc sửa chữa thì còn may.
data.Indonesian: Kalau berakhir hanya dengan perbaikan, itu sudah beruntung.

data.Korean: 지금 손봐두는 게 낫겠네... 더 벌어지면 사람도 방어벽도 같이 챙겨야 하니까.
data.English: Then we just have to hold our ground.
data.Thai: งั้นก็แค่ไม่ถอยก็พอ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chỉ cần không bị đẩy lùi là được.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita hanya perlu tidak terdorong mundur.

data.Korean: 완전히 고치긴 어렵지만, 다음 전투를 버틸 정도는 만들 수 있습니다.
data.English: I will handle the front of the gate!
data.Thai: หน้าประตูด่านฉันรับเอง!
data.Vietnamese: Trước cổng cứ để tôi lo!
data.Indonesian: Bagian depan gerbang serahkan padaku!

data.Korean: 그 정도면 충분해. 지금은 무너지지 않게 버티게 만드는 게 우선이야.
data.English: The way you make that sound easy makes it scarier...
data.Thai: พูดเหมือนง่ายแบบนั้น ยิ่งน่ากลัวเข้าไปอีก...
data.Vietnamese: Cậu nói như dễ lắm nên lại càng đáng sợ...
data.Indonesian: Caramu membuatnya terdengar mudah justru lebih menakutkan...

data.Korean: 좋아. 약한 곳부터 보강하자!
data.English: Still, she is not wrong. This time, the gate is right behind us.
data.Thai: ถึงอย่างนั้นก็ไม่ได้ผิดนะ ครั้งนี้ประตูด่านอยู่ข้างหลังเราทันที
data.Vietnamese: Dù vậy cũng không sai. Lần này cổng ở ngay sau lưng chúng ta.
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, itu tidak salah. Kali ini gerbang tepat di belakang kita.

data.Korean: 그래. 나중에 고칠 곳이 줄어드는 쪽으로 가자...
data.English: If you move too far forward, we cannot support you.
data.Thai: ถ้าเธอออกไปข้างหน้ามากเกินไป การสนับสนุนจะขาดช่วง
data.Vietnamese: Nếu tiến quá xa, hỗ trợ sẽ bị cắt đứt.
data.Indonesian: Kalau kamu maju terlalu jauh, dukungan akan terputus.

data.Korean: [관문 방어벽 보강 완료. 성벽 체력이 회복되었습니다.]
data.English: Got it. I will hold them where you can see me.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ฉันจะกันไว้ในระยะที่พวกเธอมองเห็น
data.Vietnamese: Biết rồi. Tôi sẽ chặn trong tầm mọi người nhìn thấy.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Aku akan menahan mereka dalam jarak yang terlihat.

data.Korean: 방어벽 보강은 끝났어.
data.English: The movement deeper in the forest is getting closer.
data.Thai: ความเคลื่อนไหวด้านในป่ากำลังใกล้เข้ามา
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động bên trong rừng đang đến gần.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakan di dalam hutan semakin mendekat.

data.Korean: 신호석 반응도 아직 한 번 더 맞출 수 있어.
data.English: They are coming down from both the forest path in front of the gate and the southern entrance.
data.Thai: พวกมันลงมาพร้อมกันทั้งจากทางป่าหน้าประตูด่าน และทางเข้าด้านใต้
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang xuống cùng lúc từ đường rừng trước cổng và lối vào phía nam.
data.Indonesian: Mereka turun bersamaan dari jalan hutan depan gerbang dan jalur masuk selatan.

data.Korean: 한 번 정하면 이후 전투에도 이어질 강화야. 여기서 신중하게 정하자.
data.English: I will pull the soldiers back behind the wall.
data.Thai: ผมจะให้ทหารล่าถอยไปหลังกำแพงป้องกันครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ cho binh lính lùi ra sau tường phòng thủ.
data.Indonesian: Saya akan menarik para prajurit ke belakang dinding pertahanan.

data.Korean: 좋아. 마지막으로 조율하자.
data.English: While you hold them off, we will check the wall's condition.
data.Thai: ระหว่างที่ทุกท่านช่วยสกัดไว้ พวกเราจะตรวจสภาพกำแพงป้องกันครับ
data.Vietnamese: Trong lúc các vị chặn chúng, chúng tôi sẽ kiểm tra tình trạng tường phòng thủ.
data.Indonesian: Selama kalian menahan mereka, kami akan memeriksa kondisi dinding pertahanan.

data.Korean: 오래 걸리면 안 돼. 숲 쪽 움직임이 가까워지고 있어.
data.English: Good. We will defend the gate here.
data.Thai: ดี เราป้องกันประตูด่านตรงนี้กัน
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Chúng ta giữ cổng ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Kita pertahankan gerbang di sini.

data.Korean: 그럼 더더욱 후회 안 하는 쪽으로 골라야겠네...
data.English: Defending is fine... but if you get hurt, tell me right away.
data.Thai: ป้องกันน่ะดีอยู่หรอก... แต่ถ้าบาดเจ็บก็บอกทันทีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Giữ cổng thì tốt... nhưng nếu bị thương hãy nói ngay.
data.Indonesian: Mempertahankan itu bagus... tapi kalau terluka, langsung beri tahu.

data.Korean: [캐릭터 영구 강화 후보 표시]
data.English: The more you hide it here, the bigger the problem will get.
data.Thai: ถ้าปิดบังไว้ตรงนี้ เรื่องน่าจะยิ่งบานปลาย
data.Vietnamese: Ở đây càng giấu thì chuyện sẽ càng lớn.
data.Indonesian: Di sini, semakin disembunyikan, masalahnya akan semakin besar.

data.Korean: [플레이어가 강화 1개를 선택한다]
data.English: Do not worry! I will not let anything get past this point!
data.Thai: ไม่ต้องห่วง! ฉันจะไม่ให้ผ่านตรงนี้ไปเด็ดขาด!
data.Vietnamese: Đừng lo! Tôi tuyệt đối sẽ không để chúng vượt qua chỗ này!
data.Indonesian: Jangan khawatir! Aku tidak akan membiarkan apa pun melewati tempat ini!

data.Korean: [선택한 강화가 이후 전투에도 유지됨을 표시한다]
data.English: Good. Just keep that distance.
data.Thai: ดี รักษาระยะประมาณนั้นไว้ก็พอ
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Cứ giữ khoảng cách đó là được.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Jaga jarak seperti itu saja.

data.Korean: 조율됐어.
data.English: Got it. I will take the front!
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ข้างหน้าฉันรับเอง!
data.Vietnamese: Biết rồi. Phía trước cứ để tôi!
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Bagian depan serahkan padaku!

data.Korean: 이제 다음 전투 정보를 확인하자.
data.English: Is everyone okay?
data.Thai: ทุกคนไม่เป็นไรนะ?
data.Vietnamese: Mọi người ổn chứ?
data.Indonesian: Semuanya baik-baik saja?

data.Korean: 지휘관, 숲 안쪽 움직임이 이상해.
data.English: No one is hurt?
data.Thai: ไม่มีใครบาดเจ็บใช่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Có ai bị thương không?
data.Indonesian: Ada yang terluka?

data.Korean: 발소리가 하나만 유독 무거워.
data.English: I am fine!
data.Thai: ฉันไม่เป็นไร!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi ổn!
data.Indonesian: Aku baik-baik saja!

data.Korean: 주변 몬스터들도 그 움직임에 휩쓸려 내려오고 있어.
data.English: I held the front of the gate!
data.Thai: หน้าประตูด่านฉันกันไว้ได้แน่นอน!
data.Vietnamese: Trước cổng tôi đã chặn chắc rồi!
data.Indonesian: Bagian depan gerbang sudah kutahan dengan benar!

data.Korean: 무리를 이끄는 건지, 똑같이 밀려오는 건지는 아직 모르겠어.
data.English: Yeah. You held it properly.
data.Thai: อืม กันไว้ได้จริง ๆ
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Cậu chặn rất chắc.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Kamu menahannya dengan benar.

data.Korean: 확실한 건, 저 대형 몬스터가 제일 위험하다는 거야.
data.English: Still, we need to check the wall's condition.
data.Thai: แต่ก็ยังต้องตรวจสภาพกำแพงป้องกัน
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng vẫn phải kiểm tra tình trạng tường phòng thủ.
data.Indonesian: Tapi kita tetap harus memeriksa kondisi dinding pertahanan.

data.Korean: [보스 정보 확인: 대형 몬스터 중심의 마지막 무리]
data.English: Looking fine and actually being fine are different...
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนไม่เป็นไร กับไม่เป็นไรจริง ๆ มันคนละเรื่องกัน...
data.Vietnamese: Trông ổn và thật sự ổn là hai chuyện khác nhau...
data.Indonesian: Terlihat baik-baik saja dan benar-benar baik-baik saja itu berbeda...

data.Korean: 중앙 방어선에서 막자.
data.English: Demian, how is the wall?
data.Thai: เดเมียน สภาพกำแพงป้องกันเป็นยังไง?
data.Vietnamese: Demian, tình trạng tường phòng thủ thế nào?
data.Indonesian: Demian, bagaimana kondisi dinding pertahanan?

data.Korean: 보강한 방어벽이 버티는 동안 저 녀석을 멈춰야 해.
data.English: The wall is still holding.
data.Thai: กำแพงป้องกันยังคงรับไว้ได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tường phòng thủ vẫn đang trụ được.
data.Indonesian: Dinding pertahanan masih bertahan.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 방어벽 앞에서 끝내자!
data.English: But it has taken quite a lot of impact.
data.Thai: แต่แรงกระแทกสะสมอยู่ค่อนข้างมากครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tuy nhiên, nó đã chịu khá nhiều chấn động.
data.Indonesian: Namun, dampaknya sudah cukup banyak menumpuk.

data.Korean: 다친 사람까지 늘어나면 진짜 바빠지거든...
data.English: It would be risky to have it hold one more time in this state.
data.Thai: ถ้าให้รับอีกครั้งในสภาพนี้จะเสี่ยงครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu để nó trụ thêm một lần nữa trong tình trạng này thì rất nguy hiểm.
data.Indonesian: Berbahaya jika harus bertahan sekali lagi dalam kondisi sekarang.

data.Korean: 준비 끝났으면 바로 움직이자.
data.English: Would it be hard to defend again right away?
data.Thai: ถ้าต้องป้องกันต่อทันทีจะยากเหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Khó chặn tiếp ngay sao?
data.Indonesian: Sulit untuk langsung menahan serangan berikutnya?

data.Korean: 결국 마지막까지 쉬는 건 없다는 거네...
data.English: Yes. We need at least a short time to reinforce it.
data.Thai: ครับ ถึงจะแค่ช่วงสั้น ๆ ก็ต้องมีเวลาเสริมกำแพงครับ
data.Vietnamese: Vâng. Dù chỉ ngắn thôi, cũng cần thời gian gia cố.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Meski sebentar, tetap perlu waktu untuk memperkuatnya.

data.Korean: 늦게 움직이면 더 힘들잖아!
data.English: If we repair the wall, it can hold through the next battle.
data.Thai: ถ้าซ่อมกำแพงป้องกันก่อน การต่อสู้ครั้งถัดไปน่าจะรับไหวครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu sửa tường phòng thủ, nó có thể trụ được trận tiếp theo.
data.Indonesian: Jika dinding pertahanan diperbaiki, itu bisa bertahan untuk pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 세라가 내 논리를 가져갔어...
data.English: There is still movement deeper in the forest.
data.Thai: ยังมีความเคลื่อนไหวด้านในป่าอยู่
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động bên trong rừng vẫn còn.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakan di dalam hutan masih tersisa.

data.Korean: 지휘관, 아까 들었던 무거운 발소리야.
data.English: There are heavier footsteps mixed in than before.
data.Thai: มีเสียงฝีเท้าที่หนักกว่าก่อนหน้านี้ปนอยู่ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Có lẫn cả tiếng bước chân nặng hơn lúc nãy.
data.Indonesian: Ada juga suara langkah kaki yang lebih berat dari sebelumnya.

data.Korean: 아직 보이진 않지만, 움직임은 점점 가까워지고 있어.
data.English: Then fighting again right away would be dangerous.
data.Thai: งั้นสู้ต่อทันทีคงอันตราย
data.Vietnamese: Vậy đánh tiếp ngay sẽ nguy hiểm.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, berbahaya kalau langsung bertarung lagi.

data.Korean: 주변 몬스터들이 먼저 밀려 내려오고 있어.
data.English: Let us repair the wall first, then check the movement inside again.
data.Thai: ซ่อมกำแพงป้องกันก่อน แล้วค่อยตรวจความเคลื่อนไหวด้านในอีกครั้งเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Sửa tường phòng thủ trước, rồi kiểm tra lại chuyển động bên trong.
data.Indonesian: Perbaiki dinding pertahanan dulu, lalu periksa lagi pergerakan di dalam.

data.Korean: 더 확인할 시간은 없어. 여기서 막아야 해.
data.English: If we have maintenance time, maybe I can close my eyes for a moment...
data.Thai: ถ้ามีเวลาซ่อมบำรุง งั้นขอหลับตาสักแป๊บ...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu có thời gian chỉnh bị, tôi chợp mắt một chút...
data.Indonesian: Kalau ada waktu perawatan, mungkin aku bisa memejamkan mata sebentar...

data.Korean: 좋아. 방어벽에 도달하기 전에 끝내버리자!
data.English: Sleeping is not included in maintenance time.
data.Thai: เวลาซ่อมบำรุงไม่ได้รวมเวลานอนนะ
data.Vietnamese: Ngủ không nằm trong thời gian chỉnh bị đâu.
data.Indonesian: Tidur tidak termasuk dalam waktu perawatan.

data.Korean: 그럼 부상자도 적게 나오는 쪽으로 부탁할게...
data.English: I did not even finish saying it yet...
data.Thai: ฉันยังพูดไม่จบเลย...
data.Vietnamese: Tôi còn chưa nói hết mà...
data.Indonesian: Aku bahkan belum selesai bicara...

data.Korean: 큰 움직임은 아직 뒤쪽에 있어.
data.English: ...No, you were mostly right, though.
data.Thai: ...ไม่สิ ก็เกือบถูกแล้วนั่นแหละ
data.Vietnamese: ...Không, gần như đúng thật.
data.Indonesian: ...Tidak, memang hampir benar sih.

data.Korean: 먼저 내려오는 무리부터 막아야 해.
data.English: Good. Let us start with the gate wall.
data.Thai: ดี เริ่มจากซ่อมกำแพงประตูด่านก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Bắt đầu sửa tường cổng trước.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Kita mulai dari memperbaiki dinding gerbang.

data.Korean: 보강한 방어벽은 버틸 수 있습니다.
data.English: Noah and Alice, keep checking the movement deeper in the forest.
data.Thai: โนอากับเอลิส คอยตรวจความเคลื่อนไหวด้านในป่าต่อไป
data.Vietnamese: Noah và Alice, tiếp tục kiểm tra chuyển động bên trong rừng.
data.Indonesian: Noah dan Alice, terus periksa pergerakan di dalam hutan.

data.Korean: 다만 오래 버티게 둘 수는 없습니다.
data.English: Serah and Spayne, check the repair points with the soldiers.
data.Thai: เซราห์กับสเปย์น ไปตรวจจุดที่ต้องซ่อมกับพวกทหาร
data.Vietnamese: Serah và Spayne, kiểm tra các điểm cần sửa cùng binh lính.
data.Indonesian: Serah dan Spayne, periksa titik yang perlu diperbaiki bersama para prajurit.

data.Korean: 병사들은 방어벽 뒤에서 대기시키겠습니다.
data.English: Yeah. I will keep watching the movement.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันจะคอยดูความเคลื่อนไหวต่อไป
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi sẽ tiếp tục quan sát chuyển động.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Aku akan terus mengawasi pergerakannya.

data.Korean: 신호석 조율도 유지되고 있어. 오래 끌지만 않으면 돼.
data.English: Good. I will get ready before the next battle!
data.Thai: ดี ฉันจะเตรียมให้พร้อมก่อนการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไป!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Tôi sẽ chuẩn bị trước trận tiếp theo!
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Aku akan bersiap sebelum pertempuran berikutnya!

data.Korean: 좋아. 중앙 방어선에서 막자.
data.English: Getting ready is good... but this time, please aim for fewer injuries.
data.Thai: เตรียมก็ดีอยู่หรอก... แต่ครั้งนี้ขอแบบเจ็บน้อยลงนะ
data.Vietnamese: Chuẩn bị thì tốt... nhưng lần này làm sao để ít bị thương hơn nhé.
data.Indonesian: Bersiap itu bagus... tapi kali ini, usahakan lebih sedikit yang terluka.

data.Korean: 응. 시에스는 여기서 지켜내자!
data.English: Whether it is you or the wall, more things to fix means more work...
data.Thai: ไม่ว่าจะพวกเธอหรือกำแพง ถ้ามีที่ต้องซ่อมเพิ่มก็เหนื่อย...
data.Vietnamese: Dù là các cậu hay tường phòng thủ, chỗ cần sửa tăng lên thì mệt lắm...
data.Indonesian: Entah kalian atau dinding pertahanan, kalau yang harus diperbaiki bertambah, itu melelahkan...

data.Korean: 다치면 바로 말해줘. 숨기면 더 힘들어져...
data.English: Demian, this crack looks pretty bad.
data.Thai: เดเมียน ตรงนี้รอยร้าวดูหนักนะ
data.Vietnamese: Demian, chỗ này có vẻ nứt khá nhiều.
data.Indonesian: Demian, retakan di sini sepertinya cukup parah.

data.Korean: 앞쪽 움직임이 가까워지고 있어.
data.English: If we leave this side alone, it will open up wider next time...
data.Thai: ทางนี้ถ้าปล่อยไว้ ครั้งหน้าคงแยกกว้างกว่าเดิม...
data.Vietnamese: Bên này nếu cứ để vậy, lần sau sẽ nứt rộng hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau sisi ini dibiarkan, berikutnya akan terbuka lebih besar...

data.Korean: 곧 중앙 방어선에 닿을 것 같아.
data.English: We will reinforce the gate wall at once.
data.Thai: เราจะเสริมกำแพงประตูด่านทันทีครับ
data.Vietnamese: Chúng tôi sẽ gia cố tường cổng ngay.
data.Indonesian: Kami akan segera memperkuat dinding gerbang.

data.Korean: [보스 등장]
data.English: We cannot fully repair it, but we can make it strong enough for the next battle.
data.Thai: คงซ่อมให้สมบูรณ์ไม่ได้ แต่ทำให้พอรับการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไปได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Không thể sửa hoàn toàn, nhưng có thể làm nó đủ trụ cho trận tiếp theo.
data.Indonesian: Tidak bisa memperbaikinya sepenuhnya, tapi kami bisa membuatnya cukup kuat untuk pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 주변 몬스터들이 흩어지고 있어.
data.English: Then it is better to do that now...
data.Thai: ถ้าระดับนั้นได้ ทำตอนนี้ก็น่าจะดีกว่า...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu được đến mức đó, làm ngay bây giờ vẫn hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau sampai sejauh itu bisa, lebih baik dilakukan sekarang...

data.Korean: 더 밀려오는 움직임은 줄어든 것 같아.
data.English: If it collapses later, there will be too many places to fix.
data.Thai: ถ้ามันพังทีหลัง จุดที่ต้องซ่อมจะเยอะเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Nếu sau này nó sập, sẽ có quá nhiều chỗ phải sửa.
data.Indonesian: Kalau nanti runtuh, akan ada terlalu banyak tempat yang harus diperbaiki.

data.Korean: 하아... 이번엔 진짜 가까웠네.
data.English: Then let us make it as sturdy as we can right now!
data.Thai: งั้นตอนนี้ทำให้แข็งแรงที่สุดเท่าที่ทำได้เถอะ!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy bây giờ làm nó chắc nhất có thể thôi!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, sekarang kita buat sekokoh mungkin!

data.Korean: 좋아... 막아냈어.
data.English: If the wall holds, I can hold the line longer too.
data.Thai: ถ้ากำแพงป้องกันรับไว้ได้ ฉันก็จะกันได้นานขึ้นด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu tường phòng thủ trụ được, tôi cũng có thể chặn lâu hơn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau dinding pertahanan bertahan, aku juga bisa menahan lebih lama.

data.Korean: 시에스 방어 요새를 우리가 지켜냈어!
data.English: If both hold, that gives me fewer things to check...
data.Thai: ถ้าทั้งสองอย่างรับไหว จุดที่ฉันต้องดูก็น้อยลง...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cả hai cùng trụ được, chỗ tôi phải xem cũng sẽ ít đi...
data.Indonesian: Kalau keduanya bertahan, bagian yang harus kulihat juga berkurang...

data.Korean: 다친 사람부터 확인하자... 기뻐하는 건 그다음도 늦지 않아.
data.English: Exactly. That is why we are repairing it now.
data.Thai: ใช่ เพราะงั้นเราถึงซ่อมมันตอนนี้
data.Vietnamese: Đúng vậy. Vì thế bây giờ chúng ta mới sửa nó.
data.Indonesian: Benar. Karena itu kita memperbaikinya sekarang.

data.Korean: 병사들은 무사합니다. 큰 부상자는 없습니다.
data.English: [Gate wall reinforcement complete. Wall HP has been restored.]
data.Thai: [เสริมกำแพงประตูด่านเสร็จสิ้น พลังชีวิตของกำแพงฟื้นฟูแล้ว]
data.Vietnamese: [Gia cố tường cổng hoàn tất. HP tường đã được hồi phục.]
data.Indonesian: [Penguatan dinding gerbang selesai. HP dinding telah dipulihkan.]

data.Korean: 관문 방어벽도 버텼습니다.
data.English: The gate wall reinforcement is done.
data.Thai: เสริมกำแพงประตูด่านเสร็จแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Gia cố tường cổng đã xong.
data.Indonesian: Penguatan dinding gerbang sudah selesai.

data.Korean: 수호대 여러분이 아니었다면 방어벽 앞에서 버티기 어려웠을 겁니다.
data.English: We can tune the signal stones one more time too.
data.Thai: ศิลาสัญญาณก็ยังปรับได้อีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Đá tín hiệu cũng có thể điều chỉnh thêm một lần nữa.
data.Indonesian: Batu sinyal juga bisa diselaraskan sekali lagi.

data.Korean: 완전히 해결된 건 아니지만, 오늘 몰려온 무리는 막아냈어.
data.English: It would be best to choose one more enhancement before the final battle.
data.Thai: ก่อนการต่อสู้ครั้งสุดท้าย เลือกการเสริมพลังไว้อีกหนึ่งอย่างน่าจะดี
data.Vietnamese: Trước trận cuối, tốt nhất nên chọn thêm một cường hóa.
data.Indonesian: Sebelum pertempuran terakhir, sebaiknya kita menentukan satu peningkatan lagi.

data.Korean: 응. 지금은 그걸로 충분해!
data.English: The enhancement you choose now will carry over into the next battle too.
data.Thai: การเสริมพลังที่เลือกตอนนี้จะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไปด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Cường hóa chọn bây giờ cũng sẽ tiếp tục sang trận tiếp theo.
data.Indonesian: Peningkatan yang dipilih sekarang akan berlanjut ke pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 모두 수고했어.
data.English: Good. Tune it where we need it.
data.Thai: ดี ปรับให้เข้ากับส่วนที่จำเป็นเลย
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Điều chỉnh theo phía cần thiết đi.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Sesuaikan ke bagian yang dibutuhkan.

data.Korean: 지휘관님, 전투 중에 제플 쪽 보고가 들어왔습니다.
data.English: I will be the one holding the front.
data.Thai: เพราะคนที่ยืนกันข้างหน้าคือฉัน
data.Vietnamese: Vì người trụ phía trước sẽ là tôi.
data.Indonesian: Karena aku yang akan bertahan di depan.

data.Korean: 그쪽에서도 몬스터들이 한 방향으로 몰리고 있다고 합니다.
data.English: I will keep watching movement farther back too.
data.Thai: ฉันก็จะคอยดูความเคลื่อนไหวลึกเข้าไปต่อ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cũng sẽ tiếp tục quan sát chuyển động phía sau.
data.Indonesian: Aku juga akan terus mengawasi pergerakan di belakang.

data.Korean: 상부에도 같은 내용이 전달됐습니다.
data.English: I am fine with anything that means fewer things to fix, whether it is people or the wall...
data.Thai: ฉันเอาแบบที่ทำให้ต้องซ่อมทั้งคนทั้งกำแพงน้อยลงก็พอ...
data.Vietnamese: Tôi chỉ cần phía nào khiến người hay tường phòng thủ ít phải sửa hơn...
data.Indonesian: Aku baik dengan pilihan yang membuat orang maupun dinding pertahanan lebih sedikit perlu diperbaiki...

data.Korean: 시에스에는 지원 병력이 도착하는 대로 제가 방어를 인계하겠습니다.
data.English: Good. Let us do the final tuning.
data.Thai: ดี มาปรับครั้งสุดท้ายกัน
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Điều chỉnh lần cuối nào.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Mari lakukan penyelarasan terakhir.

data.Korean: 그럼 같은 흐름이 제플 쪽에도 이어진 거네.
data.English: [Display character permanent enhancement candidates]
data.Thai: [แสดงตัวเลือกเสริมพลังถาวรของตัวละคร]
data.Vietnamese: [Hiển thị ứng viên cường hóa vĩnh viễn cho nhân vật]
data.Indonesian: [Tampilkan kandidat peningkatan permanen karakter]

data.Korean: 시에스에서 줄어든 것과는 별개일지도 몰라.
data.English: [The player selects one enhancement]
data.Thai: [ผู้เล่นเลือกการเสริมพลัง 1 อย่าง]
data.Vietnamese: [Người chơi chọn 1 cường hóa]
data.Indonesian: [Pemain memilih 1 peningkatan]

data.Korean: 원인은 아직 남아 있어.
data.English: [Display that the selected enhancement will remain active in later battles]
data.Thai: [แสดงว่าการเสริมพลังที่เลือกจะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ถัดไปด้วย]
data.Vietnamese: [Hiển thị rằng cường hóa đã chọn sẽ được duy trì trong các trận sau]
data.Indonesian: [Tampilkan bahwa peningkatan yang dipilih akan tetap aktif di pertempuran berikutnya]

data.Korean: 그래도 시에스가 무사한 건 분명한 성과야.
data.English: Tuned.
data.Thai: ปรับเสร็จแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Đã điều chỉnh xong.
data.Indonesian: Sudah diselaraskan.

data.Korean: 응. 제플도 늦기 전에 확인하자.
data.English: Now let us check the next battle's intel.
data.Thai: ต่อไปตรวจข้อมูลการต่อสู้ครั้งถัดไปกัน
data.Vietnamese: Giờ kiểm tra thông tin trận tiếp theo.
data.Indonesian: Sekarang periksa informasi pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 방금 쉬는 시간이 더 멀어진 것 같은데...
data.English: Commander, the movement deeper in the forest is strange.
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ ความเคลื่อนไหวด้านในป่าแปลกไป
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, chuyển động bên trong rừng rất lạ.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, pergerakan di dalam hutan aneh.

data.Korean: 지금은 이동 준비부터 해야지.
data.English: One set of footsteps is unusually heavy.
data.Thai: มีเสียงฝีเท้าหนึ่งที่หนักผิดปกติ
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ có một tiếng bước chân đặc biệt nặng.
data.Indonesian: Ada satu suara langkah yang sangat berat.

data.Korean: 알겠어... 쉬는 시간도 같이 이동하는 거라고 믿을게...
data.English: The nearby monsters seem to be getting swept along by that sound.
data.Thai: เหมือนสัตว์ประหลาดรอบ ๆ ก็ถูกเสียงนั้นพาให้เคลื่อนไหวตามไปด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ quái vật xung quanh cũng bị cuốn theo tiếng đó mà di chuyển.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya monster di sekitar juga ikut terseret bergerak oleh suara itu.

data.Korean: 좋아. 시에스 상황을 정리하고, 바로 제플로 이동하자.
data.English: We still do not know whether it is leading the horde or being driven along with them.
data.Thai: ยังไม่รู้ว่ามันนำฝูงอยู่ หรือถูกไล่ต้อนมาพร้อมกัน
data.Vietnamese: Vẫn chưa biết nó đang dẫn bầy, hay cũng bị đẩy xuống cùng chúng.
data.Indonesian: Masih belum jelas apakah itu memimpin gerombolan, atau ikut terdorong bersama mereka.

data.Korean: 시에스에서 오신 수호대 여러분이십니까?
data.English: But that one will be the most dangerous in the next battle.
data.Thai: แต่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไป ตัวนั้นจะอันตรายที่สุด
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng trong trận tiếp theo, con đó là nguy hiểm nhất.
data.Indonesian: Tapi dalam pertempuran berikutnya, makhluk itu yang paling berbahaya.

data.Korean: 맞아. 제플 쪽 상황을 확인하러 왔어.
data.English: [Boss intel confirmed: Final horde centered around a large monster]
data.Thai: [ยืนยันข้อมูลบอส: ฝูงสุดท้ายที่มีสัตว์ประหลาดขนาดใหญ่เป็นศูนย์กลาง]
data.Vietnamese: [Xác nhận thông tin boss: Đợt cuối xoay quanh quái vật lớn]
data.Indonesian: [Informasi bos dikonfirmasi: Gerombolan terakhir berpusat pada monster besar]

data.Korean: 예. 외곽 길에서 몬스터 무리가 계속 내려오고 있습니다.
data.English: Let us stop them at the village road entrance behind the gate.
data.Thai: หยุดพวกมันที่ปากทางถนนหมู่บ้านด้านหลังประตูด่านกัน
data.Vietnamese: Chặn chúng ở lối vào đường làng phía sau cổng.
data.Indonesian: Kita tahan mereka di pintu masuk jalan desa di belakang gerbang.

data.Korean: 주민들은 관문 안쪽으로 대피시키고 있지만, 물자 수레가 아직 남아 있습니다.
data.English: We need to stop that thing while the wall holds.
data.Thai: เราต้องหยุดเจ้านั่นระหว่างที่กำแพงป้องกันยังรับไว้ได้
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta phải chặn con đó khi tường phòng thủ còn trụ được.
data.Indonesian: Kita harus menghentikan makhluk itu selagi dinding bertahan.

data.Korean: 발자국이 한쪽으로만 이어져 있어.
data.English: Got it. I will stop that one from the front.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว เจ้านั่นฉันจะกันไว้จากด้านหน้าเอง
data.Vietnamese: Biết rồi. Con đó tôi sẽ chặn từ phía trước.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Makhluk itu akan kutahan dari depan.

data.Korean: 시에스 때처럼 흩어진 무리가 아니라, 밀려온 무리야.
data.English: I will not let it get behind the gate.
data.Thai: ฉันจะไม่ให้มันผ่านไปหลังประตูด่าน
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ không để nó qua phía sau cổng.
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak akan membiarkannya lewat ke belakang gerbang.

data.Korean: 좋아. 여기서 막자. 안쪽 사람들이 대피할 수 있도록 지켜야 해.
data.English: Please try not to get too badly hurt...
data.Thai: ขอร้องล่ะ อย่าบาดเจ็บหนักเกินไปนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Làm ơn đừng bị thương quá nặng nhé...
data.Indonesian: Tolong jangan sampai terluka terlalu parah...

data.Korean: 맞아. 길이 넓어서 막는 것 자체는 조금 수월할 수 있어.
data.English: I would like the wall to be the only thing we need to fix.
data.Thai: ฉันอยากให้สิ่งที่ต้องซ่อมมีแค่กำแพงป้องกันพอ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi muốn thứ cần sửa chỉ dừng ở tường phòng thủ thôi.
data.Indonesian: Aku ingin yang perlu diperbaiki cukup dinding pertahanan saja.

data.Korean: 하지만 한번 밀리면 인명 피해로 바로 이어질 거야.
data.English: Now let us move to the defense line behind the gate.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้ไปที่แนวป้องกันด้านหลังประตูด่านกัน
data.Vietnamese: Giờ đến tuyến phòng thủ phía sau cổng thôi.
data.Indonesian: Sekarang kita menuju garis pertahanan di belakang gerbang.

data.Korean: 사람 많은 곳에서 다치면 찾는 것부터 일이야...
data.English: So we have to hurry all the way to the end...
data.Thai: สุดท้ายก็ต้องวิ่งจนถึงตอนจบเลยสินะ...
data.Vietnamese: Cuối cùng vẫn phải chạy đến tận phút cuối nhỉ...
data.Indonesian: Pada akhirnya, kita harus berlari sampai akhir juga...

data.Korean: 그러니까 가능하면 내 쪽 일은 조금만 만들어줘.
data.English: It is better than arriving late and making things harder!
data.Thai: ก็ดีกว่าไปช้าแล้วลำบากกว่าเดิมนี่!
data.Vietnamese: Còn hơn đến muộn rồi mọi chuyện khó hơn!
data.Indonesian: Itu lebih baik daripada terlambat lalu semuanya jadi lebih sulit!

data.Korean: 수레만 빠지면 관문 앞은 바로 비울 수 있습니다.
data.English: Serah took my logic...
data.Thai: เซราห์เอาตรรกะของฉันไปใช้แล้ว...
data.Vietnamese: Serah lấy mất lý lẽ của tôi rồi...
data.Indonesian: Serah mengambil logikaku...

data.Korean: 그때까지만 방어선을 유지해 주십시오.
data.English: Commander, that is the heavy footstep I heard earlier.
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ นั่นคือเสียงฝีเท้าหนัก ๆ ที่ฉันได้ยินก่อนหน้านี้
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, đó là tiếng bước chân nặng tôi nghe lúc nãy.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, itu suara langkah berat yang kudengar tadi.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 관문 앞부터 정리하자.
data.English: It is almost here.
data.Thai: มันใกล้จะมาถึงแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Nó gần tới rồi.
data.Indonesian: Sekarang hampir sampai.

data.Korean: 수레가 빠질 길을 열고, 방어선은 그대로 유지해.
data.English: The nearby monsters are being dragged down with it too.
data.Thai: สัตว์ประหลาดรอบ ๆ ก็ถูกลากลงมาด้วยกัน
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật xung quanh cũng đang bị kéo xuống cùng nó.
data.Indonesian: Monster di sekitar juga ikut terseret turun bersamanya.

data.Korean: 알겠습니다. 바로 진행하겠습니다.
data.English: There is no time to check anything else here.
data.Thai: คงไม่มีเวลาตรวจอะไรเพิ่มเติมแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Ở đây không còn thời gian kiểm tra thêm nữa.
data.Indonesian: Tidak ada waktu lagi untuk memeriksa hal lain di sini.

data.Korean: 지휘관, 관문 밖 길에 발자국이 많이 남아 있어.
data.English: Then we cannot let this drag on...
data.Thai: งั้นจะปล่อยให้ยืดเยื้อไม่ได้สินะ...
data.Vietnamese: Vậy không thể để kéo dài được...
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita tidak boleh membiarkannya berlarut-larut...

data.Korean: 옆으로 새면 수레가 빠지는 길하고 바로 겹쳐.
data.English: I will watch the healing timing.
data.Thai: จังหวะฟื้นฟูฉันจะดูเอง
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ xem thời điểm hồi phục.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan melihat timing pemulihan.

data.Korean: 그럼 무리하게 앞으로 나가면 안 돼.
data.English: Like I said before, I will hold the front.
data.Thai: อย่างที่พูดไว้ ข้างหน้าฉันจะกันเอง
data.Vietnamese: Như đã nói lúc nãy, phía trước tôi sẽ chặn.
data.Indonesian: Seperti yang kukatakan tadi, bagian depan akan kutahan.

data.Korean: 수레가 빠질 때까지 이 선을 유지하자.
data.English: I will not let them get behind the gate!
data.Thai: ฉันจะไม่ให้พวกมันผ่านไปหลังประตูด่านเด็ดขาด!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi tuyệt đối sẽ không để chúng qua phía sau cổng!
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak akan membiarkan mereka lewat ke belakang gerbang!

data.Korean: 좋아. 먼저 부딪히는 쪽은 내가 맡을게!
data.English: Yeah. That is reassuring.
data.Thai: อืม ได้ยินแบบนั้นแล้วอุ่นใจนะ
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Nghe vậy thấy yên tâm đấy.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Mendengar itu membuatku tenang.

data.Korean: 수레 쪽으로는 한 발짝도 못 보내.
data.English: Just hold your ground where we can see you.
data.Thai: แต่ช่วยยืนรับไว้ในจุดที่พวกเรามองเห็นด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng hãy trụ trong tầm mắt của chúng tôi.
data.Indonesian: Tapi bertahanlah di dalam jarak pandang kami.

data.Korean: 응. 옆으로 새는 움직임은 내가 볼게.
data.English: Got it. I will show you what I can do.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ฉันจะแสดงให้เห็นชัด ๆ เอง
data.Vietnamese: Biết rồi. Tôi sẽ cho mọi người thấy rõ.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Akan kutunjukkan dengan benar.

data.Korean: 세라, 너무 앞서지만 마.
data.English: I will keep watching the enemies coming in from far away.
data.Thai: ฉันจะคอยดูศัตรูที่เข้ามาจากระยะไกลต่อไป
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ tiếp tục quan sát kẻ địch tiến vào từ xa.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan terus mengawasi musuh yang datang dari jauh.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 이 선 안에서 막을게.
data.English: If you get hurt, tell me right away.
data.Thai: ถ้าบาดเจ็บก็บอกทันทีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị thương thì nói ngay.
data.Indonesian: Kalau terluka, langsung beri tahu.

data.Korean: 방어선 안쪽이면 나도 좋아.
data.English: So please do not push yourself too hard.
data.Thai: เพราะงั้นอย่าฝืนเกินไปล่ะ
data.Vietnamese: Vì vậy đừng cố quá sức nhé.
data.Indonesian: Jadi jangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

data.Korean: 너무 멀리 나가면 찾으러 가야 하니까...
data.English: Good. Let us stop them at the central defense line.
data.Thai: ดี หยุดพวกมันที่แนวป้องกันกลางกัน
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Chặn chúng ở tuyến phòng thủ trung tâm.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Kita tahan mereka di garis pertahanan tengah.

data.Korean: 바깥 움직임이 가까워지고 있어.
data.English: [Boss Battle Start]
data.Thai: [เริ่มศึกบอส]
data.Vietnamese: [Bắt đầu trận boss]
data.Indonesian: [Pertempuran bos dimulai]

data.Korean: 길을 따라 그대로 들어오고 있어.
data.English: The movement is slowing down.
data.Thai: ความเคลื่อนไหวกำลังลดลง
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động đang giảm dần.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakannya mulai berkurang.

data.Korean: 몬스터 무리 접근! 외곽 관문 전방입니다!
data.English: At least the horde that was rushing in seems to have stopped.
data.Thai: อย่างน้อยฝูงที่กำลังบุกเข้ามาตอนนี้ก็ดูเหมือนจะหยุดแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Ít nhất nhóm đang tràn tới lúc này có vẻ đã dừng lại.
data.Indonesian: Setidaknya gerombolan yang datang sekarang sepertinya sudah berhenti.

data.Korean: 좋아. 외곽 관문에서 막자.
data.English: Good! We defended Cies Defense Fortress!
data.Thai: ดีล่ะ! เราปกป้องป้อมปราการป้องกันซีเอสไว้ได้แล้ว!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt! Chúng ta đã bảo vệ được pháo đài phòng thủ Cies!
data.Indonesian: Bagus! Kita berhasil melindungi Benteng Pertahanan Cies!

data.Korean: 수레가 빠질 길은 열어 두고, 들어오는 무리는 여기서 막자.
data.English: Yeah. I am glad everyone is safe.
data.Thai: อืม ดีจริง ๆ ที่ทุกคนปลอดภัย
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Mọi người an toàn là tốt rồi.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Syukurlah semua selamat.

data.Korean: 응. 앞쪽은 내가 맡을게!
data.English: We protected both the gate and the village road.
data.Thai: เราปกป้องได้ทั้งประตูด่านและถนนหมู่บ้าน
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã bảo vệ được cả cổng lẫn đường làng.
data.Indonesian: Kita melindungi gerbang dan jalan desa.

data.Korean: 바깥 움직임은 계속 볼게. 옆길로 새면 바로 말할게.
data.English: We stopped the horde that came today.
data.Thai: เราหยุดฝูงที่บุกเข้ามาวันนี้ได้แล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã chặn được nhóm tràn tới hôm nay.
data.Indonesian: Kita berhasil menahan gerombolan yang datang hari ini.

data.Korean: 한쪽으로 쏠리면 내가 정리할게.
data.English: The cause is still unresolved, but this is definitely an accomplishment.
data.Thai: สาเหตุยังไม่หายไป แต่เรื่องนี้เป็นผลงานที่ชัดเจน
data.Vietnamese: Nguyên nhân vẫn còn đó, nhưng đây chắc chắn là một thành quả.
data.Indonesian: Penyebabnya masih ada, tapi ini jelas sebuah pencapaian.

data.Korean: 다치면 바로 말해줘.
data.English: Then since we accomplished something, that means there is rest time too, right...?
data.Thai: งั้นในเมื่อมีผลงานแล้ว เวลาพักก็ควรมีด้วยใช่ไหม...?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy có thành quả rồi, chắc cũng có thời gian nghỉ chứ...?
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, karena ada pencapaian, pasti ada waktu istirahat juga, kan...?

data.Korean: 참으면 너희도 힘들고, 나도 힘들어져...
data.English: Guardians, thank you very much for your hard work.
data.Thai: ทุกท่านจากหน่วยพิทักษ์ ขอบคุณสำหรับความเหนื่อยยากจริง ๆ ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Các thành viên Đội Hộ vệ, thật sự vất vả cho mọi người rồi.
data.Indonesian: Para Guardian, kalian benar-benar sudah bekerja keras.

data.Korean: 다들 괜찮아?
data.English: Thanks to you, Cies Defense Fortress is safe.
data.Thai: เพราะทุกท่าน ป้อมปราการป้องกันซีเอสจึงปลอดภัยครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nhờ các vị, pháo đài phòng thủ Cies vẫn an toàn.
data.Indonesian: Berkat kalian, Benteng Pertahanan Cies selamat.

data.Korean: 주민들도 크게 다친 사람은 없어 보여.
data.English: Everyone, good work.
data.Thai: ทุกคน ทำได้ดีมาก
data.Vietnamese: Mọi người vất vả rồi.
data.Indonesian: Semuanya, kerja bagus.

data.Korean: 좋아! 수레도 무사히 들어갔어.
data.English: Commander, we received a message from the Jeple direction during the battle.
data.Thai: ท่านผู้บัญชาการ ระหว่างการต่อสู้มีการติดต่อมาจากทางเจเพิลครับ
data.Vietnamese: Thưa ngài Chỉ huy, trong lúc chiến đấu có liên lạc từ hướng Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, selama pertempuran ada kontak dari arah Jeple.

data.Korean: 제플 안쪽은 지켜냈어!
data.English: They say monsters are also moving in one direction over there.
data.Thai: ทางนั้นแจ้งว่ามีสัตว์ประหลาดเคลื่อนตัวไปทางเดียวกันเช่นกันครับ
data.Vietnamese: Họ nói bên đó quái vật cũng đang dồn về một hướng.
data.Indonesian: Mereka mengatakan monster di sana juga bergerak ke satu arah.

data.Korean: 응. 하지만 몬스터들은 같은 길로 계속 내려오고 있어.
data.English: So this was not only happening here.
data.Thai: แปลว่าไม่ได้เกิดขึ้นแค่ที่นี่สินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy không chỉ xảy ra ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Jadi ini bukan hanya terjadi di sini.

data.Korean: 관문에서 막았을 뿐, 움직임이 멈춘 건 아니야.
data.English: Similar movement may continue elsewhere.
data.Thai: อาจมีการเคลื่อนไหวแบบเดียวกันต่อไปอีก
data.Vietnamese: Có thể những chuyển động tương tự sẽ còn tiếp diễn.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakan serupa mungkin masih akan berlanjut.

data.Korean: 계속 내려온다는 건...
data.English: At least one thing is clear.
data.Thai: อย่างน้อยมีเรื่องหนึ่งที่แน่ชัด
data.Vietnamese: Ít nhất có một điều chắc chắn.
data.Indonesian: Setidaknya satu hal sudah jelas.

data.Korean: 오늘도 일찍 쉬긴 힘들다는 뜻이야...?
data.English: This is not a problem limited to Cies.
data.Thai: นี่ไม่ใช่ปัญหาของซีเอสเพียงแห่งเดียว
data.Vietnamese: Đây không phải vấn đề riêng của Cies.
data.Indonesian: Ini bukan masalah Cies saja.

data.Korean: 관문 앞 흔적 중 일부가 옆으로 갈라졌어.
data.English: We protected Cies.
data.Thai: เราได้ปกป้องซีเอสไว้แล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã bảo vệ được Cies.
data.Indonesian: Kita berhasil melindungi Cies.

data.Korean: 농장 지대 쪽으로 이어진 발자국도 보여.
data.English: That much we definitely did.
data.Thai: เรื่องนั้นเราทำสำเร็จแน่นอน
data.Vietnamese: Điều đó chắc chắn chúng ta đã làm được.
data.Indonesian: Itu jelas sudah kita lakukan.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 갈라진 흔적부터 확인하자.
data.English: Let us check the report from Jeple too.
data.Thai: ไปตรวจรายงานฝั่งเจเพิลด้วยเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kiểm tra cả báo cáo phía Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Mari kita periksa juga laporan dari Jeple.

data.Korean: 응. 외곽 관문에서 막은 건 일부였어.
data.English: Then there is still work left...?
data.Thai: งั้นก็ยังมีงานเหลืออยู่สินะ...?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy vẫn còn việc phải làm nhỉ...?
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, masih ada pekerjaan yang tersisa...?

data.Korean: 다른 쪽이 어디로 이어졌는지 봐야 해.
data.English: We need to sort out the situation first.
data.Thai: ต้องเริ่มจากจัดระเบียบสถานการณ์ก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Phải bắt đầu từ việc tổng hợp tình hình đã.
data.Indonesian: Kita harus mulai dari merapikan situasi dulu.

data.Korean: 지휘관님, 농장 지대 쪽에서도 보고가 들어왔습니다.
data.English: Then sorting things out right now is very important...
data.Thai: งั้นการจัดระเบียบตอนนี้ก็สำคัญมากเลยสินะ...
data.Vietnamese: Vậy việc tổng hợp bây giờ rất quan trọng nhỉ...
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, merapikan situasi sekarang sangat penting...

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 울타리를 밀고 지나가고 있다고 합니다.
data.English: Got it. Let us organize the Cies situation first.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว เริ่มจากจัดระเบียบสถานการณ์ของซีเอสก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Biết rồi. Hãy tổng hợp tình hình Cies trước.
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Kita rapikan situasi Cies dulu.

data.Korean: 농장까지?
data.English: We will check the Jeple report after that.
data.Thai: รายงานของเจเพิลค่อยตรวจหลังจากนั้น
data.Vietnamese: Báo cáo của Jeple sẽ kiểm tra sau đó.
data.Indonesian: Laporan Jeple kita periksa setelah itu.

data.Korean: 그럼 사람들이 있는 곳으로 더 들어간 거잖아.
data.English: Then that means they went farther into where the people are.
data.Thai: งั้นก็แปลว่าพวกมันเข้าไปลึกกว่าเดิม ตรงที่มีผู้คนอยู่สินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nghĩa là chúng đã tiến sâu hơn vào nơi có người.
data.Indonesian: Berarti mereka masuk lebih jauh ke tempat orang-orang berada.

data.Korean: 응. 관문 앞에서 갈라진 흔적이 농장 지대 쪽이었어.
data.English: Yeah. The traces that split off in front of the gate headed toward the farm district.
data.Thai: อืม ร่องรอยที่แยกออกจากหน้าประตูมุ่งไปทางเขตฟาร์ม
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Dấu vết tách ra trước cổng dẫn về phía khu nông trại.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Jejak yang bercabang di depan gerbang menuju ke area pertanian.

data.Korean: 보고가 들어온 걸 보면 이미 농장 안쪽까지 들어갔어.
data.English: Judging by the report, they have already gone deep into the farms.
data.Thai: จากรายงาน พวกมันเข้าไปถึงด้านในเขตฟาร์มแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Nhìn theo báo cáo, chúng đã vào sâu bên trong nông trại rồi.
data.Indonesian: Dilihat dari laporannya, mereka sudah masuk jauh ke dalam area pertanian.

data.Korean: 밭길이면 진흙도 있을 텐데...
data.English: If it is a field path, there will probably be mud...
data.Thai: ถ้าเป็นทางในไร่ ก็น่าจะมีโคลนด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu là đường ruộng thì chắc sẽ có bùn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau itu jalan ladang, pasti ada lumpur juga...

data.Korean: 넘어지면 쉬는 시간보다 씻는 시간이 길어지겠네.
data.English: If I fall, washing up will take longer than resting.
data.Thai: ถ้าล้มขึ้นมา เวลาล้างตัวคงนานกว่าเวลาพักอีก
data.Vietnamese: Nếu ngã thì thời gian rửa sạch còn lâu hơn thời gian nghỉ mất.
data.Indonesian: Kalau aku jatuh, waktu untuk bersih-bersih bisa lebih lama daripada istirahat.

data.Korean: 지금 쉬는 시간 계산할 때 아니야.
data.English: This is not the time to calculate break time.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้ไม่ใช่เวลามาคำนวณเวลาพัก
data.Vietnamese: Giờ không phải lúc tính thời gian nghỉ.
data.Indonesian: Sekarang bukan waktunya menghitung waktu istirahat.

data.Korean: 휴식을 얕보지 마...
data.English: Do not underestimate rest...
data.Thai: อย่าดูถูกการพักผ่อนนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Đừng xem nhẹ chuyện nghỉ ngơi...
data.Indonesian: Jangan meremehkan istirahat...

data.Korean: 먼저 임시 지휘소로 이동하자.
data.English: First, let us move to the temporary command post.
data.Thai: ก่อนอื่น ไปที่กองบัญชาการชั่วคราวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Trước hết, hãy di chuyển đến sở chỉ huy tạm thời.
data.Indonesian: Pertama, mari bergerak ke pos komando sementara.

data.Korean: 농장으로 가기 전에, 관문 앞 기록을 정리하자.
data.English: Before we head to the farms, let us sort out the records from the gate front.
data.Thai: ก่อนจะไปฟาร์ม เรามาจัดระเบียบบันทึกหน้าประตูก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Trước khi đến nông trại, hãy tổng hợp ghi chép ở trước cổng đã.
data.Indonesian: Sebelum menuju pertanian, mari rapikan catatan dari depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 응. 신호석 반응도 같이 확인할게.
data.English: Yeah. I will check the signal stone responses too.
data.Thai: อืม ฉันจะตรวจปฏิกิริยาของศิลาสัญญาณด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi cũng sẽ kiểm tra phản ứng của đá tín hiệu.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Aku juga akan memeriksa respons batu sinyal.

data.Korean: 어느 길로 갈라졌는지 확인해 보자.
data.English: Let us check which road they split off onto.
data.Thai: ลองตรวจดูว่าพวกมันแยกไปทางไหนกันเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kiểm tra xem chúng đã tách sang con đường nào.
data.Indonesian: Mari periksa mereka bercabang ke jalan mana.

data.Korean: 좋아. 정리가 끝나면 바로 농장으로 가자!
data.English: All right. Once we are done sorting this out, let us head straight to the farms!
data.Thai: ดีเลย พอจัดการเสร็จแล้ว เราไปฟาร์มกันทันที!
data.Vietnamese: Được. Khi tổng hợp xong thì đi thẳng đến nông trại luôn!
data.Indonesian: Baik. Begitu beres, langsung berangkat ke pertanian!

data.Korean: 흔적은 내가 계속 볼게.
data.English: I will keep watching the traces.
data.Thai: ฉันจะคอยดูร่องรอยต่อไป
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ tiếp tục theo dõi dấu vết.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan terus mengawasi jejaknya.

data.Korean: 그럼 정리부터 빨리 끝내자.
data.English: Then let us hurry and finish sorting this out.
data.Thai: งั้นรีบจัดการให้เสร็จก่อนเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy hãy nhanh chóng tổng hợp cho xong đã.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, cepat selesaikan penataan ini dulu.

data.Korean: 늦어질수록 쉬는 시간도 멀어지니까...
data.English: The longer this takes, the farther break time gets...
data.Thai: ยิ่งช้า เวลาพักก็ยิ่งห่างออกไป...
data.Vietnamese: Càng chậm thì giờ nghỉ càng xa thêm...
data.Indonesian: Makin lama, waktu istirahat juga makin menjauh...

data.Korean: 관문 안쪽 주민들은 대부분 대피했습니다.
data.English: Most of the residents inside the gate have evacuated.
data.Thai: ชาวบ้านด้านในประตูส่วนใหญ่อพยพแล้วครับ
data.Vietnamese: Phần lớn cư dân bên trong cổng đã sơ tán.
data.Indonesian: Sebagian besar warga di dalam gerbang sudah dievakuasi.

data.Korean: 다친 사람은 적지만, 물자 수레가 꽤 흔들렸습니다.
data.English: There are few injured, but the supply carts were shaken up badly.
data.Thai: ผู้บาดเจ็บมีไม่มาก แต่รถเสบียงสั่นสะเทือนไปพอสมควรครับ
data.Vietnamese: Người bị thương không nhiều, nhưng các xe chở vật tư bị xóc khá mạnh.
data.Indonesian: Yang terluka sedikit, tetapi gerobak persediaan terguncang cukup parah.

data.Korean: 다친 사람이 적은 건 다행이네.
data.English: It is a relief that there are not many injured.
data.Thai: มีคนบาดเจ็บน้อยก็นับว่าโล่งใจนะ
data.Vietnamese: Ít người bị thương là may rồi.
data.Indonesian: Syukurlah tidak banyak yang terluka.

data.Korean: 수레까지 치료하라고 하면 나도 곤란하니까...
data.English: If they ask me to treat the carts too, I will be in trouble...
data.Thai: ถ้าบอกให้ฉันรักษารถเสบียงด้วย ฉันก็คงลำบากเหมือนกัน...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu họ bảo tôi chữa cả xe hàng thì tôi cũng khó xử lắm...
data.Indonesian: Kalau aku diminta merawat gerobaknya juga, itu akan merepotkan...

data.Korean: 피해는 작게 막았어.
data.English: We kept the damage small.
data.Thai: เราคุมความเสียหายให้อยู่ในวงแคบได้
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã giữ thiệt hại ở mức thấp.
data.Indonesian: Kita berhasil menahan kerusakan tetap kecil.

data.Korean: 이제 문제는 이 무리가 어느 길로 이어졌는지야.
data.English: Now the question is which road this group leads to.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้ปัญหาคือฝูงนี้เชื่อมต่อไปทางไหน
data.Vietnamese: Giờ vấn đề là bầy này nối sang con đường nào.
data.Indonesian: Sekarang masalahnya, gerombolan ini terhubung ke jalan mana.

data.Korean: 발자국도 관문 밖에서 계속 이어져 있어.
data.English: The footprints continue outside the gate too.
data.Thai: รอยเท้ายังต่อออกไปนอกประตูด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân cũng tiếp tục ra ngoài cổng.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kakinya juga berlanjut ke luar gerbang.

data.Korean: 멈춰 서거나 주변을 맴돈 흔적은 거의 없어.
data.English: There are almost no signs that they stopped or circled around.
data.Thai: แทบไม่มีร่องรอยว่าพวกมันหยุดหรือวนอยู่รอบ ๆ
data.Vietnamese: Hầu như không có dấu hiệu chúng dừng lại hay đi vòng quanh.
data.Indonesian: Hampir tidak ada tanda mereka berhenti atau berputar-putar.

data.Korean: 그럼 시에스 때처럼, 밀려오던 무리를 여기서 막은 거네.
data.English: Then, like at Cies, we stopped the incoming group here.
data.Thai: งั้นก็เหมือนตอนที่ซีเอส เราหยุดฝูงที่ถูกต้อนมาที่นี่สินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy giống như ở Cies, chúng ta đã chặn bầy bị đẩy tới ngay tại đây.
data.Indonesian: Berarti seperti di Cies, kita menghentikan gerombolan yang datang di sini.

data.Korean: 응. 하지만 제플은 길이 더 많아.
data.English: Yeah. But Jeple has more roads.
data.Thai: อืม แต่เจเพิลมีถนนมากกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Nhưng Jeple có nhiều đường hơn.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Tapi Jeple punya lebih banyak jalan.

data.Korean: 관문에서 막아도 다른 길로 갈라질 수 있어.
data.English: Even if we block them at the gate, they can split off onto other roads.
data.Thai: ถึงเราจะหยุดพวกมันที่ประตูได้ พวกมันก็อาจแยกไปทางอื่น
data.Vietnamese: Dù chặn ở cổng, chúng vẫn có thể tách sang đường khác.
data.Indonesian: Meski kita menahan mereka di gerbang, mereka bisa bercabang ke jalan lain.

data.Korean: 관문 방어 기록은 정리해 둬.
data.English: Keep the gate defense records organized.
data.Thai: จัดบันทึกการป้องกันประตูไว้ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Hãy tổng hợp ghi chép phòng thủ cổng.
data.Indonesian: Rapikan catatan pertahanan gerbang.

data.Korean: 시에스 기록과 함께 비교하자.
data.English: Let us compare them with the Cies records.
data.Thai: เอาไปเปรียบเทียบกับบันทึกของซีเอสกัน
data.Vietnamese: Hãy so sánh với ghi chép ở Cies.
data.Indonesian: Mari bandingkan dengan catatan Cies.

data.Korean: 비교하면 갈라진 지점을 찾을 수 있을 거야.
data.English: If we compare them, we should be able to find the point where they split off.
data.Thai: ถ้าเปรียบเทียบกัน น่าจะหาจุดที่แยกออกไปได้
data.Vietnamese: Nếu so sánh, ta có thể tìm được điểm chúng tách ra.
data.Indonesian: Kalau dibandingkan, kita seharusnya bisa menemukan titik percabangannya.

data.Korean: 지휘관님, 농장 지대에서 추가 보고입니다.
data.English: Commander, we have an additional report from the farm district.
data.Thai: ท่านผู้บัญชาการ มีรายงานเพิ่มเติมจากเขตฟาร์มครับ
data.Vietnamese: Thưa Chỉ huy, có báo cáo bổ sung từ khu nông trại.
data.Indonesian: Komandan, ada laporan tambahan dari area pertanian.

data.Korean: 울타리가 여러 곳 밀렸고, 몬스터들이 밭 사이로 지나가고 있다고 합니다.
data.English: Fences have been pushed in at several places, and monsters are passing between the fields.
data.Thai: รั้วหลายจุดถูกดันพัง และมอนสเตอร์กำลังผ่านระหว่างไร่นาครับ
data.Vietnamese: Hàng rào bị xô lệch ở nhiều chỗ, và quái vật đang đi qua giữa các ruộng.
data.Indonesian: Pagar di beberapa tempat terdorong roboh, dan monster melewati sela-sela ladang.

data.Korean: 밭 사이로? 사람들은?
data.English: Between the fields? What about the people?
data.Thai: ระหว่างไร่นาเหรอ? แล้วผู้คนล่ะ?
data.Vietnamese: Giữa các ruộng à? Người dân thì sao?
data.Indonesian: Di sela-sela ladang? Orang-orang bagaimana?

data.Korean: 관리인들이 대피시키고 있지만, 농장 길이 넓어서 막기 어렵다고 합니다.
data.English: The managers are evacuating them, but the farm roads are wide, so they are difficult to block.
data.Thai: พวกผู้ดูแลกำลังอพยพคนอยู่ แต่ถนนในฟาร์มกว้าง จึงสกัดได้ยากครับ
data.Vietnamese: Các quản lý đang sơ tán họ, nhưng đường nông trại rộng nên rất khó chặn.
data.Indonesian: Para pengelola sedang mengevakuasi mereka, tetapi jalan pertanian lebar sehingga sulit diblokir.

data.Korean: 흔적이 바로 갈라졌구나.
data.English: The traces split off right away.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยแยกออกไปทันทีเลยสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết đã tách ra ngay lập tức.
data.Indonesian: Jejaknya langsung bercabang.

data.Korean: 농장 지대 쪽부터 확인하자.
data.English: Let us check the farm district first.
data.Thai: ตรวจเขตฟาร์มก่อนเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kiểm tra khu nông trại trước.
data.Indonesian: Mari periksa area pertanian dulu.

data.Korean: 밭길이면 발도 빠질 텐데...
data.English: On field paths, your feet can sink in...
data.Thai: ทางในไร่เท้าอาจจมลงไปได้ด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Đường ruộng có thể làm chân bị lún xuống...
data.Indonesian: Di jalan ladang, kaki bisa terbenam...

data.Korean: 오늘 신발은 포기해야겠어.
data.English: I guess today's shoes are done for.
data.Thai: ดูท่าว่ารองเท้าวันนี้คงไม่รอดแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chắc đôi giày hôm nay coi như xong rồi.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya sepatu hari ini harus direlakan.

data.Korean: 방어 기록을 정리하고 바로 이동하자.
data.English: Let us organize the defense records and move right away.
data.Thai: จัดบันทึกการป้องกันแล้วออกเดินทางทันที
data.Vietnamese: Hãy tổng hợp ghi chép phòng thủ rồi di chuyển ngay.
data.Indonesian: Rapikan catatan pertahanan, lalu segera bergerak.

data.Korean: 영구 강화 선택 UI가 열린다.
data.English: The permanent enhancement selection UI opens.
data.Thai: UI เลือกการเสริมพลังถาวรเปิดขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: UI chọn cường hóa vĩnh viễn mở ra.
data.Indonesian: UI pilihan peningkatan permanen terbuka.

data.Korean: 선택 예시: 세라 공격력 증가 / 스파인 방어력 증가 / 엘리스 체력 증가.
data.English: Selection examples: Serah attack increase / Spayne defense increase / Alice HP increase.
data.Thai: ตัวอย่างตัวเลือก: เพิ่มพลังโจมตีเซราห์ / เพิ่มพลังป้องกันสไปน์ / เพิ่ม HP อลิซ
data.Vietnamese: Ví dụ lựa chọn: tăng công kích cho Serah / tăng phòng thủ cho Spayne / tăng HP cho Alice.
data.Indonesian: Contoh pilihan: peningkatan serangan Serah / peningkatan pertahanan Spayne / peningkatan HP Alice.

data.Korean: 선택한 강화는 이후 전투에도 유지된다.
data.English: The selected enhancement remains in later battles.
data.Thai: การเสริมพลังที่เลือกจะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อ ๆ ไป
data.Vietnamese: Cường hóa đã chọn sẽ duy trì trong các trận chiến sau.
data.Indonesian: Peningkatan yang dipilih akan tetap berlaku di pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 수호대 분들이십니까? 이쪽입니다!
data.English: Are you the Guardians? This way, please!
data.Thai: ทุกท่านจากหน่วยพิทักษ์ใช่ไหมครับ? เชิญทางนี้ครับ!
data.Vietnamese: Các vị là Đội Hộ vệ phải không ạ? Lối này!
data.Indonesian: Apakah Anda para Penjaga? Lewat sini!

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 울타리를 부수고 밭 사이로 지나갔습니다.
data.English: The monsters broke the fence and passed between the fields.
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์พังรั้วแล้วผ่านไประหว่างไร่นาครับ
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật đã phá hàng rào và đi qua giữa các ruộng.
data.Indonesian: Monster menghancurkan pagar dan lewat di sela-sela ladang.

data.Korean: 사람들은 다 대피했어?
data.English: Did everyone evacuate?
data.Thai: ทุกคนอพยพหมดแล้วใช่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Mọi người đã sơ tán hết chưa?
data.Indonesian: Semua orang sudah dievakuasi?

data.Korean: 가까운 사람들은 대피시켰습니다.
data.English: The nearby people have been evacuated.
data.Thai: คนที่อยู่ใกล้ ๆ อพยพแล้วครับ
data.Vietnamese: Những người ở gần đã được sơ tán.
data.Indonesian: Orang-orang terdekat sudah dievakuasi.

data.Korean: 하지만 작업 창고 쪽 길은 아직 대피가 끝나지 않았습니다.
data.English: But evacuation is not finished yet along the road by the work shed.
data.Thai: แต่ทางฝั่งโรงเก็บอุปกรณ์ยังอพยพไม่เสร็จครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng việc sơ tán ở con đường phía nhà kho dụng cụ vẫn chưa xong.
data.Indonesian: Tapi evakuasi di jalan dekat gudang kerja belum selesai.

data.Korean: 작물을 뜯어 먹은 흔적은 거의 없어.
data.English: There are almost no signs that they ate the crops.
data.Thai: แทบไม่มีร่องรอยว่าพวกมันกินพืชผล
data.Vietnamese: Hầu như không có dấu hiệu chúng ăn hoa màu.
data.Indonesian: Hampir tidak ada tanda mereka memakan tanaman.

data.Korean: 그냥 지나가면서 밀어낸 쪽에 가까워.
data.English: It is closer to them simply pushing through as they passed.
data.Thai: ดูใกล้เคียงกับการดันผ่านไปเฉย ๆ มากกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Gần như chúng chỉ xô đẩy mọi thứ khi đi ngang qua.
data.Indonesian: Lebih seperti mereka hanya mendorong lewat saat melintas.

data.Korean: 농장 길이 넓은 게 오히려 문제야.
data.English: The wide farm roads are the problem instead.
data.Thai: ถนนฟาร์มที่กว้างกลับเป็นปัญหา
data.Vietnamese: Đường nông trại rộng lại chính là vấn đề.
data.Indonesian: Jalan pertanian yang lebar justru menjadi masalah.

data.Korean: 막을 곳이 많으면, 새는 길도 그만큼 많아져.
data.English: The more places there are to block, the more paths there are for them to slip through.
data.Thai: ยิ่งมีจุดต้องสกัดมาก ทางที่พวกมันหลุดรอดไปได้ก็ยิ่งมาก
data.Vietnamese: Càng có nhiều chỗ phải chặn, càng có nhiều đường để chúng lọt qua.
data.Indonesian: Makin banyak tempat yang harus diblokir, makin banyak jalan bagi mereka untuk lolos.

data.Korean: 밭길은 보기보다 발이 잘 빠져.
data.English: Field paths make your feet sink in more easily than they look.
data.Thai: ทางในไร่ดูดเท้าได้ง่ายกว่าที่เห็นนะ
data.Vietnamese: Đường ruộng dễ lún chân hơn vẻ ngoài.
data.Indonesian: Jalan ladang membuat kaki lebih mudah terbenam daripada kelihatannya.

data.Korean: 넘어지면 다친 곳보다 옷이 먼저 심각해질 수도 있어...
data.English: If you fall, your clothes might end up worse off than your injuries...
data.Thai: ถ้าล้มขึ้นมา เสื้อผ้าอาจหนักกว่าแผลก่อนก็ได้...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu ngã, quần áo có khi còn nghiêm trọng hơn chỗ bị thương...
data.Indonesian: Kalau jatuh, pakaian bisa lebih parah duluan daripada lukanya...

data.Korean: 좋아. 그럼 작업 창고 앞에서 막자!
data.English: All right. Then let us stop them in front of the work shed!
data.Thai: ดีเลย งั้นหยุดพวกมันหน้าโรงเก็บอุปกรณ์กัน!
data.Vietnamese: Được. Vậy chặn chúng trước nhà kho dụng cụ!
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kalau begitu, kita tahan mereka di depan gudang kerja!

data.Korean: 작업 창고 쪽으로는 못 가게 할게!
data.English: I will not let them get toward the work shed!
data.Thai: ฉันจะไม่ให้พวกมันไปทางโรงเก็บอุปกรณ์!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ không để chúng đi về phía nhà kho dụng cụ!
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak akan membiarkan mereka menuju gudang kerja!

data.Korean: 관리인은 사람들을 작업 창고 반대편으로 대피시켜 줘.
data.English: Manager, please evacuate the people to the opposite side of the work shed.
data.Thai: คุณผู้ดูแล ช่วยอพยพคนไปทางฝั่งตรงข้ามของโรงเก็บอุปกรณ์
data.Vietnamese: Quản lý, hãy sơ tán mọi người sang phía đối diện nhà kho dụng cụ.
data.Indonesian: Pengelola, tolong evakuasi orang-orang ke sisi seberang gudang kerja.

data.Korean: 우리는 밭 사이로 들어오는 무리를 막자.
data.English: We will stop the group coming in between the fields.
data.Thai: พวกเราจะหยุดฝูงที่เข้ามาระหว่างไร่นา
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta sẽ chặn bầy đang tiến vào giữa các ruộng.
data.Indonesian: Kita tahan gerombolan yang masuk di antara ladang.

data.Korean: 알겠습니다. 작업 창고 반대편 길로 안내하겠습니다.
data.English: Understood. I will guide them to the road on the opposite side of the work shed.
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้วครับ ผมจะนำทางไปยังถนนฝั่งตรงข้ามของโรงเก็บอุปกรณ์
data.Vietnamese: Tôi hiểu. Tôi sẽ dẫn họ sang con đường phía đối diện nhà kho dụng cụ.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Saya akan memandu mereka ke jalan di seberang gudang kerja.

data.Korean: 발자국이 두 갈래야.
data.English: The footprints split into two paths.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าแยกเป็นสองทาง
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân tách thành hai nhánh.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki terbagi dua.

data.Korean: 큰 무리의 흔적은 밭 가운데로 이어지고, 작은 무리의 흔적은 울타리 옆으로 이어졌어.
data.English: The large group's tracks lead through the middle of the fields, and the small group's tracks lead along the fence.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของฝูงใหญ่ต่อไปกลางไร่นา ส่วนร่องรอยของฝูงเล็กต่อไปข้างรั้ว
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết của bầy lớn dẫn vào giữa các ruộng, còn dấu vết của bầy nhỏ dẫn dọc theo hàng rào.
data.Indonesian: Jejak gerombolan besar mengarah ke tengah ladang, dan jejak gerombolan kecil mengarah di samping pagar.

data.Korean: 울타리 옆으로 빠진 쪽부터 막지 않으면 주민 대피로와 겹쳐.
data.English: If we do not stop the ones moving along the fence first, they will overlap with the residents' evacuation route.
data.Thai: ถ้าไม่หยุดฝั่งที่หลุดไปตามรั้วก่อน มันจะทับกับเส้นทางอพยพของชาวบ้าน
data.Vietnamese: Nếu không chặn phía đi dọc hàng rào trước, chúng sẽ trùng với đường sơ tán của cư dân.
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita tidak menghentikan yang bergerak di sepanjang pagar lebih dulu, jalurnya akan bertumpuk dengan jalur evakuasi warga.

data.Korean: 세라, 앞쪽 울타리 안쪽을 잡아줘.
data.English: Serah, take the inside of the front fence.
data.Thai: เซราห์ ช่วยจับตำแหน่งด้านในรั้วข้างหน้าที
data.Vietnamese: Serah, giữ phía trong hàng rào đằng trước.
data.Indonesian: Serah, ambil posisi di bagian dalam pagar depan.

data.Korean: 맡겨 둬! 울타리 너머로는 못 보내!
data.English: Leave it to me! I will not let them past the fence!
data.Thai: ฝากได้เลย! ฉันไม่ให้พวกมันข้ามรั้วไปแน่!
data.Vietnamese: Cứ giao cho tôi! Tôi sẽ không để chúng vượt qua hàng rào!
data.Indonesian: Serahkan padaku! Aku tidak akan membiarkan mereka melewati pagar!

data.Korean: 너무 멀리 나가진 마.
data.English: Do not go too far.
data.Thai: อย่าออกไปไกลเกินไปนะ
data.Vietnamese: Đừng đi quá xa.
data.Indonesian: Jangan bergerak terlalu jauh.

data.Korean: 진흙에 빠진 사람을 끌어내는 건 치료보다 힘들어...
data.English: Pulling someone out of mud is harder than treating them...
data.Thai: การดึงคนที่ติดโคลนออกมา ยากกว่ารักษาอีก...
data.Vietnamese: Kéo người bị lún trong bùn ra còn mệt hơn chữa trị...
data.Indonesian: Menarik orang keluar dari lumpur lebih sulit daripada merawat luka...

data.Korean: 움직임이 가까워져.
data.English: The movement is getting closer.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวใกล้เข้ามาแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động đang lại gần.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakannya makin dekat.

data.Korean: 밭 가운데로 그대로 들어오고 있어.
data.English: They are coming straight into the middle of the fields.
data.Thai: พวกมันกำลังเข้ามากลางไร่นาตรง ๆ
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang tiến thẳng vào giữa các ruộng.
data.Indonesian: Mereka masuk lurus ke tengah ladang.

data.Korean: 좋아. 밭 사이 길에서 막자.
data.English: All right. Let us stop them on the path between the fields.
data.Thai: ดี เราจะหยุดพวกมันที่ทางระหว่างไร่นา
data.Vietnamese: Được. Chặn chúng trên đường giữa các ruộng.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kita tahan mereka di jalan di antara ladang.

data.Korean: 대피로와 겹치기 전에 끝내자.
data.English: Let us finish this before they cross the evacuation route.
data.Thai: จบเรื่องก่อนมันจะทับกับทางอพยพกัน
data.Vietnamese: Kết thúc trước khi chúng chồng lên đường sơ tán.
data.Indonesian: Selesaikan sebelum mereka bertemu dengan jalur evakuasi.

data.Korean: 작업 창고 쪽 피해는 막았습니다.
data.English: We prevented damage near the work shed.
data.Thai: เราป้องกันความเสียหายทางโรงเก็บอุปกรณ์ไว้ได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Chúng tôi đã ngăn thiệt hại ở phía nhà kho dụng cụ.
data.Indonesian: Kerusakan di sisi gudang kerja berhasil kami cegah.

data.Korean: 사람들도 크게 다치지 않았습니다.
data.English: The people were not badly hurt either.
data.Thai: ผู้คนก็ไม่ได้บาดเจ็บหนักครับ
data.Vietnamese: Người dân cũng không bị thương nặng.
data.Indonesian: Orang-orang juga tidak terluka parah.

data.Korean: 다행이다.
data.English: That is a relief.
data.Thai: โล่งอกไปที
data.Vietnamese: May quá.
data.Indonesian: Syukurlah.

data.Korean: 울타리가 저렇게 밀릴 정도면, 근처에 사람이 있었으면 위험했겠네.
data.English: If the fence was pushed in that much, anyone nearby would have been in danger.
data.Thai: ถ้ารั้วถูกดันจนเป็นแบบนั้น คนที่อยู่ใกล้ ๆ คงอันตรายมาก
data.Vietnamese: Hàng rào bị xô lệch đến mức đó, nếu có người ở gần thì đã nguy hiểm rồi.
data.Indonesian: Kalau pagar terdorong sampai seperti itu, orang di dekatnya pasti dalam bahaya.

data.Korean: 응. 몬스터들이 멈춰서 싸우려 한 흔적은 적어.
data.English: Yeah. There are few signs that the monsters stopped to fight.
data.Thai: อืม ร่องรอยที่มอนสเตอร์หยุดสู้มีน้อย
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Có rất ít dấu hiệu quái vật dừng lại để chiến đấu.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Hanya sedikit tanda bahwa monster berhenti untuk bertarung.

data.Korean: 길을 잃은 것처럼 계속 앞으로 밀려왔어.
data.English: They kept being driven forward like they were lost.
data.Thai: พวกมันถูกดันไปข้างหน้าเรื่อย ๆ เหมือนหลงทาง
data.Vietnamese: Chúng cứ bị đẩy về phía trước như thể lạc đường.
data.Indonesian: Mereka terus terdorong maju seperti tersesat.

data.Korean: 농장 지형 때문에 발자국이 갈라졌어.
data.English: The farm terrain split the footprints.
data.Thai: ภูมิประเทศของฟาร์มทำให้รอยเท้าแยกออก
data.Vietnamese: Địa hình nông trại khiến dấu chân tách ra.
data.Indonesian: Medan pertanian membuat jejak kaki bercabang.

data.Korean: 한쪽은 우리가 막았지만, 다른 흔적은 시장 거리 쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: We stopped one side, but the other trail continues toward the market street.
data.Thai: ฝั่งหนึ่งเราหยุดไว้แล้ว แต่ร่องรอยอีกฝั่งต่อไปทางถนนตลาด
data.Vietnamese: Một phía thì chúng ta đã chặn, nhưng dấu vết còn lại dẫn về phía phố chợ.
data.Indonesian: Satu sisi sudah kita hentikan, tetapi jejak lainnya mengarah ke jalan pasar.

data.Korean: 시장이면 사람이 더 많겠지...?
data.English: If it is the market, there will be more people... right?
data.Thai: ถ้าเป็นตลาด คนคงเยอะกว่านี้...ใช่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Nếu là chợ thì người sẽ đông hơn... đúng không?
data.Indonesian: Kalau pasar, orangnya pasti lebih banyak... kan?

data.Korean: 밭보다 걷기는 낫겠지만, 사람도 짐도 더 많겠네.
data.English: It should be easier to walk than the fields, but there will be more people and baggage too.
data.Thai: เดินง่ายกว่าในไร่ก็จริง แต่คนกับสัมภาระก็คงเยอะกว่าด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Đi lại chắc dễ hơn ngoài ruộng, nhưng người và hành lý cũng sẽ nhiều hơn.
data.Indonesian: Berjalan mungkin lebih mudah daripada di ladang, tapi orang dan barang bawaan juga akan lebih banyak.

data.Korean: 시장 쪽에는 아직 대피하지 못한 상인들이 있을 겁니다.
data.English: There are merchants on the market side who still have not evacuated.
data.Thai: ฝั่งตลาดยังมีพ่อค้าแม่ค้าที่ยังอพยพไม่ได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Ở phía chợ vẫn còn thương nhân chưa sơ tán được.
data.Indonesian: Di sisi pasar masih ada pedagang yang belum bisa dievakuasi.

data.Korean: 짐을 두고 바로 움직이기 어려운 사람들도 많습니다.
data.English: Many people will have trouble moving right away if they leave their goods behind.
data.Thai: มีหลายคนที่ขยับออกทันทีได้ยาก เพราะทิ้งของไว้ไม่ได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Cũng có nhiều người khó di chuyển ngay vì không thể bỏ hàng hóa lại.
data.Indonesian: Banyak juga yang sulit langsung bergerak karena tidak bisa meninggalkan barang.

data.Korean: 그럼 빨리 가야 해.
data.English: Then we have to hurry.
data.Thai: งั้นต้องรีบไป
data.Vietnamese: Vậy phải đi nhanh.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu kita harus cepat.

data.Korean: 사람들이 많은 곳으로 들어가면 더 위험해져.
data.English: If they get into a crowded place, it will become more dangerous.
data.Thai: ถ้าพวกมันเข้าไปในที่ที่มีคนเยอะ จะอันตรายขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chúng đi vào nơi đông người, sẽ nguy hiểm hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jika mereka masuk ke tempat yang ramai, bahayanya akan bertambah.

data.Korean: 발자국은 시장 큰길로 이어져 있어.
data.English: The footprints lead to the market main road.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าต่อไปยังถนนใหญ่ตลาด
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân dẫn đến đường lớn của chợ.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki mengarah ke jalan utama pasar.

data.Korean: 일부는 수레가 다니는 길을 따라갔어.
data.English: Some followed the road used by carts.
data.Thai: บางส่วนตามทางที่รถเข็นใช้
data.Vietnamese: Một số đi theo đường xe hàng.
data.Indonesian: Sebagian mengikuti jalan yang dilalui gerobak.

data.Korean: 몬스터가 사람을 고른 게 아니라, 사람이 쓰는 길로 밀려온 거야.
data.English: The monsters did not choose people. They were driven onto the roads people use.
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์ไม่ได้เลือกคน แต่ถูกดันเข้ามาตามทางที่คนใช้
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật không chọn người; chúng bị đẩy vào con đường con người sử dụng.
data.Indonesian: Monster bukan memilih orang. Mereka terdorong ke jalan yang digunakan orang.

data.Korean: 그래서 막는 쪽도 더 까다로워져.
data.English: That makes stopping them more difficult too.
data.Thai: เพราะงั้นการสกัดพวกมันก็ยุ่งยากขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Vì vậy việc chặn chúng cũng khó hơn.
data.Indonesian: Karena itu, cara menghentikannya juga jadi lebih sulit.

data.Korean: 농장 지대는 관리인에게 맡기고, 우리는 시장 거리로 이동하자.
data.English: Let us leave the farm district to the managers and move to the market street.
data.Thai: เขตฟาร์มให้ผู้ดูแลจัดการ ส่วนพวกเราไปถนนตลาดกัน
data.Vietnamese: Hãy giao khu nông trại cho quản lý, còn chúng ta di chuyển đến phố chợ.
data.Indonesian: Serahkan area pertanian kepada pengelola, dan kita pindah ke jalan pasar.

data.Korean: 시장이면 다친 사람 찾는 것도 일이겠네.
data.English: If it is the market, even finding injured people will be work.
data.Thai: ถ้าเป็นตลาด แม้แต่การหาคนเจ็บก็คงเป็นงานหนัก
data.Vietnamese: Nếu là chợ, tìm người bị thương cũng sẽ thành một việc lớn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau pasar, mencari orang terluka juga bakal jadi pekerjaan.

data.Korean: 사람 찾는 걸 일이라고 생각하지 마.
data.English: Do not think of finding people as just work.
data.Thai: อย่าคิดว่าการตามหาคนเป็นแค่งาน
data.Vietnamese: Đừng xem việc tìm người là một công việc đơn thuần.
data.Indonesian: Jangan anggap mencari orang itu sekadar pekerjaan.

data.Korean: 으... 찾는 것부터 오래 걸리면 치료도 늦어지니까.
data.English: Ugh... If finding them takes too long, treatment will be delayed too.
data.Thai: อืม... ถ้าแค่หาก็ใช้เวลานาน การรักษาก็จะช้าลงด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Ừm... Nếu tìm thôi đã mất lâu, việc chữa trị cũng sẽ chậm.
data.Indonesian: Ugh... Kalau mencari mereka saja lama, perawatan juga akan terlambat.

data.Korean: 이쪽입니다! 수레가 길을 막고 있습니다!
data.English: This way! A cart is blocking the road!
data.Thai: ทางนี้ครับ! มีรถเข็นขวางถนนอยู่!
data.Vietnamese: Lối này! Xe hàng đang chặn đường!
data.Indonesian: Lewat sini! Ada gerobak menghalangi jalan!

data.Korean: 주민들은 안쪽 골목으로 이동 중입니다.
data.English: The residents are moving into the inner alleys.
data.Thai: ชาวบ้านกำลังเคลื่อนไปยังตรอกด้านในครับ
data.Vietnamese: Cư dân đang di chuyển vào các hẻm bên trong.
data.Indonesian: Warga sedang bergerak ke gang bagian dalam.

data.Korean: 하지만 시장 큰길이 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.
data.English: But the market main road has not been cleared yet.
data.Thai: แต่ถนนใหญ่ตลาดยังจัดการไม่เรียบร้อยครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng đường lớn của chợ vẫn chưa được dọn xong.
data.Indonesian: Tapi jalan utama pasar belum dibersihkan.

data.Korean: 사람들이 먼저야.
data.English: People come first.
data.Thai: คนต้องมาก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Người dân là ưu tiên.
data.Indonesian: Orang-orang lebih dulu.

data.Korean: 우리가 수레를 밀어서라도 치우자!
data.English: Let us move the carts ourselves, even if we have to push them!
data.Thai: เราช่วยกันดันรถเข็นออกไปเองก็ได้!
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta sẽ đẩy xe hàng ra, dù phải tự làm!
data.Indonesian: Kita singkirkan gerobaknya, meski harus mendorongnya sendiri!

data.Korean: 무거운 수레를 급하게 밀면 허리부터 나갈 텐데...
data.English: If we rush to push heavy carts, our backs will give out first...
data.Thai: ถ้ารีบดันรถเข็นหนัก ๆ หลังคงพังก่อนแน่...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu vội đẩy xe hàng nặng, lưng sẽ hỏng trước mất...
data.Indonesian: Kalau mendorong gerobak berat terburu-buru, punggung bisa menyerah duluan...

data.Korean: 그래도 몬스터한테 밀리는 것보단 낫겠지.
data.English: Still, that is better than being pushed by monsters.
data.Thai: แต่ก็คงดีกว่าถูกมอนสเตอร์ดันล่ะนะ
data.Vietnamese: Dù vậy vẫn tốt hơn bị quái vật đẩy.
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, itu lebih baik daripada didorong monster.

data.Korean: 농장 쪽 발자국이 여기로 이어져 있어.
data.English: The footprints from the farm side lead here.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าจากฝั่งฟาร์มต่อมาถึงที่นี่
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân từ phía nông trại dẫn đến đây.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki dari sisi pertanian mengarah ke sini.

data.Korean: 좌판을 피한 게 아니라, 빈틈을 따라 들어온 것 같아.
data.English: It does not look like they avoided the stalls. It looks like they came in along the gaps.
data.Thai: ไม่ใช่ว่าพวกมันหลบแผงลอย แต่น่าจะเข้ามาตามช่องว่าง
data.Vietnamese: Không phải chúng tránh các sạp hàng, mà có vẻ chúng đi vào theo các khe trống.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya mereka bukan menghindari lapak, tapi masuk mengikuti celah kosong.

data.Korean: 시장 큰길은 상인들이 장사하는 곳이면서, 주민들이 빠져나가는 대피로야.
data.English: The market main road is where merchants do business, and also the evacuation route residents use to get out.
data.Thai: ถนนใหญ่ตลาดเป็นที่ที่พ่อค้าแม่ค้าขายของ และเป็นทางอพยพให้ชาวบ้านออกไปด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Đường lớn của chợ là nơi thương nhân buôn bán, đồng thời là đường sơ tán để cư dân thoát ra.
data.Indonesian: Jalan utama pasar adalah tempat para pedagang berjualan, sekaligus jalur evakuasi bagi warga untuk keluar.

data.Korean: 몬스터가 시장 큰길에 끼어들면, 노리지 않아도 피해가 생겨.
data.English: If monsters get into the market main road, there will be damage even if they are not aiming for anyone.
data.Thai: ถ้ามอนสเตอร์แทรกเข้าถนนใหญ่ตลาด ต่อให้ไม่ได้เล็งใครก็เกิดความเสียหายได้
data.Vietnamese: Nếu quái vật chen vào đường lớn của chợ, dù không nhắm vào ai thì vẫn sẽ gây thiệt hại.
data.Indonesian: Jika monster masuk ke jalan utama pasar, kerusakan tetap akan terjadi meski mereka tidak mengincar siapa pun.

data.Korean: 대피로는 열어 둔 채 방어선을 잡자.
data.English: Let us form a defensive line while keeping the evacuation route open.
data.Thai: ตั้งแนวป้องกันโดยเปิดทางอพยพไว้
data.Vietnamese: Hãy lập tuyến phòng thủ trong khi vẫn giữ đường sơ tán mở.
data.Indonesian: Mari buat garis pertahanan sambil tetap membuka jalur evakuasi.

data.Korean: 큰길은 열어 두고, 들어오는 무리는 시장 입구에서 막자.
data.English: Keep the main road open, and stop the incoming group at the market entrance.
data.Thai: เปิดถนนใหญ่ไว้ แล้วหยุดฝูงที่เข้ามาตรงทางเข้าตลาด
data.Vietnamese: Giữ đường lớn thông thoáng, và chặn bầy tiến vào ở lối vào chợ.
data.Indonesian: Biarkan jalan utama tetap terbuka, dan hentikan gerombolan yang masuk di pintu masuk pasar.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 사람들이 지나갈 길은 남겨 둘게!
data.English: Got it. I will leave a path for people to pass!
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ฉันจะเหลือทางให้ผู้คนผ่าน!
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Tôi sẽ chừa đường cho mọi người đi qua!
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Aku akan menyisakan jalan untuk orang-orang lewat!

data.Korean: 세라가 전방을 잡으면, 나는 좌판 사이로 새는 쪽을 볼게.
data.English: If Serah takes the front, I will watch the ones slipping between the stalls.
data.Thai: ถ้าเซราห์ยืนแนวหน้า ฉันจะดูฝั่งที่เล็ดลอดระหว่างแผงลอย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu Serah giữ phía trước, tôi sẽ để ý phía lọt qua giữa các sạp hàng.
data.Indonesian: Kalau Serah mengambil bagian depan, aku akan mengawasi yang lolos di antara lapak.

data.Korean: 지붕 위 움직임도 확인할게.
data.English: I will check the movement on the rooftops too.
data.Thai: ฉันจะตรวจการเคลื่อนไหวบนหลังคาด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cũng sẽ kiểm tra chuyển động trên mái nhà.
data.Indonesian: Aku juga akan memeriksa pergerakan di atas atap.

data.Korean: 시장은 시야가 막히는 곳이 많아.
data.English: There are many places in the market where visibility is blocked.
data.Thai: ในตลาดมีหลายจุดที่บังสายตา
data.Vietnamese: Trong chợ có nhiều chỗ bị che khuất tầm nhìn.
data.Indonesian: Di pasar ada banyak tempat yang menghalangi pandangan.

data.Korean: 다친 사람은 방어선 안쪽으로 보내줘.
data.English: Send injured people inside the defensive line.
data.Thai: ส่งคนเจ็บเข้ามาด้านในแนวป้องกัน
data.Vietnamese: Đưa người bị thương vào bên trong tuyến phòng thủ.
data.Indonesian: Kirim orang yang terluka ke dalam garis pertahanan.

data.Korean: 좌판 옆에서 버티고 있으면 내가 찾기 힘들어...
data.English: If they hold out beside the stalls, it will be hard for me to find them...
data.Thai: ถ้าฝืนอยู่ข้างแผงลอย ฉันจะหาเจอยากนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cứ cố trụ bên cạnh sạp hàng, tôi sẽ khó tìm thấy lắm...
data.Indonesian: Kalau mereka bertahan di samping lapak, aku akan sulit menemukan mereka...

data.Korean: 길은 비웠습니다!
data.English: The road is clear!
data.Thai: เคลียร์ทางแล้วครับ!
data.Vietnamese: Đường đã được dọn!
data.Indonesian: Jalannya sudah kosong!

data.Korean: 하지만 농장 쪽 입구에서 소리가 납니다!
data.English: But there is noise coming from the farm-side entrance!
data.Thai: แต่มีเสียงดังจากทางเข้าฝั่งฟาร์มครับ!
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng có tiếng động từ lối vào phía nông trại!
data.Indonesian: Tapi ada suara dari pintu masuk sisi pertanian!

data.Korean: 들어오고 있어.
data.English: They are coming in.
data.Thai: พวกมันกำลังเข้ามา
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang tiến vào.
data.Indonesian: Mereka masuk.

data.Korean: 좌판 사이로 흩어지기 전에 막아야 해.
data.English: We need to stop them before they scatter between the stalls.
data.Thai: ต้องหยุดพวกมันก่อนจะแตกไปตามแผงลอย
data.Vietnamese: Phải chặn chúng trước khi chúng tản ra giữa các sạp hàng.
data.Indonesian: Kita harus menghentikan mereka sebelum menyebar di antara lapak.

data.Korean: 좋아. 흩어지기 전에 시장 입구에서 막자.
data.English: All right. Let us stop them at the market entrance before they scatter.
data.Thai: ดี หยุดพวกมันที่ทางเข้าตลาดก่อนจะแตกกระจายกัน
data.Vietnamese: Được. Chặn chúng ở lối vào chợ trước khi chúng tản ra.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kita tahan mereka di pintu masuk pasar sebelum menyebar.

data.Korean: 시장 안쪽 주민들은 대피했습니다.
data.English: The residents inside the market have evacuated.
data.Thai: ชาวบ้านด้านในตลาดอพยพแล้วครับ
data.Vietnamese: Cư dân bên trong chợ đã sơ tán.
data.Indonesian: Warga di dalam pasar sudah dievakuasi.

data.Korean: 큰 피해는 막았습니다.
data.English: We prevented major damage.
data.Thai: เราป้องกันความเสียหายใหญ่ไว้ได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã ngăn được thiệt hại lớn.
data.Indonesian: Kita berhasil mencegah kerusakan besar.

data.Korean: 좋아. 사람들은 지켰어.
data.English: Good. We protected the people.
data.Thai: ดี เราปกป้องผู้คนไว้ได้
data.Vietnamese: Tốt. Chúng ta đã bảo vệ mọi người.
data.Indonesian: Bagus. Kita melindungi orang-orang.

data.Korean: 여기까지 들어왔다는 게 문제네.
data.English: The problem is that they made it this far.
data.Thai: ปัญหาคือพวกมันเข้ามาได้ถึงตรงนี้
data.Vietnamese: Vấn đề là chúng đã vào tới tận đây.
data.Indonesian: Masalahnya, mereka bisa masuk sejauh ini.

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 사람을 쫓은 흔적은 없어.
data.English: There are no signs that the monsters chased people.
data.Thai: ไม่มีร่องรอยว่ามอนสเตอร์ไล่ตามคน
data.Vietnamese: Không có dấu hiệu quái vật đuổi theo người.
data.Indonesian: Tidak ada tanda monster mengejar orang.

data.Korean: 대신 사람들이 대피하면서 생긴 빈틈을 그대로 밟고 왔어.
data.English: Instead, they stepped right through the openings left as people evacuated.
data.Thai: แต่พวกมันเหยียบเข้ามาตามช่องว่างที่เกิดตอนผู้คนอพยพ
data.Vietnamese: Thay vào đó, chúng đi thẳng qua những khoảng trống do người dân sơ tán tạo ra.
data.Indonesian: Sebaliknya, mereka langsung melewati celah yang muncul saat orang-orang mengungsi.

data.Korean: 그래서 더 위험했던 거야.
data.English: That is why it was more dangerous.
data.Thai: เพราะงั้นถึงอันตรายกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Vì vậy nó càng nguy hiểm hơn.
data.Indonesian: Karena itu lebih berbahaya.

data.Korean: 제플은 길이 많아서 사람들이 피할 곳도 많지만, 그건 몬스터에게도 해당되는 이야기야.
data.English: Jeple has many roads, so people have many places to escape, but the same applies to monsters.
data.Thai: เจเพิลมีถนนเยอะ ผู้คนจึงมีที่ให้หลบมาก แต่เรื่องนั้นก็ใช้กับมอนสเตอร์เหมือนกัน
data.Vietnamese: Jeple có nhiều đường nên người dân có nhiều chỗ để tránh, nhưng điều đó cũng đúng với quái vật.
data.Indonesian: Jeple punya banyak jalan, jadi orang punya banyak tempat untuk menghindar, tapi hal yang sama juga berlaku bagi monster.

data.Korean: 사람들이 흩어져 있으면 치료하기도 어려워.
data.English: If people are scattered, treating them becomes difficult too.
