data.Thai: ถ้าผู้คนกระจายกันอยู่ การรักษาก็ยากขึ้นด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu mọi người tản ra, việc chữa trị cũng khó hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jika orang-orang tersebar, merawat mereka juga jadi sulit.

data.Korean: 누가 다쳤는지부터 찾느라 시간이 걸리니까...
data.English: Because it takes time just to find out who is hurt...
data.Thai: เพราะแค่หาว่าใครบาดเจ็บก็ใช้เวลาแล้ว...
data.Vietnamese: Vì chỉ tìm xem ai bị thương thôi cũng mất thời gian...
data.Indonesian: Karena mencari siapa yang terluka saja sudah memakan waktu...

data.Korean: 수로 쪽 창고에서도 소란이 났다고 들었습니다.
data.English: I heard there was a commotion at the warehouses near the waterway too.
data.Thai: ได้ยินว่าที่โกดังฝั่งทางน้ำก็เกิดความวุ่นวายครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi nghe nói ở các nhà kho phía kênh nước cũng có náo loạn.
data.Indonesian: Saya dengar ada keributan juga di gudang dekat saluran air.

data.Korean: 물길이 막혀서 창고 사이 길이 좁아졌다고 합니다.
data.English: They say the waterway is blocked, narrowing the road between the warehouses.
data.Thai: ว่ากันว่าทางน้ำถูกปิด ทำให้ทางระหว่างโกดังแคบลงครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nghe nói kênh nước bị tắc, khiến đường giữa các nhà kho hẹp lại.
data.Indonesian: Katanya saluran air tersumbat, membuat jalan di antara gudang menjadi sempit.

data.Korean: 발자국도 수로 쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: The footprints lead toward the waterway too.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าก็ต่อไปทางทางน้ำด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân cũng dẫn về phía kênh nước.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki juga mengarah ke saluran air.

data.Korean: 시장 큰길을 따라오다가 수로 방향으로 꺾였어.
data.English: They followed the market main road, then turned toward the waterway.
data.Thai: พวกมันมาตามถนนใหญ่ตลาด แล้วเลี้ยวไปทางทางน้ำ
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đi theo đường lớn của chợ rồi rẽ về phía kênh nước.
data.Indonesian: Mereka mengikuti jalan utama pasar, lalu berbelok ke arah saluran air.

data.Korean: 수로가 막혔다면 이동 방향이 더 이상하게 꺾일 수 있어.
data.English: If the waterway is blocked, their movement path could bend even more strangely.
data.Thai: ถ้าทางน้ำถูกปิด ทิศทางการเคลื่อนที่อาจหักเลี้ยวแปลกกว่าเดิม
data.Vietnamese: Nếu kênh nước bị tắc, hướng di chuyển có thể rẽ ngoặt kỳ lạ hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jika saluran air tersumbat, arah pergerakan mereka bisa berbelok makin aneh.

data.Korean: 몬스터뿐 아니라 사람 대피에도 영향을 줄 거야.
data.English: It will affect not only monsters, but people's evacuation too.
data.Thai: มันจะส่งผลไม่ใช่แค่มอนสเตอร์ แต่รวมถึงการอพยพของผู้คนด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nó sẽ ảnh hưởng không chỉ đến quái vật, mà cả việc sơ tán của người dân.
data.Indonesian: Itu akan memengaruhi bukan hanya monster, tapi juga evakuasi orang-orang.

data.Korean: 그럼 수로 쪽도 막아야지.
data.English: Then we should block the waterway side too.
data.Thai: งั้นฝั่งทางน้ำก็ต้องสกัดด้วยสิ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy phía kênh nước cũng phải chặn lại.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, sisi saluran air juga harus kita hadang.

data.Korean: 시장까지는 지켰으니까, 다음 길도 지키면 되지!
data.English: We protected the market, so we just have to protect the next road too!
data.Thai: เราปกป้องตลาดไว้แล้ว ทางต่อไปก็แค่ปกป้องให้ได้เหมือนกัน!
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã bảo vệ được chợ rồi, đường tiếp theo cũng chỉ cần bảo vệ tiếp thôi!
data.Indonesian: Kita sudah melindungi pasar, jadi jalan berikutnya juga tinggal kita lindungi!

data.Korean: 물가면 미끄러울 텐데...
data.English: If it is by the water, it will be slippery...
data.Thai: ถ้าอยู่ริมน้ำก็คงลื่นนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu ở gần nước thì chắc trơn lắm...
data.Indonesian: Kalau di dekat air, pasti licin...

data.Korean: 이번엔 넘어지기 전에 조심하라고 먼저 말해 둘게.
data.English: This time, I will warn everyone to be careful before they fall.
data.Thai: คราวนี้ฉันจะเตือนให้ระวังก่อนจะล้มไว้ก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Lần này tôi sẽ nhắc cẩn thận trước khi có ai ngã.
data.Indonesian: Kali ini aku akan mengingatkan agar berhati-hati sebelum ada yang jatuh.

data.Korean: 수로와 창고 구역으로 이동하자.
data.English: Let us move to the waterway and warehouse area.
data.Thai: ไปที่ทางน้ำกับเขตโกดังกัน
data.Vietnamese: Di chuyển đến khu kênh nước và nhà kho.
data.Indonesian: Mari bergerak ke area saluran air dan gudang.

data.Korean: 물길이 몬스터 이동에 영향을 주는지 확인하자.
data.English: Let us check whether the waterways are affecting monster movement.
data.Thai: ตรวจดูว่าทางน้ำส่งผลต่อการเคลื่อนที่ของมอนสเตอร์หรือไม่
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kiểm tra xem các kênh nước có ảnh hưởng đến chuyển động của quái vật không.
data.Indonesian: Mari periksa apakah saluran air memengaruhi pergerakan monster.

data.Korean: 시장 쪽에서 오셨습니까?
data.English: Did you come from the market side?
data.Thai: มาจากฝั่งตลาดใช่ไหมครับ?
data.Vietnamese: Các vị đến từ phía chợ phải không?
data.Indonesian: Apakah Anda datang dari sisi pasar?

data.Korean: 수로가 막히면서 창고 사이 길이 좁아졌습니다.
data.English: The waterway is blocked, so the road between the warehouses has narrowed.
data.Thai: ทางน้ำถูกปิด ทำให้ทางระหว่างโกดังแคบลงครับ
data.Vietnamese: Kênh nước bị tắc nên đường giữa các nhà kho đã hẹp lại.
data.Indonesian: Saluran air tersumbat, sehingga jalan di antara gudang menyempit.

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 창고 사이 길로 몰려들고 있습니다.
data.English: The monsters are swarming into the road between the warehouses.
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์กำลังหลั่งเข้ามาตามทางระหว่างโกดังครับ
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật đang dồn vào con đường giữa các nhà kho.
data.Indonesian: Monster-monster berkumpul masuk ke jalan di antara gudang.

data.Korean: 발자국이 물가에서 꺾였어.
data.English: The footprints turned at the water's edge.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าเลี้ยวตรงริมน้ำ
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân rẽ ở mép nước.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki berbelok di tepi air.

data.Korean: 물을 피하려고 한 건지, 밀려서 돌아간 건지는 아직 모르겠어.
data.English: I still do not know whether they were avoiding the water or were pushed into a detour.
data.Thai: ยังไม่รู้ว่าพวกมันพยายามหลบน้ำ หรือถูกดันให้วนอ้อมไป
data.Vietnamese: Tôi vẫn chưa biết chúng tránh nước hay bị đẩy phải đi vòng.
data.Indonesian: Aku belum tahu apakah mereka menghindari air atau terdorong memutar.

data.Korean: 길이 꼬인 건 보여.
data.English: We can see that the path is tangled.
data.Thai: เห็นได้ว่าทางมันพันกันยุ่ง
data.Vietnamese: Có thể thấy con đường đã bị rối.
data.Indonesian: Terlihat jalurnya menjadi kacau.

data.Korean: 막힌 수로가 사람이 다니는 길까지 좁혀 놓았어.
data.English: The blocked waterway has narrowed even the paths people use.
data.Thai: ทางน้ำที่ถูกปิดทำให้ทางที่คนใช้แคบลงด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Kênh nước bị tắc đã làm hẹp cả đường người dân đi lại.
data.Indonesian: Saluran air yang tersumbat juga mempersempit jalan yang dipakai orang.

data.Korean: 길이 줄면 막기 쉬운 거 아니야?
data.English: If the roads shrink, does that not make them easier to block?
data.Thai: ถ้าทางแคบลง ก็สกัดง่ายขึ้นไม่ใช่เหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Nếu đường hẹp lại thì chẳng phải dễ chặn hơn sao?
data.Indonesian: Kalau jalannya menyempit, bukankah lebih mudah untuk diblokir?

data.Korean: 일시적으론 그럴 수도 있어. 하지만 한곳으로 몰리면 힘도 같이 쏠려.
data.English: Temporarily, maybe. But if everything is forced into one place, the force gathers there too.
data.Thai: ชั่วคราวอาจใช่ แต่ถ้าทุกอย่างถูกบีบไปที่เดียว แรงก็จะไปรวมตรงนั้นด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Tạm thời thì có thể. Nhưng nếu mọi thứ bị dồn vào một chỗ, lực cũng dồn lại theo.
data.Indonesian: Untuk sementara mungkin. Tapi kalau semuanya terdorong ke satu tempat, tekanannya juga berkumpul di sana.

data.Korean: 물가에서 밀리면 다치는 방식도 다양해져.
data.English: If you get pushed near the water, there are all kinds of ways to get hurt.
data.Thai: ถ้าถูกดันตรงริมน้ำ วิธีบาดเจ็บก็มีหลายแบบเลย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị đẩy ở gần nước, cách bị thương cũng đủ kiểu.
data.Indonesian: Kalau terdorong di dekat air, cara terluka bisa macam-macam.

data.Korean: 미끄러지고, 부딪히고, 젖고... 별로 좋은 조합은 아니야.
data.English: Slipping, bumping into things, getting soaked... It is not a very good combination.
data.Thai: ลื่น ชน เปียก... ไม่ใช่การรวมกันที่ดีเลย
data.Vietnamese: Trượt ngã, va đập, ướt sũng... không phải tổ hợp tốt đẹp gì.
data.Indonesian: Tergelincir, terbentur, basah kuyup... bukan kombinasi yang bagus.

data.Korean: 수로 가장자리에 사람은 남아 있어?
data.English: Are there any people left along the waterway edge?
data.Thai: ยังมีคนเหลืออยู่ริมทางน้ำไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Còn ai ở mép kênh nước không?
data.Indonesian: Apakah masih ada orang di tepi saluran air?

data.Korean: 창고 직원들은 대피시켰습니다.
data.English: The warehouse staff have been evacuated.
data.Thai: พนักงานโกดังอพยพแล้วครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nhân viên nhà kho đã được sơ tán.
data.Indonesian: Staf gudang sudah dievakuasi.

data.Korean: 다만 창고 물자가 길을 막고 있어서 정비가 늦어지고 있습니다.
data.English: However, warehouse supplies are blocking the road, so the clearing work is being delayed.
data.Thai: แต่วัสดุในโกดังขวางทางอยู่ ทำให้การเคลียร์พื้นที่ล่าช้าครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tuy nhiên, hàng hóa trong kho đang chặn đường nên việc dọn dẹp bị chậm lại.
data.Indonesian: Namun, persediaan gudang menghalangi jalan, sehingga pekerjaan pembersihan tertunda.

data.Korean: 창고 사이 길로 큰 무리의 흔적이 이어져 있어.
data.English: The tracks of the large group continue along the road between the warehouses.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของฝูงใหญ่ยังต่อไปตามทางระหว่างโกดัง
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết của bầy lớn tiếp tục dọc theo đường giữa các nhà kho.
data.Indonesian: Jejak gerombolan besar berlanjut di jalan antara gudang.

data.Korean: 시장에서 본 것보다 더 깊게 눌렸어.
data.English: They are pressed in deeper than what we saw at the market.
data.Thai: มันกดลึกกว่าที่เราเห็นในตลาด
data.Vietnamese: Chúng lún sâu hơn những gì ta thấy ở chợ.
data.Indonesian: Jejaknya tertekan lebih dalam daripada yang kita lihat di pasar.

data.Korean: 더 큰 게 있다는 뜻이야?
data.English: Does that mean there is something bigger?
data.Thai: แปลว่ามีตัวที่ใหญ่กว่าเหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nghĩa là có thứ gì đó lớn hơn à?
data.Indonesian: Berarti ada sesuatu yang lebih besar?

data.Korean: 가능성은 있어.
data.English: It is possible.
data.Thai: ก็เป็นไปได้
data.Vietnamese: Có khả năng.
data.Indonesian: Ada kemungkinan.

data.Korean: 하지만 지금 가까운 건 앞쪽 무리야.
data.English: But what is close right now is the group up ahead.
data.Thai: แต่ตอนนี้สิ่งที่ใกล้คือฝูงด้านหน้า
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng thứ đang ở gần lúc này là bầy phía trước.
data.Indonesian: Tapi yang dekat saat ini adalah gerombolan di depan.

data.Korean: 큰 움직임을 확인하려면 먼저 수로 옆 길을 열어야 해.
data.English: To check the larger movement, we need to open the road beside the waterway first.
data.Thai: ถ้าจะตรวจการเคลื่อนไหวที่ใหญ่กว่า ต้องเปิดทางข้างทางน้ำก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Muốn kiểm tra chuyển động lớn hơn, trước hết phải mở đường bên cạnh kênh nước.
data.Indonesian: Untuk memeriksa pergerakan yang lebih besar, kita harus membuka jalan di samping saluran air dulu.

data.Korean: 수로를 정비하지 않으면 다음 방어선도 불안해져.
data.English: If we do not clear the waterway, the next defensive line will become unstable too.
data.Thai: ถ้าไม่จัดการทางน้ำ แนวป้องกันถัดไปก็จะไม่มั่นคงด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu không dọn kênh nước, tuyến phòng thủ tiếp theo cũng sẽ bất ổn.
data.Indonesian: Jika kita tidak membersihkan saluran air, garis pertahanan berikutnya juga akan goyah.

data.Korean: 좋아. 그럼 수로 옆 길부터 막자!
data.English: All right. Then let us stop them on the road beside the waterway first!
data.Thai: ดี งั้นหยุดพวกมันที่ทางข้างทางน้ำก่อน!
data.Vietnamese: Được. Vậy chặn chúng ở đường bên cạnh kênh nước trước!
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kalau begitu, hentikan mereka di jalan samping saluran air dulu!

data.Korean: 물가 가까이는 조심해.
data.English: Be careful near the water.
data.Thai: ระวังใกล้น้ำด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Cẩn thận khi ở gần nước.
data.Indonesian: Hati-hati di dekat air.

data.Korean: 물가 가까이에 있는 사람은 치료하기 전에 잔소리부터 나갈지도 몰라...
data.English: Anyone near the water might get a scolding before I even treat them...
data.Thai: คนที่อยู่ใกล้น้ำอาจโดนบ่นก่อนจะได้รักษานะ...
data.Vietnamese: Ai ở gần nước có khi bị tôi cằn nhằn trước khi được chữa đấy...
data.Indonesian: Orang yang berada dekat air mungkin akan kena omel sebelum aku merawatnya...

data.Korean: 움직임이 가까워져.
data.English: The movement is getting closer.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวใกล้เข้ามาแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động đang lại gần.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakannya makin dekat.

data.Korean: 창고 사이 좁은 길로 들어오고 있어.
data.English: They are entering the narrow road between the warehouses.
data.Thai: พวกมันกำลังเข้ามาตามทางแคบระหว่างโกดัง
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang vào con đường hẹp giữa các nhà kho.
data.Indonesian: Mereka masuk ke jalan sempit di antara gudang.

data.Korean: 수로 옆 길에서 막자.
data.English: Let us stop them on the road beside the waterway.
data.Thai: หยุดพวกมันที่ทางข้างทางน้ำกัน
data.Vietnamese: Chặn chúng trên đường bên cạnh kênh nước.
data.Indonesian: Kita tahan mereka di jalan samping saluran air.

data.Korean: 물길 정비가 끝날 때까지 창고 쪽으로 이어지기 전에 막자.
data.English: Until the waterway clearing is finished, let us stop them before they reach the warehouse side.
data.Thai: จนกว่าการเคลียร์ทางน้ำจะเสร็จ หยุดพวกมันก่อนจะต่อไปถึงฝั่งโกดัง
data.Vietnamese: Cho đến khi việc dọn kênh nước xong, hãy chặn chúng trước khi chúng tới phía nhà kho.
data.Indonesian: Sampai pembersihan saluran air selesai, tahan mereka sebelum mencapai sisi gudang.

data.Korean: 창고 쪽 피해는 더 번지지 않았습니다.
data.English: The damage on the warehouse side did not spread any farther.
data.Thai: ความเสียหายฝั่งโกดังไม่ได้ลุกลามต่อครับ
data.Vietnamese: Thiệt hại phía nhà kho không lan rộng thêm.
data.Indonesian: Kerusakan di sisi gudang tidak menyebar lebih jauh.

data.Korean: 하지만 수로는 바로 손봐야 합니다.
data.English: But the waterway needs to be handled immediately.
data.Thai: แต่ทางน้ำต้องรีบจัดการทันทีครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng kênh nước cần được xử lý ngay.
data.Indonesian: Tapi saluran air harus segera ditangani.

data.Korean: 큰 무리의 흔적은 여기서 끝나지 않았어.
data.English: The large group's tracks do not end here.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของฝูงใหญ่ไม่ได้จบที่นี่
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết của bầy lớn không kết thúc ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Jejak gerombolan besar tidak berakhir di sini.

data.Korean: 영주관 앞 광장 쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: They continue toward the plaza in front of the Lord's Manor.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยต่อไปทางลานหน้าคฤหาสน์เจ้าเมือง
data.Vietnamese: Chúng tiếp tục hướng về quảng trường trước Dinh Lãnh chúa.
data.Indonesian: Jejaknya berlanjut ke alun-alun di depan Wisma Penguasa.

data.Korean: 광장까지 가면 사람들이 더 많이 모여 있지 않아?
data.English: If they reach the plaza, will there not be more people gathered there?
data.Thai: ถ้าไปถึงลาน คนจะรวมกันอยู่เยอะกว่านี้ไม่ใช่เหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Nếu tới quảng trường, chẳng phải sẽ có nhiều người tụ tập hơn sao?
data.Indonesian: Kalau sampai ke alun-alun, bukankah akan ada lebih banyak orang berkumpul di sana?

data.Korean: 대피 장소가 영주관 앞 광장 근처입니다.
data.English: The evacuation site is near the plaza in front of the Lord's Manor.
data.Thai: จุดอพยพอยู่ใกล้ลานหน้าคฤหาสน์เจ้าเมืองครับ
data.Vietnamese: Điểm sơ tán nằm gần quảng trường trước Dinh Lãnh chúa.
data.Indonesian: Tempat evakuasi berada di dekat alun-alun depan Wisma Penguasa.

data.Korean: 지금은 경비병들이 광장 바깥쪽을 막고 있습니다.
data.English: Right now, the guards are blocking the outside of the plaza.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้ทหารยามกำลังกันพื้นที่ด้านนอกลานไว้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Hiện tại lính gác đang chặn phía ngoài quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Saat ini para penjaga menahan sisi luar alun-alun.

data.Korean: 막힌 수로 때문에 길이 꼬인 것 같아.
data.English: It looks like the blocked waterway has tangled the roads.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนทางน้ำที่ถูกปิดทำให้เส้นทางพันกันยุ่ง
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ kênh nước bị tắc đã làm đường đi rối lên.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya saluran air yang tersumbat membuat jalannya kacau.

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 물길을 따라온 건 아니지만, 막힌 물길 때문에 사람이 다니는 길로 몰렸어.
data.English: The monsters did not follow the waterway, but the blocked waterway forced them onto the roads people use.
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์ไม่ได้มาตามทางน้ำ แต่ทางน้ำที่ถูกปิดทำให้พวกมันถูกดันมาทางที่คนใช้
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật không đi theo kênh nước, nhưng kênh nước bị tắc đã đẩy chúng vào đường người dân sử dụng.
data.Indonesian: Monster tidak mengikuti saluran air, tetapi saluran air yang tersumbat memaksa mereka ke jalan yang digunakan orang.

data.Korean: 그러니까 물도 막고, 몬스터도 막고, 사람도 지켜야 한다는 거네.
data.English: So we have to stop the water, stop the monsters, and protect the people.
data.Thai: งั้นก็ต้องหยุดทั้งน้ำ หยุดทั้งมอนสเตอร์ แล้วก็ปกป้องผู้คนด้วยสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy là phải chặn cả nước, chặn cả quái vật, rồi còn bảo vệ người dân nữa.
data.Indonesian: Jadi kita harus menahan air, menahan monster, dan melindungi orang-orang juga.

data.Korean: 오늘은 챙길 게 너무 많네...
data.English: There is too much to take care of today...
data.Thai: วันนี้มีเรื่องต้องดูแลเยอะเกินไปแล้ว...
data.Vietnamese: Hôm nay có quá nhiều thứ phải lo...
data.Indonesian: Hari ini terlalu banyak yang harus diurus...

data.Korean: 큰 움직임은 아직 광장 쪽에 있어.
data.English: The large movement is still on the plaza side.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวขนาดใหญ่ยังอยู่ทางลาน
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động lớn vẫn ở phía quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakan besar masih ada di sisi alun-alun.

data.Korean: 먼저 내려온 무리와는 무게가 달라.
data.English: Its weight is different from the group that came down first.
data.Thai: น้ำหนักของมันต่างจากฝูงที่ลงมาก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Sức nặng của nó khác với bầy đã xuống trước.
data.Indonesian: Bobotnya berbeda dari gerombolan yang turun lebih dulu.

data.Korean: 광장으로 가기 전에 수로와 방어선을 정비하자.
data.English: Before we go to the plaza, let us repair the waterway and defensive line.
data.Thai: ก่อนจะไปที่ลาน เรามาซ่อมทางน้ำกับแนวป้องกันกัน
data.Vietnamese: Trước khi tới quảng trường, hãy sửa kênh nước và tuyến phòng thủ.
data.Indonesian: Sebelum menuju alun-alun, mari perbaiki saluran air dan garis pertahanan.

data.Korean: 여기서 밀려오는 움직임을 조금이라도 줄여야 해.
data.English: We need to reduce the incoming movement here, even a little.
data.Thai: ต้องลดการเคลื่อนไหวที่ไหลเข้ามาจากตรงนี้ให้ได้แม้แต่นิดเดียว
data.Vietnamese: Phải giảm bớt chuyển động đang tràn tới từ đây, dù chỉ một chút.
data.Indonesian: Kita harus mengurangi pergerakan yang datang dari sini, walau sedikit.

data.Korean: 응. 정비를 서두르자.
data.English: Yeah. Let us hurry with the repairs.
data.Thai: อืม รีบซ่อมกันเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Hãy nhanh chóng sửa chữa.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Ayo percepat perbaikannya.

data.Korean: 그대로 두면 광장 방어선이 더 빨리 흔들릴 거야.
data.English: If we leave it as is, the plaza defensive line will shake sooner.
data.Thai: ถ้าปล่อยไว้แบบนี้ แนวป้องกันลานจะสั่นคลอนเร็วขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cứ để vậy, tuyến phòng thủ quảng trường sẽ lung lay nhanh hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jika dibiarkan, garis pertahanan alun-alun akan lebih cepat goyah.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 정비하는 동안 앞쪽을 볼게!
data.English: Got it. I will watch the front while the repairs are happening!
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ระหว่างซ่อม ฉันจะดูด้านหน้าให้!
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Trong lúc sửa chữa, tôi sẽ canh phía trước!
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Selama perbaikan, aku akan mengawasi bagian depan!

data.Korean: 그럼 나는 정비 인원 쪽부터 확인할게.
data.English: Then I will check on the repair crew first.
data.Thai: งั้นฉันจะตรวจฝั่งคนซ่อมก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Vậy tôi sẽ kiểm tra nhóm sửa chữa trước.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, aku akan memeriksa kru perbaikan dulu.

data.Korean: 물가 작업 뒤엔 꼭 누군가 미끄러져 있더라고...
data.English: After work by the water, someone always seems to have slipped...
data.Thai: หลังทำงานริมน้ำ มักจะมีใครสักคนลื่นอยู่เสมอเลย...
data.Vietnamese: Sau khi làm việc gần nước, lúc nào cũng có ai đó trượt chân...
data.Indonesian: Setelah bekerja di dekat air, selalu saja ada yang terpeleset...

data.Korean: 막힌 물길은 조금 트였습니다.
data.English: The blocked waterway has opened a little.
data.Thai: ทางน้ำที่ถูกปิดเปิดออกมาบ้างแล้วครับ
data.Vietnamese: Kênh nước bị tắc đã được khai thông một chút.
data.Indonesian: Saluran air yang tersumbat sudah sedikit terbuka.

data.Korean: 하지만 흙더미를 전부 걷어 내려면 시간이 더 필요합니다.
data.English: But we need more time to clear all the piles of dirt.
data.Thai: แต่ต้องใช้เวลาอีกหน่อยกว่าจะขนกองดินออกทั้งหมดครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng cần thêm thời gian để dọn hết các đống đất.
data.Indonesian: Tapi kami butuh waktu lagi untuk membersihkan semua tumpukan tanah.

data.Korean: 지금은 전부 정리할 시간이 없어.
data.English: We do not have time to clear everything right now.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้เราไม่มีเวลาจัดการทั้งหมด
data.Vietnamese: Bây giờ không có thời gian để dọn hết mọi thứ.
data.Indonesian: Saat ini kita tidak punya waktu untuk membersihkan semuanya.

data.Korean: 광장 입구 방어선이 버틸 시간을 벌어야 해.
data.English: We need to buy time for the plaza entrance defensive line to hold.
data.Thai: ต้องซื้อเวลาให้แนวป้องกันทางเข้าลานยืนหยัดได้
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta cần câu giờ để tuyến phòng thủ lối vào quảng trường trụ được.
data.Indonesian: Kita harus mengulur waktu agar garis pertahanan pintu masuk alun-alun bisa bertahan.

data.Korean: 좋아. 그럼 우리가 물길부터 조금이라도 더 열자!
data.English: All right. Then let us open the waterway even a little more ourselves!
data.Thai: ดี งั้นพวกเราช่วยเปิดทางน้ำเพิ่มอีกสักหน่อยกัน!
data.Vietnamese: Được. Vậy chúng ta tự mở thêm kênh nước, dù chỉ một chút!
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kalau begitu, kita buka saluran air sedikit lagi sendiri!

data.Korean: 급하게 세운 방어선은 꼭 다시 말썽이 나더라고.
data.English: A hastily built defensive line always seems to cause trouble again.
data.Thai: แนวป้องกันที่รีบสร้างมักจะก่อปัญหาอีกเสมอ
data.Vietnamese: Tuyến phòng thủ dựng vội lúc nào cũng lại gây chuyện.
data.Indonesian: Garis pertahanan yang dibuat terburu-buru selalu saja bermasalah lagi.

data.Korean: 그래도 지금은 안 무너지는 게 먼저겠지...
data.English: Still, keeping it from collapsing comes first right now...
data.Thai: แต่ตอนนี้คงต้องไม่ให้มันพังก่อน...
data.Vietnamese: Dù vậy, lúc này ưu tiên là đừng để nó sập trước...
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, sekarang yang utama adalah jangan sampai runtuh...

data.Korean: 큰 무리의 흔적은 광장 쪽으로 계속 이어져 있어.
data.English: The large group's tracks continue toward the plaza.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของฝูงใหญ่ยังต่อไปทางลาน
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết của bầy lớn vẫn tiếp tục hướng về quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Jejak gerombolan besar terus mengarah ke alun-alun.

data.Korean: 주변 몬스터들도 그 방향으로 휩쓸리고 있어.
data.English: The nearby monsters are being swept in that direction too.
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์รอบ ๆ ก็ถูกกวาดไปทางนั้นด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật xung quanh cũng bị cuốn về hướng đó.
data.Indonesian: Monster di sekitar juga terseret ke arah itu.

data.Korean: 대형 개체가 무리를 이끄는 건지, 똑같이 밀려오는 건지는 아직 모르겠어.
data.English: We still do not know whether the large creature is leading the group or being driven along just the same.
data.Thai: ยังไม่รู้ว่าสิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดใหญ่นั้นนำฝูงอยู่ หรือถูกดันมาด้วยเหมือนกัน
data.Vietnamese: Vẫn chưa biết cá thể lớn đang dẫn bầy, hay cũng bị đẩy tới giống như chúng.
data.Indonesian: Kita masih belum tahu apakah makhluk besar itu memimpin gerombolan, atau ikut terdorong seperti yang lain.

data.Korean: 하지만 확실한 건 있어. 광장 입구를 넘기면 피해가 커져.
data.English: But one thing is certain. If they get past the plaza entrance, the damage will grow.
data.Thai: แต่มีเรื่องหนึ่งที่แน่ชัด ถ้าพวกมันผ่านทางเข้าลานไปได้ ความเสียหายจะใหญ่ขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng có một điều chắc chắn. Nếu chúng vượt qua lối vào quảng trường, thiệt hại sẽ tăng lên.
data.Indonesian: Tapi ada satu hal yang pasti. Jika mereka melewati pintu masuk alun-alun, kerusakan akan membesar.

data.Korean: 영주관 앞 광장 방어를 준비하고, 임시 정비가 끝나는 대로 바로 이동하자.
data.English: Prepare the defense of the plaza in front of the Lord's Manor, and move as soon as the temporary repairs are finished.
data.Thai: เตรียมการป้องกันลานหน้าคฤหาสน์เจ้าเมือง แล้วเคลื่อนที่ทันทีที่การซ่อมชั่วคราวเสร็จ
data.Vietnamese: Chuẩn bị phòng thủ quảng trường trước Dinh Lãnh chúa, rồi di chuyển ngay khi việc sửa chữa tạm thời xong.
data.Indonesian: Siapkan pertahanan alun-alun di depan Wisma Penguasa, lalu bergerak segera setelah perbaikan sementara selesai.

data.Korean: 수로 쪽 임시 방어선을 보강하고, 광장 쪽 경비병들에게도 전달하겠습니다.
data.English: I will reinforce the temporary defensive line by the waterway and inform the guards near the plaza as well.
data.Thai: ผมจะเสริมแนวป้องกันชั่วคราวฝั่งทางน้ำ และแจ้งทหารยามทางลานด้วยครับ
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ gia cố tuyến phòng thủ tạm thời phía kênh nước và báo cho lính gác phía quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Saya akan memperkuat garis pertahanan sementara di sisi saluran air dan menyampaikan ini kepada penjaga di sisi alun-alun.

data.Korean: 다친 사람은 영주관 뒤편 대피로로 안내해 줘.
data.English: Guide the injured people to the evacuation route behind the Lord's Manor.
data.Thai: ช่วยพาคนเจ็บไปยังทางอพยพด้านหลังคฤหาสน์เจ้าเมืองด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Hãy hướng dẫn người bị thương đến đường sơ tán phía sau Dinh Lãnh chúa.
data.Indonesian: Arahkan orang-orang yang terluka ke jalur evakuasi di belakang Wisma Penguasa.

data.Korean: 대피로가 막히면 치료도 늦어져.
data.English: If the evacuation route is blocked, treatment will be delayed too.
data.Thai: ถ้าทางอพยพถูกปิด การรักษาก็จะช้าลงด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu đường sơ tán bị chặn, việc chữa trị cũng sẽ chậm lại.
data.Indonesian: Jika jalur evakuasi terhalang, perawatan juga akan tertunda.

data.Korean: 알겠어. 대피로는 열어 둘게!
data.English: Got it. I will keep the evacuation route open!
data.Thai: เข้าใจแล้ว ฉันจะเปิดทางอพยพไว้!
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Tôi sẽ giữ đường sơ tán mở!
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Aku akan menjaga jalur evakuasi tetap terbuka!

data.Korean: 수로 쪽 몬스터 움직임이 조금 느려졌어.
data.English: The monster movement near the waterway has slowed a little.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวของมอนสเตอร์ฝั่งทางน้ำช้าลงเล็กน้อย
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động của quái vật phía kênh nước đã chậm lại một chút.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakan monster di sisi saluran air sedikit melambat.

data.Korean: 물길을 열어 둔 게 효과가 있는 것 같아.
data.English: Opening the waterway seems to be working.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนการเปิดทางน้ำไว้จะได้ผล
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ việc mở kênh nước đã có hiệu quả.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya membuka saluran air mulai berpengaruh.

data.Korean: 그럼 이틈에 정비를 하는 게 맞아. 대신 여기서 오래 붙잡히면 안 돼.
data.English: Then we should use this chance to make repairs. But we cannot get stuck here for long.
data.Thai: งั้นก็ควรใช้จังหวะนี้ซ่อมแซม แต่จะติดอยู่ที่นี่นานไม่ได้
data.Vietnamese: Vậy thì nên tranh thủ lúc này để sửa chữa. Nhưng không được bị giữ chân ở đây quá lâu.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, sekarang saatnya melakukan perbaikan. Tapi kita tidak boleh tertahan di sini terlalu lama.

data.Korean: 성벽 체력이 회복된다.
data.English: Wall HP is restored.
data.Thai: พลังชีวิตของกำแพงฟื้นฟูแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: HP tường thành được hồi phục.
data.Indonesian: HP tembok dipulihkan.

data.Korean: 영구 강화 선택 UI가 열린다.
data.English: The permanent enhancement selection UI opens.
data.Thai: UI เลือกการเสริมพลังถาวรเปิดขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: UI chọn cường hóa vĩnh viễn mở ra.
data.Indonesian: UI pilihan peningkatan permanen terbuka.

data.Korean: 선택 예시: 노아 치명타 확률 증가 / 세라 체력 증가 / 스파인 회복량 증가.
data.English: Selection examples: Noah critical rate increase / Serah HP increase / Spayne healing amount increase.
data.Thai: ตัวอย่างตัวเลือก: เพิ่มอัตราคริติคอลของโนอา / เพิ่ม HP ของเซราห์ / เพิ่มปริมาณการรักษาของสไปน์
data.Vietnamese: Ví dụ lựa chọn: tăng tỷ lệ chí mạng cho Noah / tăng HP cho Serah / tăng lượng hồi phục cho Spayne.
data.Indonesian: Contoh pilihan: peningkatan peluang kritikal Noah / peningkatan HP Serah / peningkatan jumlah penyembuhan Spayne.

data.Korean: 선택한 강화는 이후 전투에도 유지된다.
data.English: The selected enhancement remains in later battles.
data.Thai: การเสริมพลังที่เลือกจะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อ ๆ ไป
data.Vietnamese: Cường hóa đã chọn sẽ duy trì trong các trận chiến sau.
data.Indonesian: Peningkatan yang dipilih akan tetap berlaku di pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 큰 움직임이 가까워져.
data.English: The large movement is getting closer.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวขนาดใหญ่กำลังใกล้เข้ามา
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động lớn đang đến gần.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakan besar makin mendekat.

data.Korean: 먼저 도달하는 건 앞쪽 무리야.
data.English: The first to arrive will be the group up front.
data.Thai: สิ่งที่จะมาถึงก่อนคือฝูงด้านหน้า
data.Vietnamese: Bầy phía trước sẽ đến trước.
data.Indonesian: Yang akan tiba lebih dulu adalah gerombolan depan.

data.Korean: 좋아. 광장 입구로 이동해서, 제플 중심부로 이어지기 전에 막자.
data.English: All right. Move to the plaza entrance and stop them before they reach the center of Jeple.
data.Thai: ดี ไปที่ทางเข้าลาน แล้วหยุดพวกมันก่อนจะต่อไปถึงศูนย์กลางเจเพิล
data.Vietnamese: Được. Di chuyển đến lối vào quảng trường và chặn chúng trước khi chúng tiến vào trung tâm Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Bergerak ke pintu masuk alun-alun dan hentikan mereka sebelum mencapai pusat Jeple.

data.Korean: 주민들은 영주관 뒤편 대피로로 이동했습니다.
data.English: The residents have moved to the evacuation route behind the Lord's Manor.
data.Thai: ชาวบ้านย้ายไปยังทางอพยพด้านหลังคฤหาสน์เจ้าเมืองแล้วครับ
data.Vietnamese: Cư dân đã di chuyển đến đường sơ tán phía sau Dinh Lãnh chúa.
data.Indonesian: Warga sudah bergerak ke jalur evakuasi di belakang Wisma Penguasa.

data.Korean: 광장 입구만 막아 주시면 중심부까지 피해가 번지는 건 막을 수 있습니다.
data.English: If you can hold the plaza entrance, we can stop the damage from spreading to the center.
data.Thai: ถ้าช่วยกันทางเข้าลานไว้ได้ ก็จะหยุดไม่ให้ความเสียหายลามไปถึงศูนย์กลางครับ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu các vị chặn được lối vào quảng trường, chúng ta có thể ngăn thiệt hại lan tới trung tâm.
data.Indonesian: Jika Anda bisa menahan pintu masuk alun-alun, kami bisa mencegah kerusakan menyebar ke pusat.

data.Korean: 그럼 광장 입구에서 끝내자.
data.English: Then let us finish this at the plaza entrance.
data.Thai: งั้นจบเรื่องนี้ที่ทางเข้าลานกัน
data.Vietnamese: Vậy hãy kết thúc ở lối vào quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita selesaikan di pintu masuk alun-alun.

data.Korean: 제플 중심부는 내가 지켜낼게!
data.English: I will protect the center of Jeple!
data.Thai: ฉันจะปกป้องศูนย์กลางเจเพิลเอง!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ bảo vệ trung tâm Jeple!
data.Indonesian: Aku akan melindungi pusat Jeple!

data.Korean: 수로 쪽 큰 무리의 흔적이 광장 입구까지 이어져 있어.
data.English: The tracks of the large group from the waterway side continue all the way to the plaza entrance.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของฝูงใหญ่ฝั่งทางน้ำต่อมาถึงทางเข้าลาน
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết của bầy lớn từ phía kênh nước kéo dài tới tận lối vào quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Jejak gerombolan besar dari sisi saluran air berlanjut sampai pintu masuk alun-alun.

data.Korean: 주변 몬스터 흔적도 같은 방향으로 겹쳐 있어.
data.English: The traces of nearby monsters overlap in the same direction too.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยของมอนสเตอร์รอบ ๆ ก็ทับไปในทิศทางเดียวกันด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết của quái vật xung quanh cũng chồng lên theo cùng hướng.
data.Indonesian: Jejak monster di sekitar juga bertumpuk ke arah yang sama.

data.Korean: 수로를 정비해서 수로 쪽 몬스터는 경비병들도 막을 수 있을 거야.
data.English: Since we cleared the waterway, the guards should be able to stop the monsters on that side.
data.Thai: เพราะเราจัดการทางน้ำแล้ว มอนสเตอร์ฝั่งทางน้ำน่าจะให้ทหารยามรับมือได้
data.Vietnamese: Vì đã chỉnh lại kênh nước, lính gác có thể chặn quái vật phía kênh nước.
data.Indonesian: Karena kita sudah membereskan saluran air, para penjaga seharusnya bisa menahan monster di sisi itu.

data.Korean: 대신 대형 개체가 오래 버티면 광장 입구 방어선이 흔들릴 거야.
data.English: But if the large creature holds out for too long, the plaza entrance defensive line will start to shake.
data.Thai: แต่ถ้าสิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดใหญ่ยื้อไว้นานเกินไป แนวป้องกันทางเข้าลานจะเริ่มสั่นคลอน
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng nếu cá thể lớn trụ quá lâu, tuyến phòng thủ lối vào quảng trường sẽ lung lay.
data.Indonesian: Tapi jika makhluk besar itu bertahan terlalu lama, garis pertahanan pintu masuk alun-alun akan mulai goyah.

data.Korean: 광장은 넓어서 다친 사람을 찾기엔 낫지만...
data.English: The plaza is wide, so it is better for finding injured people, but...
data.Thai: ลานกว้าง เลยหาคนเจ็บได้ง่ายกว่า แต่...
data.Vietnamese: Quảng trường rộng nên dễ tìm người bị thương hơn, nhưng...
data.Indonesian: Alun-alun luas, jadi lebih mudah mencari orang terluka, tapi...

data.Korean: 넓은 만큼 뛰어다니다 다치기도 쉬워 보이네.
data.English: Because it is wide, it also looks easy to get hurt while running around.
data.Thai: เพราะมันกว้าง ก็เลยดูเหมือนจะบาดเจ็บตอนวิ่งไปมาได้ง่ายด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Vì rộng nên cũng dễ bị thương khi chạy qua chạy lại.
data.Indonesian: Karena luas, orang juga terlihat mudah terluka saat berlarian.

data.Korean: 대피로는 열어 두고, 광장 입구에서 막자.
data.English: Keep the evacuation route open and stop them at the plaza entrance.
data.Thai: เปิดทางอพยพไว้ แล้วหยุดพวกมันที่ทางเข้าลาน
data.Vietnamese: Giữ đường sơ tán mở và chặn chúng ở lối vào quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Biarkan jalur evakuasi tetap terbuka dan hentikan mereka di pintu masuk alun-alun.

data.Korean: 대형 개체가 나타나도 먼저 내려오는 무리부터 막자.
data.English: Even if the large creature appears, let us stop the group coming down first.
data.Thai: ต่อให้สิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดใหญ่ปรากฏตัว ก็หยุดฝูงที่ลงมาก่อนเป็นอันดับแรก
data.Vietnamese: Dù cá thể lớn xuất hiện, hãy chặn bầy đi xuống trước.
data.Indonesian: Meski makhluk besar muncul, kita tahan dulu gerombolan yang turun lebih awal.

data.Korean: 응. 대형 개체는 아직 앞쪽 무리 뒤에 있어.
data.English: Yeah. The large creature is still behind the front group.
data.Thai: อืม สิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดใหญ่ยังอยู่หลังฝูงด้านหน้า
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Cá thể lớn vẫn ở phía sau bầy trước.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Makhluk besar itu masih berada di belakang gerombolan depan.

data.Korean: 앞쪽 무리가 먼저 도달해.
data.English: The front group will arrive first.
data.Thai: ฝูงด้านหน้าจะมาถึงก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Bầy phía trước sẽ đến trước.
data.Indonesian: Gerombolan depan akan tiba lebih dulu.

data.Korean: 앞쪽은 내가 막을게!
data.English: I will stop the front!
data.Thai: ด้านหน้า ฉันจะหยุดเอง!
data.Vietnamese: Phía trước để tôi chặn!
data.Indonesian: Bagian depan akan aku tahan!

data.Korean: 뒤에 있는 큰 녀석도 오면 같이 막으면 되지!
data.English: If the big one behind them comes too, we can stop it together!
data.Thai: ถ้าเจ้าตัวใหญ่ข้างหลังมาด้วย ก็หยุดพร้อมกันได้เลย!
data.Vietnamese: Nếu con lớn phía sau cũng tới thì chặn luôn cùng nhau là được!
data.Indonesian: Kalau yang besar di belakang juga datang, kita hentikan sekalian!

data.Korean: 응. 대신 앞쪽 무리가 흩어지면 대피로 쪽이 위험해져.
data.English: Yeah. But if the front group scatters, the evacuation route will be in danger.
data.Thai: อืม แต่ถ้าฝูงด้านหน้าแตกกระจาย ทางอพยพจะอันตราย
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Nhưng nếu bầy phía trước tản ra, đường sơ tán sẽ nguy hiểm.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Tapi kalau gerombolan depan menyebar, jalur evakuasi akan berbahaya.

data.Korean: 다치면 바로 방어선 안쪽으로 빠져.
data.English: If you are hurt, fall back inside the defensive line right away.
data.Thai: ถ้าบาดเจ็บ ให้ถอยเข้าด้านในแนวป้องกันทันที
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị thương, hãy lùi vào trong tuyến phòng thủ ngay.
data.Indonesian: Kalau terluka, segera mundur ke dalam garis pertahanan.

data.Korean: 마지막이라고 참고 있으면 끝난 뒤가 더 힘들어져...
data.English: If you hold it in because it is the last battle, it will be harder after it ends...
data.Thai: ถ้าฝืนทนเพราะคิดว่าเป็นครั้งสุดท้าย หลังจบแล้วจะลำบากกว่าเดิมนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cố chịu vì nghĩ đây là trận cuối, sau khi kết thúc sẽ còn mệt hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau menahan sakit karena ini yang terakhir, setelah selesai akan lebih sulit...

data.Korean: 들어오고 있어.
data.English: They are coming in.
data.Thai: พวกมันกำลังเข้ามา
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang tiến vào.
data.Indonesian: Mereka masuk.

data.Korean: 앞쪽 무리가 곧 광장 입구에 도달해.
data.English: The front group will reach the plaza entrance soon.
data.Thai: ฝูงด้านหน้ากำลังจะถึงทางเข้าลานแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Bầy phía trước sắp tới lối vào quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Gerombolan depan akan segera mencapai pintu masuk alun-alun.

data.Korean: 좋아. 앞쪽 무리부터 광장 입구에서 막자.
data.English: All right. Let us stop the front group first at the plaza entrance.
data.Thai: ดี หยุดฝูงด้านหน้าก่อนที่ทางเข้าลาน
data.Vietnamese: Được. Chặn bầy phía trước trước ở lối vào quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kita hentikan gerombolan depan dulu di pintu masuk alun-alun.

data.Korean: 광장 안쪽으로 피해가 번지는 건 막았습니다.
data.English: We stopped the damage from spreading deeper into the plaza.
data.Thai: เราหยุดไม่ให้ความเสียหายลามเข้าไปด้านในลานได้ครับ
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã ngăn thiệt hại lan sâu vào trong quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Kami berhasil mencegah kerusakan menyebar ke bagian dalam alun-alun.

data.Korean: 제플 중심부도 무사합니다.
data.English: The center of Jeple is safe too.
data.Thai: ศูนย์กลางเจเพิลก็ปลอดภัยครับ
data.Vietnamese: Trung tâm Jeple cũng an toàn.
data.Indonesian: Pusat Jeple juga aman.

data.Korean: 좋아! 다들 제플도 지켜냈어!
data.English: Good! Everyone, we protected Jeple too!
data.Thai: ดีเลย! ทุกคน เราปกป้องเจเพิลได้แล้ว!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt quá! Mọi người, chúng ta cũng bảo vệ được Jeple rồi!
data.Indonesian: Bagus! Semuanya, kita juga berhasil melindungi Jeple!

data.Korean: 드디어 좋은 소식이네.
data.English: Finally, some good news.
data.Thai: ในที่สุดก็มีข่าวดีนะ
data.Vietnamese: Cuối cùng cũng có tin tốt.
data.Indonesian: Akhirnya ada kabar baik.

data.Korean: 이 정도면 쉬는 시간도 같이 지켜낸 거 아닐까...?
data.English: At this point, did we protect our break time too...?
data.Thai: ขนาดนี้แล้ว เราปกป้องเวลาพักไปด้วยหรือเปล่านะ...?
data.Vietnamese: Đến mức này thì có khi chúng ta cũng bảo vệ được giờ nghỉ rồi nhỉ...?
data.Indonesian: Kalau sejauh ini, bukankah kita juga melindungi waktu istirahat...?

data.Korean: 아직 결론 내리긴 일러.
data.English: It is too early to conclude that.
data.Thai: ยังเร็วเกินไปที่จะสรุปแบบนั้น
data.Vietnamese: Còn quá sớm để kết luận.
data.Indonesian: Masih terlalu cepat untuk menyimpulkan.

data.Korean: 대형 몬스터도 광장에서 멈추려던 건 아니었어.
data.English: The large monster was not trying to stop at the plaza either.
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์ขนาดใหญ่เองก็ไม่ได้พยายามหยุดที่ลาน
data.Vietnamese: Con quái vật lớn cũng không định dừng lại ở quảng trường.
data.Indonesian: Monster besar itu juga tidak berniat berhenti di alun-alun.

data.Korean: 흔적도 광장을 밟고 지나가려던 쪽에 가까워.
data.English: The tracks look closer to it trying to pass through the plaza.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยดูใกล้เคียงกับการพยายามเหยียบผ่านลานไปมากกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết giống như nó định giẫm qua quảng trường để đi tiếp hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jejaknya lebih seperti mencoba melewati alun-alun.

data.Korean: 제플이 목표가 아니라 지나가는 길이었다는 건가?
data.English: So Jeple was not the target, but a path it was passing through?
data.Thai: งั้นเจเพิลไม่ใช่เป้าหมาย แต่เป็นทางผ่านงั้นเหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy Jeple không phải mục tiêu, mà là con đường chúng đi qua sao?
data.Indonesian: Jadi Jeple bukan target, melainkan jalan yang dilewatinya?

data.Korean: 응. 지금까지 본 흔적은 그렇게 보여.
data.English: Yeah. The traces we have seen so far look that way.
data.Thai: อืม ร่องรอยที่เห็นมาจนถึงตอนนี้ดูเป็นแบบนั้น
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Những dấu vết chúng ta thấy đến giờ cho thấy như vậy.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Jejak yang kita lihat sejauh ini menunjukkan begitu.

data.Korean: 수로 정비 중 추가 보고가 들어왔습니다. 막힌 물길과 몬스터 흔적이 모두 루메르 숲 방향을 가리킨다고 합니다.
data.English: An additional report came in during the waterway repairs. They say both the blocked waterway and the monster tracks point toward Lumer Forest.
data.Thai: มีรายงานเพิ่มเติมระหว่างซ่อมทางน้ำครับ ทั้งทางน้ำที่ถูกปิดและร่องรอยมอนสเตอร์ต่างชี้ไปทางป่าลูเมอร์
data.Vietnamese: Có báo cáo bổ sung trong lúc sửa kênh nước. Họ nói cả kênh nước bị tắc lẫn dấu vết quái vật đều chỉ về phía rừng Lumer.
data.Indonesian: Ada laporan tambahan saat perbaikan saluran air. Katanya saluran air yang tersumbat dan jejak monster sama-sama mengarah ke Hutan Lumer.

data.Korean: 루메르 숲?
data.English: Lumer Forest?
data.Thai: ป่าลูเมอร์เหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Rừng Lumer?
data.Indonesian: Hutan Lumer?

data.Korean: 숲이면 또 걷는 거네...
data.English: If it is a forest, that means more walking...
data.Thai: ถ้าเป็นป่า ก็ต้องเดินอีกแล้วสินะ...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu là rừng thì lại phải đi bộ nữa...
data.Indonesian: Kalau hutan, berarti berjalan lagi...

data.Korean: 나무 그늘이 있겠지...? 제발 그래야 하는데...
data.English: There will be tree shade, right...? Please let there be...
data.Thai: คงมีร่มไม้ใช่ไหม...? ขอให้มีเถอะ...
data.Vietnamese: Chắc sẽ có bóng cây chứ...? Mong là vậy...
data.Indonesian: Pasti ada naungan pohon, kan...? Semoga saja ada...

data.Korean: 쉬는 건 나중에 하자.
data.English: Let us rest later.
data.Thai: พักไว้ทีหลังเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Nghỉ ngơi để sau đi.
data.Indonesian: Istirahat nanti saja.

data.Korean: 그럼 제플 안으로 들어온 건 숲 쪽에서 밀려온 몬스터 움직임 때문일 수도 있겠네.
data.English: Then the monsters entering Jeple may have been caused by movement being driven in from the forest side.
data.Thai: งั้นที่พวกมันเข้ามาในเจเพิล อาจเป็นเพราะการเคลื่อนไหวที่ถูกดันมาจากฝั่งป่า
data.Vietnamese: Vậy việc chúng vào Jeple có thể là do chuyển động bị đẩy tới từ phía rừng.
data.Indonesian: Berarti masuknya mereka ke Jeple mungkin disebabkan pergerakan yang terdorong dari sisi hutan.

data.Korean: 가능성은 있어. 대신 아직 원인은 몰라. 직접 확인해야 해.
data.English: It is possible. But we still do not know the cause. We need to check it ourselves.
data.Thai: เป็นไปได้ แต่เรายังไม่รู้สาเหตุ ต้องไปตรวจด้วยตัวเอง
data.Vietnamese: Có khả năng. Nhưng vẫn chưa biết nguyên nhân. Chúng ta phải tự kiểm tra.
data.Indonesian: Ada kemungkinan. Tapi kita masih belum tahu penyebabnya. Kita harus memeriksanya langsung.

data.Korean: 숲 방향 흔적이 제일 진해.
data.English: The traces toward the forest are the strongest.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยทางฝั่งป่าชัดที่สุด
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết hướng về phía rừng là rõ nhất.
data.Indonesian: Jejak menuju hutan adalah yang paling kuat.

data.Korean: 물길과 발자국이 같은 쪽을 가리키고 있어.
data.English: The waterway and the footprints are pointing the same way.
data.Thai: ทางน้ำกับรอยเท้าชี้ไปทางเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Dòng nước và dấu chân đều chỉ về cùng một hướng.
data.Indonesian: Aliran air dan jejak kaki menunjuk ke arah yang sama.

data.Korean: 숲 쪽에서 또 밀려오면, 제플도 다시 위험해져.
data.English: If they get driven in from the forest side again, Jeple will be in danger again too.
data.Thai: ถ้าพวกมันถูกดันมาจากฝั่งป่าอีก เจเพิลก็จะตกอยู่ในอันตรายอีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chúng lại bị dồn tới từ phía rừng, Jeple cũng sẽ nguy hiểm lần nữa.
data.Indonesian: Kalau mereka terdorong dari sisi hutan lagi, Jeple juga akan kembali berbahaya.

data.Korean: 제플 방어는 관리인에게 인계하고, 우리는 루메르 숲 입구로 이동하자.
data.English: Hand Jeple's defense over to the manager, and let's move to the entrance of Lumer Forest.
data.Thai: ส่งต่อการป้องกันเจเพิลให้ผู้ดูแล แล้วพวกเราไปที่ทางเข้าป่าลูเมอร์กัน
data.Vietnamese: Bàn giao phòng thủ Jeple cho quản lý, rồi chúng ta di chuyển đến lối vào rừng Lumer.
data.Indonesian: Serahkan pertahanan Jeple kepada pengelola, lalu kita bergerak ke pintu masuk Hutan Lumer.

data.Korean: 응. 제플에서 본 움직임이 어디까지 이어지는지 봐야 해.
data.English: Yeah. We need to see how far the movement we saw in Jeple continues.
data.Thai: อืม ต้องดูว่าการเคลื่อนไหวที่เห็นในเจเพิลต่อเนื่องไปถึงไหน
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Chúng ta cần xem chuyển động thấy ở Jeple kéo dài đến đâu.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Kita harus melihat sejauh mana pergerakan yang terlihat di Jeple berlanjut.

data.Korean: 제플에서 본 흔적이 여기까지 이어져 있어.
data.English: The traces we saw in Jeple continue all the way here.
data.Thai: ร่องรอยที่เห็นในเจเพิลต่อเนื่องมาถึงที่นี่
data.Vietnamese: Dấu vết thấy ở Jeple kéo dài tới tận đây.
data.Indonesian: Jejak yang kita lihat di Jeple berlanjut sampai ke sini.

data.Korean: 방향은 숲 안쪽에서 바깥쪽이야.
data.English: The direction is from inside the forest to the outside.
data.Thai: ทิศทางคือจากด้านในป่าออกมาด้านนอก
data.Vietnamese: Hướng đi là từ trong rừng ra bên ngoài.
data.Indonesian: Arahnya dari dalam hutan menuju ke luar.

data.Korean: 그럼 몬스터들이 여기에서 제플 쪽으로 몰려간 거네.
data.English: Then the monsters rushed from here toward Jeple.
data.Thai: งั้นพวกมอนสเตอร์ก็กรูกันจากที่นี่ไปทางเจเพิล
data.Vietnamese: Vậy quái vật đã ùa từ đây về phía Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Berarti para monster bergerombol dari sini menuju Jeple.

data.Korean: 여기가 시작점이라고 단정하긴 일러.
data.English: It's too early to say this is where it started.
data.Thai: ยังเร็วเกินไปที่จะสรุปว่าที่นี่คือจุดเริ่มต้น
data.Vietnamese: Còn quá sớm để kết luận đây là điểm bắt đầu.
data.Indonesian: Masih terlalu cepat untuk memastikan ini titik awalnya.

data.Korean: 하지만 확실한 건, 몬스터들이 숲 안쪽에서 바깥쪽으로 몰려나왔다는 거야.
data.English: But what is clear is that the monsters came flooding out from inside the forest.
data.Thai: แต่ที่แน่ชัดคือพวกมอนสเตอร์กรูกันออกมาจากด้านในป่า
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng điều chắc chắn là quái vật đã ùa ra từ bên trong rừng.
data.Indonesian: Tapi yang jelas, para monster berbondong-bondong keluar dari dalam hutan.

data.Korean: 제플 바로 뒤에 이런 흔적이 이어져 있었다니...
data.English: I can't believe traces like this continued right behind Jeple...
data.Thai: ไม่นึกเลยว่าร่องรอยแบบนี้จะต่อเนื่องอยู่หลังเจเพิลทันที...
data.Vietnamese: Không ngờ dấu vết như thế này lại kéo dài ngay sau Jeple...
data.Indonesian: Tidak kusangka jejak seperti ini berlanjut tepat di belakang Jeple...

data.Korean: 막아낸 뒤에 봐도 기분이 썩 좋진 않네.
data.English: Even seeing it after we stopped them, it still doesn't feel good.
data.Thai: ถึงจะเห็นหลังจากหยุดพวกมันได้แล้ว ก็ยังรู้สึกไม่ค่อยดีเลย
data.Vietnamese: Dù nhìn thấy sau khi đã chặn được chúng, cảm giác vẫn chẳng dễ chịu gì.
data.Indonesian: Bahkan setelah kita berhasil menahan mereka, melihat ini tetap terasa tidak enak.

data.Korean: 숲은 조용한 곳이라고 생각했는데...
data.English: I thought forests were quiet places...
data.Thai: ฉันนึกว่าป่าเป็นที่เงียบ ๆ ซะอีก...
data.Vietnamese: Tôi cứ nghĩ rừng là nơi yên tĩnh...
data.Indonesian: Kupikir hutan itu tempat yang tenang...

data.Korean: 조용해서 더 불편한 곳도 있구나.
data.English: So some places are even more uncomfortable because they're quiet.
data.Thai: มีที่ที่เงียบจนยิ่งทำให้อึดอัดด้วยสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Hóa ra cũng có nơi vì yên tĩnh mà càng khó chịu hơn.
data.Indonesian: Ternyata ada tempat yang justru makin tidak nyaman karena terlalu tenang.

data.Korean: 괜찮아! 조용할 때 얼른 확인하면 되지!
data.English: It's okay! If it's quiet, we can hurry and check it now!
data.Thai: ไม่เป็นไร! ตอนเงียบ ๆ ก็รีบตรวจดูได้เลยไง!
data.Vietnamese: Không sao! Đang yên tĩnh thì mình kiểm tra nhanh là được!
data.Indonesian: Tidak apa-apa! Kalau sedang tenang, kita bisa cepat memeriksanya!

data.Korean: ...소리가 안 나는 게 더 불안해졌어.
data.English: ...The lack of sound just made me more uneasy.
data.Thai: ...การที่ไม่มีเสียงยิ่งทำให้ไม่สบายใจกว่าเดิม
data.Vietnamese: ...Việc không có tiếng động lại làm tôi bất an hơn.
data.Indonesian: ...Tidak adanya suara malah membuatku makin gelisah.

data.Korean: 안쪽으로 들어가기 전에, 입구 쪽 흔적부터 확인하자.
data.English: Before we head inside, let's check the traces near the entrance first.
data.Thai: ก่อนเข้าไปด้านใน ตรวจร่องรอยฝั่งทางเข้าก่อนเถอะ
data.Vietnamese: Trước khi vào bên trong, hãy kiểm tra dấu vết phía lối vào trước.
data.Indonesian: Sebelum masuk ke dalam, kita periksa dulu jejak di sisi pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 발자국이 흩어져 있어.
data.English: The footprints are scattered.
data.Thai: รอยเท้ากระจัดกระจายอยู่
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân bị phân tán.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kakinya tersebar.

data.Korean: 싸우려고 모인 게 아니라, 방향을 잃고 입구 쪽으로 몰린 흔적이야.
data.English: They weren't gathering to fight. These are traces of them losing direction and crowding toward the entrance.
data.Thai: ไม่ใช่ร่องรอยที่รวมตัวเพื่อสู้ แต่เป็นร่องรอยของพวกมันที่หลงทิศแล้วกรูกันไปทางเข้า
data.Vietnamese: Không phải chúng tụ lại để chiến đấu. Đây là dấu vết chúng mất phương hướng rồi dồn về phía lối vào.
data.Indonesian: Mereka tidak berkumpul untuk bertarung. Ini jejak mereka kehilangan arah lalu bergerombol ke pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 바깥쪽 발자국은 깊고, 안쪽으로 돌아간 발자국은 얕아.
data.English: The footprints heading outside are deep, and the ones that turned back inside are shallow.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าที่ไปด้านนอกลึก ส่วนรอยเท้าที่วกกลับเข้าไปด้านในตื้น
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân hướng ra ngoài thì sâu, còn dấu chân quay lại bên trong thì nông.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki yang menuju keluar tampak dalam, sedangkan yang kembali ke dalam tampak dangkal.

data.Korean: 힘으로 밀려 나온 뒤에 다시 숲으로 숨으려 한 것 같아.
data.English: It looks like they were forced out, then tried to hide back in the forest.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนพวกมันถูกแรงบางอย่างดันออกมา แล้วพยายามกลับไปซ่อนในป่าอีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ chúng bị ép bật ra ngoài, rồi cố quay lại trốn trong rừng.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya mereka terdesak keluar oleh suatu kekuatan, lalu mencoba bersembunyi kembali ke hutan.

data.Korean: 같은 자리를 오간 게 아니라, 밀렸다가 버틴 흔적이네.
data.English: They weren't going back and forth over the same spot. These are traces of being pushed out and then holding their ground.
data.Thai: ไม่ใช่ว่าเดินวนที่เดิม แต่เป็นร่องรอยที่ถูกดันออกมาแล้วพยายามยันไว้
data.Vietnamese: Không phải chúng đi qua lại cùng một chỗ, mà là dấu vết bị đẩy ra rồi cố trụ lại.
data.Indonesian: Mereka bukan mondar-mandir di tempat yang sama. Ini jejak terdorong keluar lalu mencoba bertahan.

data.Korean: 길을 잃은 거라면 더 조심해야겠네.
data.English: If they lost their way, we need to be even more careful.
data.Thai: ถ้าพวกมันหลงทาง ก็ต้องระวังมากขึ้นแล้วล่ะ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chúng bị lạc đường thì càng phải cẩn thận hơn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau mereka tersesat, kita harus lebih berhati-hati.

data.Korean: 어디로 튈지 모르는 거잖아.
data.English: That means we don't know where they'll bolt next.
data.Thai: เพราะไม่รู้ว่าพวกมันจะพุ่งไปทางไหนน่ะสิ
data.Vietnamese: Tức là không biết chúng sẽ lao về hướng nào.
data.Indonesian: Artinya kita tidak tahu mereka akan melesat ke mana.

data.Korean: 응. 무리하게 쫓기보다 입구 쪽을 막아야 해.
data.English: Yeah. Rather than chase them recklessly, we need to block the entrance side.
data.Thai: อืม แทนที่จะไล่ตามฝืน ๆ เราควรกันฝั่งทางเข้าไว้
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Thay vì đuổi theo liều lĩnh, chúng ta phải chặn phía lối vào.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Daripada mengejar secara paksa, kita harus menahan sisi pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 여기서 흩어지면 제플 쪽으로 다시 내려갈 수 있어.
data.English: If they scatter here, they could head down toward Jeple again.
data.Thai: ถ้าพวกมันแตกกระจายตรงนี้ อาจลงไปทางเจเพิลอีกได้
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chúng tản ra ở đây, chúng có thể lại đi xuống phía Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Kalau mereka menyebar di sini, mereka bisa turun ke arah Jeple lagi.

data.Korean: 그럼 입구에서 한 번 잡아 둬야겠네.
data.English: Then we need to hold them at the entrance first.
data.Thai: งั้นต้องจับพวกมันไว้ที่ทางเข้าก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Vậy phải giữ chúng lại ở lối vào trước.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita harus menahan mereka dulu di pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 앞쪽은 내가 맡을게.
data.English: I'll take the front.
data.Thai: ด้านหน้าฉันรับเอง
data.Vietnamese: Phía trước để tôi lo.
data.Indonesian: Bagian depan biar aku yang urus.

data.Korean: 숲 밖으로는 못 가게 할게!
data.English: I won't let them get out of the forest!
data.Thai: ฉันจะไม่ให้พวกมันออกนอกป่าไปได้!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ không để chúng ra khỏi rừng!
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak akan membiarkan mereka keluar dari hutan!

data.Korean: 숲길에서 다치면 옮기기도 어렵겠네.
data.English: If someone gets hurt on a forest path, moving them will be hard too.
data.Thai: ถ้าบาดเจ็บบนทางในป่า การเคลื่อนย้ายก็คงยากด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị thương trên đường rừng thì đưa đi cũng khó.
data.Indonesian: Kalau terluka di jalan hutan, memindahkannya juga akan sulit.

data.Korean: 제발 평평한 곳에서만 넘어져 줬으면 좋겠어...
data.English: Please, if anyone has to fall, let it only be on flat ground...
data.Thai: ขอร้องล่ะ ถ้าจะล้มก็ช่วยล้มเฉพาะที่พื้นเรียบเถอะ...
data.Vietnamese: Làm ơn, nếu có ngã thì chỉ ngã ở chỗ bằng phẳng thôi nhé...
data.Indonesian: Kumohon, kalau ada yang jatuh, semoga hanya di tanah yang rata...

data.Korean: 움직임이 가까워졌어.
data.English: The movement has gotten closer.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวเข้ามาใกล้แล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động đã đến gần hơn.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakannya sudah mendekat.

data.Korean: 입구 쪽으로 몰려나오고 있어.
data.English: They're crowding out toward the entrance.
data.Thai: พวกมันกำลังกรูออกมาทางทางเข้า
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang ùa ra về phía lối vào.
data.Indonesian: Mereka bergerombol keluar menuju pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 좋아. 제플 쪽으로 몰려가기 전에 루메르 숲 입구에서 막자.
data.English: All right. Stop them at the entrance of Lumer Forest before they rush toward Jeple.
data.Thai: ดี หยุดพวกมันที่ทางเข้าป่าลูเมอร์ ก่อนที่พวกมันจะกรูกันไปทางเจเพิล
data.Vietnamese: Được. Chặn chúng ở lối vào rừng Lumer trước khi chúng ùa về phía Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Hentikan mereka di pintu masuk Hutan Lumer sebelum mereka bergerombol menuju Jeple.

data.Korean: 막긴 했는데... 이상해.
data.English: We stopped them, but... it's strange.
data.Thai: เราหยุดพวกมันได้ก็จริง... แต่มันแปลก
data.Vietnamese: Chúng ta đã chặn được, nhưng... lạ quá.
data.Indonesian: Kita memang berhasil menahan mereka, tapi... ini aneh.

data.Korean: 덤벼든다기보다 빠져나오려던 것 같았어.
data.English: It felt more like they were trying to get out than attack.
data.Thai: เหมือนพวกมันพยายามหนีออกมามากกว่าจะพุ่งเข้าโจมตี
data.Vietnamese: Có cảm giác chúng cố thoát ra hơn là lao vào tấn công.
data.Indonesian: Rasanya mereka lebih seperti mencoba keluar daripada menyerang.

data.Korean: 싸우려는 것처럼 보이진 않았지만, 제플 쪽으로 다시 내려가게 둘 순 없었어.
data.English: They didn't look like they wanted to fight, but we couldn't let them head back down toward Jeple.
data.Thai: พวกมันไม่ได้ดูเหมือนอยากสู้ แต่เราปล่อยให้ลงไปทางเจเพิลอีกไม่ได้
data.Vietnamese: Chúng không có vẻ muốn chiến đấu, nhưng chúng ta không thể để chúng lại đi xuống phía Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Mereka tidak tampak ingin bertarung, tapi kita tidak bisa membiarkan mereka turun lagi ke arah Jeple.

data.Korean: 응. 우리를 향해 모인 흔적이 아니야.
data.English: Yeah. These aren't traces of them gathering toward us.
data.Thai: อืม นี่ไม่ใช่ร่องรอยที่พวกมันรวมตัวเข้าหาเรา
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Đây không phải dấu vết chúng tụ lại về phía chúng ta.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Ini bukan jejak mereka berkumpul menuju kita.

data.Korean: 안쪽을 피해 입구 쪽으로 몰려나온 흔적이야.
data.English: These are traces of them avoiding the inside and crowding out toward the entrance.
data.Thai: เป็นร่องรอยที่พวกมันเลี่ยงด้านใน แล้วกรูออกมาทางทางเข้า
data.Vietnamese: Đây là dấu vết chúng tránh bên trong rồi ùa ra phía lối vào.
data.Indonesian: Ini jejak mereka menghindari bagian dalam lalu bergerombol keluar ke pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 제플에서 본 것보다 더 분명하네.
data.English: It's clearer than what we saw in Jeple.
data.Thai: ชัดกว่าสิ่งที่เห็นในเจเพิลอีก
data.Vietnamese: Rõ hơn những gì thấy ở Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Ini lebih jelas daripada yang kita lihat di Jeple.

data.Korean: 이건 단순히 길을 따라 이동한 게 아니야.
data.English: This wasn't simply movement along a path.
data.Thai: นี่ไม่ใช่แค่การเคลื่อนที่ไปตามทางธรรมดา
data.Vietnamese: Đây không đơn giản là di chuyển theo đường.
data.Indonesian: Ini bukan sekadar bergerak mengikuti jalan.

data.Korean: 그러면 숲 안쪽엔 더 끔찍한 게 있다는 뜻이겠지...?
data.English: Then that means there's something more horrific inside the forest, right...?
data.Thai: งั้นก็แปลว่าข้างในป่ามีอะไรที่น่ากลัวกว่านั้นสินะ...?
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nghĩa là trong rừng còn có thứ gì đó kinh khủng hơn, đúng không...?
data.Indonesian: Berarti di dalam hutan ada sesuatu yang lebih mengerikan, kan...?

data.Korean: 듣기만 해도 쉬고 싶어져.
data.English: Just hearing that makes me want to rest.
data.Thai: แค่ฟังก็อยากพักแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ nghe thôi đã muốn nghỉ rồi.
data.Indonesian: Mendengarnya saja membuatku ingin istirahat.

data.Korean: 쉬고 싶어지는 건 이해해.
data.English: I understand wanting to rest.
data.Thai: ฉันเข้าใจนะว่าอยากพัก
data.Vietnamese: Tôi hiểu là muốn nghỉ.
data.Indonesian: Aku mengerti kalau ingin istirahat.

data.Korean: 그래도 지금은 입구에서 멈춘 이유부터 봐야 해.
data.English: Still, right now we need to see why they stopped at the entrance first.
data.Thai: แต่ตอนนี้ต้องดูก่อนว่าทำไมพวกมันถึงหยุดที่ทางเข้า
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng lúc này phải xem trước vì sao chúng dừng lại ở lối vào.
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, sekarang kita harus melihat dulu alasan mereka berhenti di pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 발자국이 오솔길 쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: The footprints continue toward the footpath.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าต่อเนื่องไปทางทางเดินเล็ก
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân kéo dài về phía lối mòn.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kakinya berlanjut ke arah jalan setapak.

data.Korean: 일부는 입구에서 다시 안쪽으로 돌아간 것 같아.
data.English: Some of them seem to have turned back inside from the entrance.
data.Thai: บางส่วนเหมือนวกจากทางเข้ากลับเข้าไปด้านในอีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Một số có vẻ đã quay lại bên trong từ lối vào.
data.Indonesian: Sebagian tampaknya berbalik masuk lagi dari pintu masuk.

data.Korean: 그럼 아직 여기서 끝난 건 아니네.
data.English: Then this isn't over here yet.
data.Thai: งั้นเรื่องนี้ยังไม่จบแค่ตรงนี้สินะ
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chuyện này vẫn chưa kết thúc ở đây.
data.Indonesian: Berarti ini belum selesai di sini.

data.Korean: 숲 안쪽에 아직 남은 게 있는 거지?
data.English: There's still something left inside the forest, right?
data.Thai: ยังมีอะไรเหลืออยู่ข้างในป่าใช่ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Trong rừng vẫn còn thứ gì đó, đúng không?
data.Indonesian: Masih ada sesuatu yang tersisa di dalam hutan, kan?

data.Korean: 숲 입구 전투 기록을 정리하자.
data.English: Let's organize the battle record from the forest entrance.
data.Thai: จัดระเบียบบันทึกการต่อสู้ที่ทางเข้าป่ากัน
data.Vietnamese: Hãy tổng hợp ghi chép trận chiến ở lối vào rừng.
data.Indonesian: Mari kita susun catatan pertempuran di pintu masuk hutan.

data.Korean: 제플에서 본 흔적과 비교한 뒤, 안쪽으로 들어갈 준비를 하자.
data.English: After comparing them with the traces we saw in Jeple, let's prepare to head inside.
data.Thai: หลังจากเทียบกับร่องรอยที่เห็นในเจเพิลแล้ว ก็เตรียมเข้าไปด้านในกัน
data.Vietnamese: Sau khi so sánh với dấu vết thấy ở Jeple, hãy chuẩn bị tiến vào bên trong.
data.Indonesian: Setelah membandingkannya dengan jejak yang kita lihat di Jeple, mari bersiap masuk ke dalam.

data.Korean: 응. 제플 때보다 더 자세히 봐야겠어.
data.English: Yeah. We'll need to look more closely than we did at Jeple.
data.Thai: อืม ต้องดูให้ละเอียดกว่าตอนอยู่ที่เจเพิล
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Chúng ta phải xem kỹ hơn lúc ở Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Kita harus memeriksanya lebih rinci daripada saat di Jeple.

data.Korean: 발자국이 한 번에 이어지지 않아.
data.English: The footprints don't continue in one straight line.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าไม่ได้ต่อเนื่องเป็นเส้นเดียว
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân không nối liền thành một mạch.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kakinya tidak berlanjut dalam satu jalur lurus.

data.Korean: 몇 번이나 방향을 바꾸다가 결국 같은 쪽으로 몰려간 흔적이야.
data.English: They changed direction several times, but in the end they all crowded toward the same side.
data.Thai: เป็นร่องรอยที่เปลี่ยนทิศหลายครั้ง แต่สุดท้ายก็กรูกันไปทางเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đổi hướng nhiều lần, nhưng cuối cùng vẫn dồn về cùng một phía.
data.Indonesian: Mereka beberapa kali mengubah arah, tapi akhirnya tetap bergerombol ke sisi yang sama.

data.Korean: 깊은 발자국은 숲 밖으로, 얕은 발자국은 안쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: The deep footprints lead out of the forest, and the shallow ones lead inward.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าลึกต่อออกไปนอกป่า ส่วนรอยเท้าตื้นต่อเข้าไปด้านใน
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân sâu dẫn ra ngoài rừng, còn dấu chân nông dẫn vào bên trong.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki yang dalam menuju keluar hutan, sedangkan yang dangkal menuju ke dalam.

data.Korean: 길을 잃은 몬스터들이 한꺼번에 같은 쪽으로 몰려간 것 같네.
data.English: It looks like monsters that lost their way all crowded toward the same side at once.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนพวกมอนสเตอร์ที่หลงทางจะกรูกันไปทางเดียวกันพร้อมกัน
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ lũ quái vật lạc đường đã đồng loạt dồn về cùng một phía.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya para monster yang tersesat bergerombol sekaligus ke sisi yang sama.

data.Korean: 응. 대신 그냥 헤맨 것치고는 방향이 너무 비슷해.
data.English: Yeah. But for simple wandering, their direction is too similar.
data.Thai: อืม แต่ถ้าแค่หลงทาง ทิศทางมันเหมือนกันเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Nhưng nếu chỉ là lang thang thì hướng đi của chúng quá giống nhau.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Tapi kalau hanya tersesat, arah mereka terlalu mirip.

data.Korean: 오솔길 전체를 쫓기보다, 같은 방향으로 모이는 지점을 봐야 해.
data.English: Rather than follow the whole footpath, we need to look for where they gather in the same direction.
data.Thai: แทนที่จะไล่ตามทั้งทางเดินเล็ก เราควรดูจุดที่พวกมันไปรวมกันในทิศเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Thay vì lần theo cả lối mòn, chúng ta cần xem điểm chúng tụ lại theo cùng hướng.
data.Indonesian: Daripada mengikuti seluruh jalan setapak, kita harus melihat titik tempat mereka berkumpul ke arah yang sama.

data.Korean: 숲에서 길을 잃으면 사람도 꽤 위험한데...
data.English: Even people are in real danger if they get lost in a forest...
data.Thai: ถ้าคนหลงทางในป่าก็อันตรายมากอยู่แล้ว...
data.Vietnamese: Ngay cả con người nếu lạc trong rừng cũng khá nguy hiểm...
data.Indonesian: Manusia saja cukup berbahaya kalau tersesat di hutan...

data.Korean: 몬스터까지 길을 잃으면 더 귀찮아지는구나.
data.English: So it gets even more troublesome when monsters get lost too.
data.Thai: พอมอนสเตอร์หลงทางด้วย เรื่องก็ยิ่งยุ่งยากสินะ
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cả quái vật cũng lạc đường thì càng phiền hơn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau monster juga tersesat, urusannya jadi makin merepotkan.

data.Korean: 오솔길을 따라가서, 흔적이 다시 갈라지기 전에 방향을 확인하자.
data.English: Let's follow the footpath and confirm the direction before the traces split again.
data.Thai: ไปตามทางเดินเล็ก แล้วตรวจทิศทางก่อนที่ร่องรอยจะแยกอีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Hãy đi theo lối mòn và xác nhận hướng trước khi dấu vết lại tách ra.
data.Indonesian: Ikuti jalan setapak dan pastikan arahnya sebelum jejaknya bercabang lagi.

data.Korean: 제플 방향 표식도 남겨 둬. 돌아오는 길이 막히면 안 돼.
data.English: Leave markers toward Jeple too. We can't let the way back get blocked.
data.Thai: ทำเครื่องหมายทิศไปเจเพิลไว้ด้วย ทางกลับจะถูกปิดไม่ได้
data.Vietnamese: Đánh dấu hướng về Jeple nữa. Không được để đường quay lại bị chặn.
data.Indonesian: Tinggalkan penanda arah ke Jeple juga. Jalan kembali tidak boleh sampai tertutup.

data.Korean: 오, 돌아오는 길은 정말 중요하지...
data.English: Oh, the way back really is important...
data.Thai: โอ้ ทางกลับนี่สำคัญจริง ๆ นะ...
data.Vietnamese: Ồ, đường quay lại đúng là quan trọng thật...
data.Indonesian: Oh, jalan kembali memang benar-benar penting...

data.Korean: 오솔길 쪽은 발자국이 더 얕아.
data.English: The footprints toward the footpath are shallower.
data.Thai: รอยเท้าฝั่งทางเดินเล็กตื้นกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Dấu chân phía lối mòn nông hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jejak kaki ke arah jalan setapak lebih dangkal.

data.Korean: 뛰었다기보다, 밀려나지 않으려고 버틴 흔적이야.
data.English: Rather than running, these are traces of trying to hold their ground and not be pushed away.
data.Thai: ไม่ใช่ร่องรอยของการวิ่ง แต่เหมือนพยายามยันไว้ไม่ให้ถูกดันออกไป
data.Vietnamese: Không giống chạy, mà là dấu vết cố trụ lại để không bị đẩy bật ra.
data.Indonesian: Bukan seperti berlari, melainkan jejak mencoba bertahan agar tidak terdorong pergi.

data.Korean: 숲 안쪽에 움직임을 흔드는 요인이 있을지도 몰라.
data.English: There may be something inside the forest disrupting their movement.
data.Thai: อาจมีปัจจัยบางอย่างในป่าที่ทำให้การเคลื่อนไหวของพวกมันสั่นคลอน
data.Vietnamese: Có thể có thứ gì đó trong rừng làm rối chuyển động của chúng.
data.Indonesian: Mungkin ada sesuatu di dalam hutan yang mengacaukan pergerakan mereka.

data.Korean: 아직은 가능성으로만 두자.
data.English: For now, let's leave it as a possibility.
data.Thai: ตอนนี้ให้ถือว่าเป็นแค่ความเป็นไปได้ก่อน
data.Vietnamese: Hiện giờ cứ xem đó là một khả năng thôi.
data.Indonesian: Untuk sekarang, anggap saja itu masih kemungkinan.

data.Korean: 신호석 반응도 약하지만 숲 안쪽으로 이어져 있어.
data.English: The signal stone reaction is weak, but it also continues deeper into the forest.
data.Thai: ปฏิกิริยาของหินสัญญาณอ่อน แต่ก็ทอดลึกเข้าไปในป่า
data.Vietnamese: Phản ứng của đá tín hiệu yếu, nhưng cũng kéo dài vào sâu trong rừng.
data.Indonesian: Reaksi batu sinyalnya lemah, tapi juga berlanjut ke dalam hutan.

data.Korean: 원인이라기보다, 따라갈 수 있는 흔적 정도야.
data.English: It's less a cause and more a trace we can follow.
data.Thai: มันไม่เชิงเป็นสาเหตุ แต่เป็นร่องรอยที่ตามไปได้มากกว่า
data.Vietnamese: Nó không hẳn là nguyên nhân, mà giống một dấu vết có thể lần theo.
data.Indonesian: Itu lebih seperti jejak yang bisa kita ikuti, bukan penyebabnya.

data.Korean: 좋아. 표시를 놓치지 말고 들어가자!
data.English: Good. Let's go in without losing the markers!
data.Thai: ดี เข้าไปโดยอย่าให้พลาดเครื่องหมายล่ะ!
data.Vietnamese: Được. Vào trong nhưng đừng bỏ sót dấu hiệu nhé!
data.Indonesian: Baik. Masuklah tanpa kehilangan penandanya!

data.Korean: 들어가는 건 좋은데, 나오는 길도 기억해 두자.
data.English: Going in is fine, but let's remember the way out too.
data.Thai: เข้าไปน่ะได้ แต่อย่าลืมจำทางออกไว้ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Vào thì được, nhưng cũng nhớ đường ra nhé.
data.Indonesian: Masuk boleh saja, tapi ingat juga jalan keluarnya.

data.Korean: 길 잃는 쪽에 우리까지 추가되면 곤란해...
data.English: It'd be a problem if we got added to the list of lost ones...
data.Thai: ถ้าฝั่งที่หลงทางมีพวกเราเพิ่มเข้าไปด้วยคงลำบาก...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cả chúng ta cũng thành bên bị lạc thì rắc rối lắm...
data.Indonesian: Akan gawat kalau kita ikut masuk daftar yang tersesat...

data.Korean: 영구 강화 선택 UI가 열린다.
data.English: The permanent enhancement selection UI opens.
data.Thai: UI เลือกการเสริมพลังถาวรเปิดขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: UI chọn cường hóa vĩnh viễn mở ra.
data.Indonesian: UI pilihan peningkatan permanen terbuka.

data.Korean: 선택 예시: 노아 치명타 확률 증가 / 세라 체력 증가 / 스파인 회복량 증가.
data.English: Selection examples: Noah critical rate increase / Serah HP increase / Spayne healing amount increase.
data.Thai: ตัวอย่างตัวเลือก: เพิ่มอัตราคริติคอลของโนอา / เพิ่ม HP ของเซราห์ / เพิ่มปริมาณการรักษาของสไปน์
data.Vietnamese: Ví dụ lựa chọn: tăng tỷ lệ chí mạng cho Noah / tăng HP cho Serah / tăng lượng hồi phục cho Spayne.
data.Indonesian: Contoh pilihan: peningkatan peluang kritikal Noah / peningkatan HP Serah / peningkatan jumlah penyembuhan Spayne.

data.Korean: 선택한 강화는 이후 전투에도 유지된다.
data.English: The selected enhancement remains in later battles.
data.Thai: การเสริมพลังที่เลือกจะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อ ๆ ไป
data.Vietnamese: Cường hóa đã chọn sẽ duy trì trong các trận chiến sau.
data.Indonesian: Peningkatan yang dipilih akan tetap berlaku di pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 여기서부터 흔적이 더 복잡해졌어.
data.English: From here, the traces have gotten more complicated.
data.Thai: ตั้งแต่ตรงนี้ ร่องรอยซับซ้อนขึ้น
data.Vietnamese: Từ đây, dấu vết trở nên phức tạp hơn.
data.Indonesian: Mulai dari sini, jejaknya menjadi lebih rumit.

data.Korean: 길을 따라가다가, 덤불로 빠졌다가, 다시 길로 돌아왔어.
data.English: They followed the path, slipped into the bushes, then returned to the path again.
data.Thai: พวกมันไปตามทาง แวะเข้าไปในพุ่มไม้ แล้วกลับมาที่ทางอีกครั้ง
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đi theo đường, rẽ vào bụi cây, rồi lại quay về đường.
data.Indonesian: Mereka mengikuti jalan, masuk ke semak-semak, lalu kembali ke jalan lagi.

data.Korean: 도망치다가 길을 못 찾은 것 같아.
data.English: It looks like they couldn't find the way while running away.
data.Thai: ดูเหมือนพวกมันหาทางไม่เจอระหว่างหนี
data.Vietnamese: Có vẻ chúng không tìm được đường trong lúc bỏ chạy.
data.Indonesian: Sepertinya mereka tidak bisa menemukan jalan saat melarikan diri.

data.Korean: 그런데 마지막 방향은 거의 같아.
data.English: But their final direction is almost the same.
data.Thai: แต่ทิศทางสุดท้ายแทบจะเหมือนกัน
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng hướng cuối cùng gần như giống nhau.
data.Indonesian: Tapi arah akhirnya hampir sama.

data.Korean: 흩어진 것처럼 보여도 결국 같은 쪽으로 몰리고 있어.
data.English: Even if they look scattered, in the end they're being drawn toward the same side.
data.Thai: ถึงจะดูเหมือนกระจัดกระจาย แต่สุดท้ายก็ถูกพาไปรวมทางเดียวกัน
data.Vietnamese: Dù trông như bị phân tán, cuối cùng chúng vẫn dồn về cùng một phía.
data.Indonesian: Meski tampak menyebar, pada akhirnya mereka tetap terdorong ke sisi yang sama.

data.Korean: 좁은 길에서 이리저리 밀리면 다치기 쉽지.
data.English: If you're shoved around on a narrow path, it's easy to get hurt.
data.Thai: ถ้าถูกเบียดไปมาบนทางแคบ ๆ ก็บาดเจ็บง่าย
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị xô qua xô lại trên đường hẹp thì rất dễ bị thương.
data.Indonesian: Kalau terdorong ke sana kemari di jalan sempit, mudah sekali terluka.

data.Korean: 덤불에 긁히는 것도 은근히 오래 가고...
data.English: Even scratches from bushes can linger longer than you'd think...
data.Thai: รอยข่วนจากพุ่มไม้ก็เจ็บอยู่นานกว่าที่คิดด้วย...
data.Vietnamese: Vết xước do bụi cây cũng kéo dài lâu hơn tưởng tượng...
data.Indonesian: Goresan dari semak-semak pun bisa lama terasa...

data.Korean: 좁으면 막는 건 편한데, 놓치면 다시 찾기 어렵겠네.
data.English: If it's narrow, blocking them is easier, but if we miss them, finding them again will be hard.
data.Thai: ถ้าทางแคบ การกันไว้ก็ง่าย แต่ถ้าพลาดไปแล้วจะหาพวกมันอีกยาก
data.Vietnamese: Nếu đường hẹp thì chặn dễ hơn, nhưng nếu để lọt thì tìm lại sẽ khó.
data.Indonesian: Kalau sempit, menahan mereka lebih mudah, tapi kalau terlepas akan sulit ditemukan lagi.

data.Korean: 맞아. 그래서 중심을 비워 두면 안 돼.
data.English: Right. That's why we can't leave the center open.
data.Thai: ใช่ เพราะงั้นจะปล่อยตรงกลางว่างไว้ไม่ได้
data.Vietnamese: Đúng. Vì vậy không được để trống phần giữa.
data.Indonesian: Benar. Karena itu kita tidak boleh membiarkan bagian tengah terbuka.

data.Korean: 오솔길 중앙을 잡되, 너무 깊게 쫓아가진 말자.
data.English: Hold the center of the footpath, but don't chase too deep.
data.Thai: ยึดตรงกลางทางเดินเล็กไว้ แต่อย่าไล่ลึกเกินไป
data.Vietnamese: Giữ trung tâm lối mòn, nhưng đừng đuổi quá sâu.
data.Indonesian: Kuasai bagian tengah jalan setapak, tapi jangan mengejar terlalu dalam.

data.Korean: 흩어진 무리가 제플 방향으로 빠지지 않게 막자.
data.English: Stop the scattered groups from slipping toward Jeple.
data.Thai: กันไม่ให้ฝูงที่แตกกระจายเล็ดลอดไปทางเจเพิล
data.Vietnamese: Chặn các nhóm tản ra để chúng không lọt về phía Jeple.
data.Indonesian: Cegah gerombolan yang tersebar agar tidak lolos ke arah Jeple.

data.Korean: 왼쪽 덤불에 움직임이 있어.
data.English: There's movement in the bushes on the left.
data.Thai: มีการเคลื่อนไหวในพุ่มไม้ทางซ้าย
data.Vietnamese: Có chuyển động trong bụi cây bên trái.
data.Indonesian: Ada pergerakan di semak-semak sebelah kiri.

data.Korean: 오른쪽 길 아래에도 작은 무리가 숨어 있어.
data.English: A small group is hiding below the path on the right too.
data.Thai: ใต้ทางด้านขวาก็มีกลุ่มเล็กซ่อนอยู่ด้วย
data.Vietnamese: Bên dưới đường phía phải cũng có một nhóm nhỏ đang ẩn nấp.
data.Indonesian: Di bawah jalan sebelah kanan juga ada gerombolan kecil bersembunyi.

data.Korean: 그럼 가운데를 잡을게.
data.English: Then I'll hold the middle.
data.Thai: งั้นฉันจะยึดตรงกลางไว้
data.Vietnamese: Vậy tôi sẽ giữ phần giữa.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, aku akan menahan bagian tengah.

data.Korean: 양쪽으로 새면 바로 말해 줘!
data.English: Tell me right away if they slip out to either side!
data.Thai: ถ้าพวกมันเล็ดลอดไปสองข้าง รีบบอกทันทีนะ!
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chúng lọt sang hai bên thì báo ngay nhé!
data.Indonesian: Kalau mereka lolos ke kedua sisi, segera beri tahu!

data.Korean: 덤불 때문에 양쪽을 동시에 보기 어려워.
data.English: The bushes make it hard to watch both sides at once.
data.Thai: เพราะพุ่มไม้ เลยมองทั้งสองฝั่งพร้อมกันได้ยาก
data.Vietnamese: Vì bụi cây nên khó quan sát hai bên cùng lúc.
data.Indonesian: Karena semak-semak, sulit melihat kedua sisi sekaligus.

data.Korean: 무리하게 따라가면 오히려 놓칠 수 있어.
data.English: If we follow too forcefully, we might lose them instead.
data.Thai: ถ้าฝืนตามไป อาจกลับกลายเป็นปล่อยหลุดได้
data.Vietnamese: Nếu cố đuổi theo quá mức, ngược lại có thể để mất dấu.
data.Indonesian: Kalau kita memaksa mengejar, justru bisa kehilangan mereka.

data.Korean: 오른쪽은 흔적이 얕아. 작은 무리야.
data.English: The traces on the right are shallow. It's a small group.
data.Thai: ฝั่งขวาร่องรอยตื้น เป็นกลุ่มเล็ก
data.Vietnamese: Bên phải dấu vết nông. Đó là một nhóm nhỏ.
data.Indonesian: Jejak di kanan dangkal. Itu gerombolan kecil.

data.Korean: 왼쪽은 가지가 방금 꺾였어. 더 큰 무리가 가까워.
data.English: On the left, branches just broke. A larger group is close.
data.Thai: ฝั่งซ้ายกิ่งไม้เพิ่งหัก กลุ่มที่ใหญ่กว่ากำลังอยู่ใกล้
data.Vietnamese: Bên trái cành cây vừa bị gãy. Một nhóm lớn hơn đang ở gần.
data.Indonesian: Di kiri, ranting baru saja patah. Gerombolan yang lebih besar sudah dekat.

data.Korean: 그럼 왼쪽 큰 무리부터 막고, 오른쪽 작은 무리는 오솔길 안쪽에서 정리하자.
data.English: Then stop the large group on the left first, and handle the small group on the right inside the footpath.
data.Thai: งั้นหยุดกลุ่มใหญ่ทางซ้ายก่อน แล้วจัดการกลุ่มเล็กทางขวาภายในทางเดินเล็ก
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chặn nhóm lớn bên trái trước, rồi xử lý nhóm nhỏ bên phải ở trong lối mòn.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, hentikan gerombolan besar di kiri dulu, lalu bereskan gerombolan kecil di kanan di dalam jalan setapak.

data.Korean: 좋아. 큰 쪽은 내가 붙잡을게!
data.English: Good. I'll hold the bigger group!
data.Thai: ดี กลุ่มใหญ่ฉันจะจับไว้เอง!
data.Vietnamese: Được. Nhóm lớn để tôi giữ lại!
data.Indonesian: Baik. Yang besar akan aku tahan!

data.Korean: 다치면 바로 뒤로 와. 내가 볼게.
data.English: If you're hurt, come back right away. I'll take a look.
data.Thai: ถ้าบาดเจ็บให้ถอยมาข้างหลังทันที ฉันจะดูให้
data.Vietnamese: Nếu bị thương thì lùi lại ngay. Tôi sẽ xem cho.
data.Indonesian: Kalau terluka, segera mundur ke belakang. Aku akan memeriksanya.

data.Korean: 누가 덤불에서 굴러 나오면 일단 한숨부터 쉬고 치료할게...
data.English: If anyone rolls out of the bushes, I'll sigh first and then treat them...
data.Thai: ถ้ามีใครกลิ้งออกมาจากพุ่มไม้ ฉันจะถอนหายใจก่อนแล้วค่อยรักษานะ...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu ai lăn ra khỏi bụi cây, tôi sẽ thở dài trước rồi mới chữa...
data.Indonesian: Kalau ada yang terguling keluar dari semak-semak, aku akan menghela napas dulu baru mengobati...

data.Korean: 움직임이 시작됐어.
data.English: The movement has started.
data.Thai: การเคลื่อนไหวเริ่มแล้ว
data.Vietnamese: Chuyển động bắt đầu rồi.
data.Indonesian: Pergerakannya sudah dimulai.

data.Korean: 길 양쪽에서 동시에 나오고 있어.
data.English: They're coming out from both sides of the path at the same time.
data.Thai: พวกมันออกมาจากทั้งสองฝั่งของทางพร้อมกัน
data.Vietnamese: Chúng đang xuất hiện đồng thời từ hai bên đường.
data.Indonesian: Mereka keluar bersamaan dari kedua sisi jalan.

data.Korean: 좋아. 오솔길 중앙에서 막자.
data.English: All right. Let's stop them at the center of the footpath.
data.Thai: ดี หยุดพวกมันที่กลางทางเดินเล็กกัน
data.Vietnamese: Được. Hãy chặn chúng ở giữa lối mòn.
data.Indonesian: Baik. Kita hentikan mereka di tengah jalan setapak.

data.Korean: 제플 쪽으로 빠질 틈은 주지 말자.
data.English: Don't give them any opening to slip toward Jeple.
